jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description: Software Engineer I : **APPLY at**: **https://virnous.com/careers/** Department: Engineering Reports to: Director of Engineering / Chief Technology Officer Employment type: Full\-time Level: Entry level (1 to 3 years of experience) Position Summary Virnous builds software for the people who work criminal cases: detectives, crime analysts, and prosecutors. Our main product, CANDOR, takes the raw data that shows up in a modern investigation, such as phone carrier records, cell site location information (CSLI), device extractions, and social media returns, and turns it into maps, timelines, and reports that an investigator can use and defend in court. We also build a public tip line, a training platform, and CANDOR Edge, a self\-contained version of CANDOR for agencies whose data can’t leave their building. As a Software Engineer I, you’ll be working on real features and bug fixes from your first few weeks. Most of our code is Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, with a good amount of JavaScript on the front end. You’ll get code review, pairing, and plenty of room to ask questions. In return, we need you to be careful. The files our customers upload are evidence, and what our software shows them can end up in front of a jury. Getting it right matters more to us than getting it done fast. Key Duties \& Responsibilities Build and maintain features across CANDOR and our other Rails applications, from the database migration through the view, along with the tests that cover them. Write and improve the importers that read what investigators bring us: carrier call detail records, tower lists, spreadsheets, PDFs, and phone extraction reports. These files are often messy, and carriers change their formats without telling anyone**.\* Track down bugs reported by customers and our support team. Reproduce the problem, find the real cause, fix it, and add a test that would have caught it. Work on the front end with Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus) and plain JavaScript, including maps, timelines, and charts that sometimes have to draw hundreds of thousands of records. Write and maintain automated tests, and help keep the CI pipeline passing. Help move code from development to test to production, and keep an eye on it after it goes live. Work with our support staff and investigators, many of whom come from law enforcement, to learn how the software is used on real cases. Use AI coding tools as part of your daily work, and review what they produce as closely as you would review a teammate’s pull request**.\* Update documentation and runbooks when you change how something works. What You’ll Work With * Ruby 3\.x and Rails 8, with Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus), import maps, and Solid Queue for background jobs. PostgreSQL, S3\-compatible object storage, and Apache Arrow for large datasets. JavaScript with D3, deck.gl, Google Maps, and Sigma.js for maps, charts, and link\-analysis graphs. Minitest and Capybara for application tests, and Playwright with TypeScript for end\-to\-end tests. Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, and Ansible for builds and deployments. Self\-hosted language models (vLLM, Ollama, and LiteLLM) that run features like our Ask Sarge assistant. Required Qualifications * 1 to 3 years of professional experience building web applications. A strong internship or co\-op can count toward this. Working knowledge of a server\-side web framework. Rails is ideal, but if you know Django, Laravel, Express, or something similar, you can pick up Rails here. Comfortable writing SQL and working with a relational database, preferably PostgreSQL. Solid fundamentals in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Everyday comfort with Git: commits, pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts. The habit of writing tests as part of the work, not after it. A methodical approach to debugging: read the logs, form a theory, check it, and say so plainly when you don’t know yet. Clear writing. You’ll write tickets, commit messages, and explanations for people who aren’t engineers. Good judgment and discretion with sensitive information. Our customers trust us with active criminal case data. Ability to pass a criminal background check. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with Ruby on Rails, especially Rails 7 or 8 and Hotwire. Experience with Docker. Exposure to Kubernetes, Jenkins, or another CI/CD system is a plus. Experience parsing and cleaning messy real\-world data in CSV, Excel, XML, JSON, or PDF form. Familiarity with geospatial data (coordinates, bearings, distance math) or with charting and mapping libraries like D3 or deck.gl. Curiosity about how large language models and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) work in practice. We run our own models in\-house. Any exposure to digital forensics, cellular networks, or the criminal justice system. It isn’t required. We’ll teach you the domain. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. *This job description outlines the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Duties may be modified at any time based on business needs.* Pay: $60,742\.41 \- $106,872\.57 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Phoenix, AZ 85016

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Platform
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **About Arena Intelligence** ============================ Arena is the platform for evaluating how AI models perform in the real world. Founded by researchers from UC Berkeley's SkyLab, we're on a mission to measure and advance the frontier of AI for real\-world use, and to build the foundation for everyone to understand, shape, and benefit from it. Tens of millions of people use Arena each month to evaluate how frontier systems handle the work they actually do. The preferences they share power the most transparent, rigorous, and human\-centered evaluations in AI. Leading AI labs, enterprises, and independent researchers rely on our work and open datasets to understand how models behave in real workflows: agentic coding, creative generation, professional productivity, and beyond. We go beyond leaderboards and decompose what human experience reveals about AI, so models advance toward the work people actually do. We're a team of researchers, academics, builders, and creatives from UC Berkeley, Google, Stanford, and DeepMind. We seek truth, move fast, and value craftsmanship, curiosity, and impact over hierarchy. We're building a company where thoughtful, curious people from all backgrounds can do their best work together, in an office culture that radiates excellence, energy, and focus. ### **About the Role** Arena Intelligence is looking for a Software Engineer, Platform to build the core infrastructure that sits beneath our online evaluation systems — the AI gateways, automated arena runtimes, and serving layers that make real\-world model evaluation possible at scale. This is a critical part of the Arena Service. Arenas are live, online systems: they route traffic across frontier models from many providers, handle bursty and unpredictable load, need to fail gracefully when upstream models do, and have to remain fair and consistent under all of it. We exist to build foundational infrastructure for our users that scales, is reliable, and makes the complexities of operating this infrastructure at scale disappear. We need a practitioner who's shipped this kind of infrastructure before and knows where the sharp edges are. Our AI gateway is currently in private, gated launch with individual developers as our primary users today; enterprise use cases will follow later. Next month we're shipping direct model access and new infrastructure features, and Arena may begin collecting usage traces and building leaderboards shared with lab partners — so there's a lot of near\-term, zero\-to\-one work ahead. You'll be an early member of our infrastructure team, working closely with researchers, engineers, and product leadership. The work is zero\-to\-one in places and scale\-it\-up in others. We move fast and stay rigorous. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role — we're not hiring for a tech lead or SRE function right now; everyone on the team is heads\-down building. ### **What You'll Do** * **Build API\-based products from the ground up.** Design and implement low\-latency, high\-reliability APIs for leaderboards, models, and arenas. * **Solve hard streaming problems.** Handle SSE/streaming responses across heterogeneous providers, including partial failure recovery, mid\-stream fallback, and consistent response normalization. * **Ship enterprise\-grade infrastructure.** Build the systems enterprise customers will eventually expect — rate limiting, authentication, usage metering, cost attribution, audit logging, and SOC 2 compliance — as we grow beyond our current individual\-developer user base. * **Build deep observability.** Instrument infrastructure with distributed tracing, latency breakdowns, token\-level usage tracking, and real\-time dashboards so customers (and we) can see exactly what's happening. * **Build AI\-centered products.** Integrate with our core evaluation platform, Arena data, and customer\-specific benchmarks. Collaborate with the research team to turn novel ideas into full\-featured products. (This role does not involve data labeling or third\-party data\-verification work.) * **Flex across the stack.** Contribute to the backend of our Leaderboards and Evals platforms when needed, helping unify our public and private data architectures. ### **You’ll have** * \~5\+ years of backend engineering experience, with meaningful time spent on distributed systems, infrastructure, or developer\-facing platforms. + *Senior:* proven delivery on meaningful backend work. + *Staff:* extensive, deep experience owning backend systems end to end. * Strong proficiency in Go — this is our primary backend language and a must\-have for the role. * Experience with LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.) and a working understanding of the challenges: streaming, token management, rate limits, model\-specific quirks. * A product\-oriented mindset. You think about the developer experience of your APIs, not just the implementation. You ask "why" before "how." * Comfort with ambiguity. We're a startup. Scope is fluid, context shifts, and you'll wear many hats. That should sound exciting, not stressful. ### **Nice to Have** * Cloud infrastructure experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure), Kubernetes, Terraform, and database systems like Postgres and Redis — helpful, but not a hard filter. * Experience building API gateways, proxies, or developer tools (Bifrost, Kong, Envoy, Tyk, or custom). * Background in AI/ML infrastructure, model serving, inference, or evaluation frameworks. * Experience building enterprise\-ready features: SSO, RBAC, audit logs, multi\-tenancy. * Experience building billing infrastructure around systems like Stripe, Metronome, and Orb. * Familiarity with the modern AI infra stack (vLLM, LiteLLM, LangChain, etc.). ### **Location** This role is based in San Francisco, with a minimum of 3 days/week onsite. Fully remote candidates will only be considered with a very strong endorsement. **What we offer** ================= * We offer competitive compensation and equity aligned to the markets where our team members are based. The base salary range will depend on the candidate’s permanent work location. * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and additional support programs. * The opportunity to work on cutting\-edge AI with a small, mission\-driven team * A culture that values transparency, trust, and community impact Come help build the space where anyone can explore and help shape the future of AI. Arena Intelligence *provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.*

Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world\-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: **Building the future of Disney’s media:** Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. **Reach, Scale \& Impact:** More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. build a culture aligned to our Media\-generalist model including PMs who use AI\-assisted tools to accelerate discovery and sharpen their work. * Maintain working fluency across the live and linear platform; identify where AI and automation can improve reliability, reduce operational burden, or unlock new capabilities. **Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training:** * 10\+ years of experience in product management or a related discipline. * Experience leading and developing PM teams, with demonstrated investment in coaching and raising the standard of product thinking. * Experience owning product strategy across a complex, multi\-domain platform or media technology environment, with accountability for measurable outcomes. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to frame portfolio strategy for executive audiences and align cross\-functional stakeholders. * Proven ability to operate across organizational boundaries and unblock teams in ambiguous situations. **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with live media workflows: signal acquisition, live event orchestration, linear playout, dMVPD and DVR, SCTE 224 / SCTE\-35 processing, and in\-stream ad insertion. * Experience with FAST channel operations and content marking, decoration, and scheduling systems. * Platform or infrastructure PM background at a large\-scale streaming or media technology organization. * Experience building or scaling a product team in a new or evolving domain. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted PM workflows and a point of view on how they raise team productivity and craft. **Required Education** * Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field required \#TECHATDISNEY The hiring range for this position in New York, NY is $197,400 to $264,700 per year, and in Morrisville, NC is $179,500 to $240,600 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. jobs.title: Sr Product Software Engineer
jobs.description: **\*\*This position must sit onsite four (4\) days a week in our Seattle, WA technology location\*\*** **Overview** **On any given day at Disney Entertainment \& ESPN Technology, we’re reimagining ways to create magical viewing experiences for the world’s most beloved stories while also transforming Disney’s media business for the future. Whether that’s evolving our streaming and digital products in new and immersive ways, powering worldwide advertising and distribution to maximize flexibility and efficiency, or delivering Disney’s unmatched entertainment and sports content, every day is a moment to make a difference to partners and to hundreds of millions of people around the world.** *A few reasons why we think you’d love working for Disney Entertainment \& ESPN Technology:* * **Building the future of Disney’s media business:** DE\&E Technologists are designing and building the infrastructure that will power Disney’s media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. * **Reach \& Scale:** The products and platforms this group builds and operates delight millions of consumers every minute of every day – from Disney\+ and Hulu, to ABC News and Entertainment, to ESPN and ESPN\+, and much more. * **Innovation:** We develop and execute groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and enhance how audiences experience sports, entertainment \& news. **Job Summary** The Event Platform team is the pillar of a data processing pipeline responsible for powering core features and analytics across all of Disney’s streaming services (including Disney\+, Hulu, ESPN, and more). The team is responsible for transmitting billions of client\-emitted signals throughout the Disney ecosystem. We build and manage platforms that process terabytes of data daily while performing real\-time enrichment and aggregation for nearline and offline uses. As a software engineer at Disney, you will help to build the platform that powers these applications. jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: **About us** ------------ MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The job** ----------- You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work. From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved. You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer. You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers. **About you** ------------- * You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job. * You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role. * You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum. * You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations. * You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew. * You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one. * You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy. * You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them. * You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team. **Nice to have:** ----------------- * AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background. * You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers. * Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship. * Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders. **What we offer** ----------------- * Competitive base, variable, and significant equity. * Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership. * Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to implement features, optimize performance, and ensure seamless integration with backend services. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: *Job Description* **Location** Salem, Massachusetts **Position Type** Full\-time, on\-site **Department** Engineering / Operations **Works Closely With** Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Operations Leadership About ANCORE ANCORE is a growing fitness\-equipment manufacturer based in Salem, Massachusetts. We design and assemble compact mechanical products used by athletes, fitness professionals, rehabilitation providers, and consumers. ANCORE is entering a significant period of growth. We are preparing to substantially expand manufacturing capacity, improve our existing assembly operation, develop new tooling and processes, and ultimately transition into a new facility designed around the next stage of the business. Position Summary ANCORE is seeking a highly hands\-on Manufacturing Engineer to own the technical side of our manufacturing system and help develop, improve, and scale our assembly processes, production tooling, fixtures, workstations, material flow, testing methods, and manufacturing infrastructure. This role will work closely with ANCORE's Production Manager, who currently owns day\-to\-day production and brings deep knowledge of the product and assembly process. The Manufacturing Engineer will not replace that ownership; instead, they will provide the technical engineering capability needed to improve how the line is designed, supported, tested, and scaled. The successful candidate should be equally comfortable developing a concept in CAD, fabricating or modifying a fixture, testing it with production personnel, evaluating the results, and refining the solution. Not every challenge will fall neatly within an existing internal process or area of expertise. This person must be curious, resourceful, and comfortable learning unfamiliar systems, identifying outside expertise where necessary, and independently driving projects from problem definition through implementation. ANCORE's manufacturing environment is centered on mechanical assembly, so direct experience implementing fixtures, tooling, workstations, or process changes on an active assembly floor is strongly preferred. Key Responsibilities · Own the technical development and improvement of the processes used to assemble, test, inspect, package, and move ANCORE products through production, in close partnership with the Production Manager and production team. · Work side\-by\-side with the Production Manager, combining their day\-to\-day production and product knowledge with engineering analysis, design, and process\-development capability. · Partner with the Production Manager to analyze assembly methods, cycle times, bottlenecks, ergonomics, labor needs, and production flow, and develop practical technical solutions as volume increases. · Design custom assembly fixtures, gauges, tooling, test fixtures, mistake\-proofing devices, workstation accessories, and other production aids. · Personally prototype, fabricate, machine, assemble, modify, and troubleshoot fixtures and tooling when practical, while using outside fabrication resources appropriately when needed. · Create production\-ready CAD models, drawings, and documentation for fixtures, tools, and equipment, and refine designs based on operator feedback. · Support capacity expansion by modeling cycle times, workstation and equipment needs, line balance, material flow, and processes requiring duplication, redesign, or automation, while working with Manufacturing leadership on staffing and operating requirements. · Design workstations, production cells, and material\-flow systems around efficient presentation of parts, ergonomics, quality, and operator use. · Own the technical manufacturing inputs to ANCORE's future facility planning, including production layouts, material flow, compressed air, electrical service, workstations, equipment, testing systems, storage interfaces, and production utilities, in partnership with Manufacturing and Operations leadership. · Coordinate with contractors, equipment suppliers, manufacturing leadership, and outside technical resources; support equipment relocation, installation, commissioning, and process validation. · Troubleshoot manufacturing equipment and process problems and develop mistake\-proofing and process controls that prevent errors rather than relying only on inspection. · Work with Product Engineering to improve manufacturability, with Quality Engineering to develop and validate production test methods and process capability, and with the Production Manager to implement changes effectively on the line. · Document manufacturing knowledge so critical processes do not depend solely on individual experience. Required Qualifications · Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering, engineering technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience. · 3\+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, mechanical design, process engineering, tooling, or a related hands\-on engineering role. · Strong mechanical\-design and practical problem\-solving ability. · Experience designing mechanical fixtures, tooling, equipment, or production aids. · Strong proficiency with 3D CAD and mechanical drawings. · Comfort personally building, testing, modifying, and troubleshooting physical solutions. · Strong understanding of mechanical assemblies, tolerances, fasteners, materials, and fabrication methods. · Ability to independently take a loosely defined problem from observation through design, implementation, and refinement. · Demonstrated resourcefulness and ability to learn unfamiliar technical systems. · Strong organization and communication skills and ability to work closely with production personnel. Preferred Qualifications · Hands\-on machining experience using manual mills, lathes, drill presses, saws, or similar equipment. · Experience personally fabricating prototypes, fixtures, gauges, or production tooling. · Welding, sheet\-metal, 3D\-printing, woodworking, or other practical fabrication experience. · Experience designing assembly lines, work cells, material\-flow systems, or manufacturing layouts. · Familiarity with lean manufacturing, line balancing, cycle\-time analysis, standard work, and mistake\-proofing. · Experience with pneumatic systems, compressed\-air tooling, sensors, basic controls, or production automation. · Experience commissioning equipment or supporting a manufacturing\-facility expansion or move. · Experience with mechanically assembled products or low\-to\-medium\-volume manufacturing. What Success Looks Like The successful candidate will become the technical engineering owner of ANCORE's manufacturing system while working side\-by\-side with the Production Manager, who continues to own day\-to\-day production. Together, they will improve how materials flow, how products are assembled and tested, how operators interact with fixtures and workstations, and how the line scales without sacrificing quality. Over the next several years, this role will have the opportunity to influence everything from individual hand tools and assembly fixtures to the architecture of ANCORE's next manufacturing facility. This is not a role where the engineer simply writes recommendations for someone else to implement, nor is it a role that independently owns every aspect of production. We are looking for someone who enjoys turning ideas into physical solutions, collaborating closely with the Production Manager and Quality team, and taking responsibility for the technical side of seeing those solutions work in production. Physical and Work Requirements · Full\-time, on\-site work in Salem, Massachusetts. · Significant time working directly in manufacturing, assembly, fabrication, and testing areas. · Ability to safely use hand tools, fabrication equipment, and machine tools appropriate to the employee's training. · Ability to lift and move tools, fixtures, products, or components weighing up to 35 pounds. · Occasional travel may be required for equipment suppliers, vendors, or facility\-related work. Compensation and Benefits · **Compensation:** $95,000–$120,000 annually · **Health Insurance:** HSA\-eligible health plan with 50/50 premium sharing · **Retirement:** Fidelity Safe Harbor 401(k) with a 4% company contribution at a 5% employee contribution · **Dental \& Vision:** Employee\-paid coverage available · **Time Off:** Paid holidays, PTO, and additional benefits in accordance with company policy ANCORE is an equal opportunity employer. Pay: $95,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Service Desk Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** Astrolab is The Lunar Operations Company. experience with macOS and/or Linux is a plus * Experience working with Microsoft 365 applications and supporting user accounts and access **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience with CompTIA A\+, Microsoft Certified: Fundamentals (MS\-900 or AZ\-900\), or an equivalent technical certification * Experience working with ticketing or IT service management (ITSM) platforms, such as ServiceNow, Freshservice, or Jira Service Management * Experience supporting or administering Intune, Entra ID, Azure AD, or similar identity and device\-management platforms * Experience supporting technical, engineering, manufacturing, aerospace, robotics, or other complex technical environments * Experience communicating clearly and effectively with users of varying levels of technical expertise * Experience troubleshooting technical issues, prioritizing requests, and managing multiple support needs in a fast\-paced environment * Experience delivering responsive, customer\-focused support while maintaining a professional and solutions\-oriented approach * Experience safely handling and moving IT equipment weighing up to approximately 40 pounds and working on\-site daily ### **Benefits and Perks** * Join a team of best\-in\-class engineers building the foundation of planetary surface exploration * Equity ownership in the company * Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and mental health support * 401(k) plan with company match * Flexible PTO and parental leave * Weekly lunch stipend, plus complimentary snacks and beverages on\-site * Once a month social hour on\-site with food and drinks ### **About Astrolab** Having a strong, inclusive, and inspired team is essential to accomplishing our bold mission. Over 50 million family caregivers support loved ones without the tools, training, or recognition they deserve. We believe families are the largest untapped caregiving workforce in America, and that technology can help them deliver better care while driving stronger outcomes and greater transparency across the healthcare system. Abby Care combines clinical oversight with an AI\-powered platform to train, enable, and support family caregivers in delivering high\-quality care at home. Our platform helps health plans and government partners better understand, verify, and improve care in the home. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher\-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively. We are proud to partner with leading health plans, providers, and community organizations and are backed by top VCs. You will be a critical voice for articulating technical initiatives to further our mission. * Lead the team in technical excellence. You will deepen your technical “spikes”, be they in product\-development, cloud infrastructure, machine learning, or data security, as well as broaden your horizons by building greenfield systems using the latest advancements in AI. You will be challenged to uphold health care industry standards and become an expert in one of the US’s largest sectors. **What you'll have:** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience * Experience with Web and API development * Experience working with Typescript and Python * Experience with cloud architectures and platforms such as AWS * A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field is preferred * Experience with product development is preferred * Experience in the healthcare industry and at startups is preferred **Benefits:** ------------- * **Competitive compensation packages** that reflect the value you bring. jobs.title: Multiaxis CNC Manufacturing Technologist (Milling)
jobs.description: **Ready to solve complex 5\-axis challenges and grow into programming?** ======================================================================== **Industry:** Advanced Manufacturing **Shifts:** multiple available **Pay:** $30–$50/hour (depending on experience). Multiple openings available. **Why this role?** ------------------ * Do you thrive on transforming tough materials into precise parts on a 5\-axis mill? * Do you enjoy collaborating with engineers to make designs easier to machine? * Do you want a defined path from operator to CNC programmer in months, not years? **The Challenge** ----------------- * Operate and set up advanced 5\-axis milling centers to hold tight tolerances on complex geometries. * Jump between prototypes and scaling production as our operation accelerates. * Edit existing programs early on; advance to full CNC programming within 6–12 months. * Cut a variety of materials, including Inconel and metal 3D\-printed blanks, as your experience allows. **Must\-Haves** --------------- * **Direct, hands\-on 5\-axis milling experience (required — non\-negotiable).** * Problem\-solver who works confidently without rigid, step\-by\-step procedures. * Genuine ambition to advance into a more technical programming role. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * DMG Mori platforms. * Siemens controls. * Mastercam or comparable CAM. * Background machining exotic alloys (Inconel). * Experience with metal additive parts. * High\-growth space/aerospace hardware experience (e.g., SpaceX, Rocket Lab, Vast). **Your Toolkit** ---------------- * **Proficiencies:** 5\-axis, problem solving. * **Machines \& Tech:** DMG Mori, Siemens controls. **What success looks like** --------------------------- * Week 1–4: Master setups, prove\-out runs, and process stabilization. * Month 2–3: Confidently edit and optimize existing programs with engineering input. * Month 6–12: Author full CNC programs and drive repeatable, scalable production. Join a fast\-scaling team that invests in people. We’re elevating machinists into programmers—not simply filling seats.

jobs.title: Field Engineer II
jobs.description: **Field Service Technician \- Network \& Technology Services :** **Acuative** is seeking a dependable and technically capable hands\-on **Field Service Technician** to provide installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and Smart Hands support for network and technology infrastructure at customer locations. Technicians work with a wide variety of network, communications, computing, and low\-voltage infrastructure and frequently coordinate with remote Network Operations Centers (NOCs), engineers, project coordinators, and customer technical teams to complete installations and resolve service issues. This is a full time benefits eligible position that includes a company vehicle, gas card for vehicle, inventory, and training. Prior field service, IT, networking, telecommunications, or structured cabling experience is preferred. However, candidates with a strong technical background, mechanical aptitude, and a demonstrated willingness to learn are encouraged to apply. Acuative provides paid training and technical support for the work our technicians perform. Technicians serve as the Onsite Smart Hands resource, performing physical installation, cabling, testing, troubleshooting, equipment replacement, and other hands\-on tasks while working with remote technical resources when configuration or advanced troubleshooting is required. This position requires a person willing to go to new places. Tickets can be assigned four or more hours away to provide installation and maintenance services to voice and data networks, servers, computer systems, retail technology systems, and other network\-based hardware. **Acuative technicians are guaranteed forty (40\) hours of pay per week even if not dispatched for forty hours.** To be eligible for this role you must have a clear driver’s license (no more than 4 points), have the Covid\-19 vaccination, and willing to work mostly M\-F with opportunity for overtime and call out pay after hours and weekends. This position often works alone, and qualified applicants must be able to lift up to fifty pounds above head and climb a ladder. **Acuative is a drug free workplace.** **Overview:** Acuative, the nation's leading independent provider of telecommunications field services, seeks a Field Service Technician. The successful candidate will spend the majority of their time covering the (MARKET) area providing installation and maintenance services to voice and data networks, servers, computer systems, retail technology systems, and other network\-based hardware. **Primary Duties and Responsibilities :** The position involves a variety of tasks including but not limited to: * Install, replace, relocate, rack, stack, mount, and provide Smart Hands support for routers, switches, wireless access points, firewalls, cellular gateways, SD\-WAN equipment, servers, circuits, telephony and other network\-based hardware. * Perform physical installation and replacement of equipment from a variety of manufacturers and technology platforms, including circuit extensions, structured cabling, fixed wireless, and Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite solutions. * Perform equipment cutovers and migrations while working with remote engineers, NOCs, project teams, and customer technical resources. * Locate, identify, label, and document telecommunications circuits, circuit IDs, demarcation points, network equipment, ports, cabling, and associated infrastructure. * Troubleshoot copper cabling and connectivity using appropriate test equipment, including cable testers, toner/probe sets, and related tools. Perform circuit extensions and other low\-voltage cabling work as required. * Conduct site surveys and site audits to document existing infrastructure, equipment, cabling, power availability, installation requirements, and other site conditions. * Install LEO satellite and fixed wireless equipment, including exterior mounting, antenna installation, cable routing from exterior to interior locations, and associated indoor network equipment. Installation of Fixed Wireless Antennas, cables and hardware. * Carry and position tools, networking equipment, mounting hardware, ladders, satellite installation components, ballast/cinder blocks, and other materials required for field installations. * Complete all required job deliverables accurately and on time. Deliverables may include photographs, ticket notes, equipment and serial\-number information, Microsoft Excel survey forms, sign\-off documents, installation checklists, test results, and customer\-specific electronic forms or applications. * Maintain assigned company vehicle, inventory, tools, test equipment, and safety equipment according to departmental standards. * Ability to work off a lift or ladder at heights up to 30 feet or more. **Preferred Qualifications :** * Working knowledge of networking hardware and topologies. * Previous experience in IT field services, telecommunications, networking, structured cabling, computer hardware, electronics, or a related technical field. * Ability to identify and work with routers, switches, wireless access points, firewalls, cellular gateways, modems, servers, telecommunications circuits, and related hardware. * Basic understanding of telecommunications circuits, demarcation points, circuit extensions, and connectivity troubleshooting. * Knowledge of computing systems hardware with the ability to provide break/fix support for desktop PC and/or servers. * Physical installations of a wide variety of hardware including routers, switches, WAPs, servers, POS systems, digital signage systems, and associated peripheral equipment. * Ability to provide configuration support for a variety of technology platforms through console and remote applications. * Understanding of telephony systems (VOIP, PBX, Key Systems) with an ability to provide hands\-on hardware and troubleshooting support. * Experience with LEC circuit identification and extensions. * Familiarity with cabling standards and the ability to pull and terminate cabling in a variety of customer environments. * Ability to operate basic power tools – drills, saws, etc. * Work on ladders and lifts where required. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Excel \& Word). * Ability to follow detailed job documents. * Must be willing to travel as needed to meet customer SLAs. * On\-call, after hours, and weekend work may be required. * Must possess a valid drivers’ license with good driving record. * Experience installing LEO Satellite (such as Starlink) and/or Fixed Wireless antennas. * Ability to work off a lift or ladder at heights up to 30 feet or more. **Education \& Certifications :** * Associate’s degree in information technology or equivalent experience. * CompTIA networking, Cisco, Cabling, BICSII, Satellite, PBX or VoIP system certifications a plus! * Selected candidates will be required to attend a hardware and cabling training course at our Global Technology Center in Strongsville, OH. **The Ideal Candidate :** The ideal Field Service Technician is someone we can depend on. You do not need to know every piece of equipment you will encounter on day one. Technology, customers, and project requirements continually change, and training and remote technical support are available. What matters is having a solid technical foundation, the ability and desire to learn, good judgment, and the willingness to work through unfamiliar problems. Our strongest technicians are comfortable working independently, traveling wherever the work requires, communicating professionally with everyone they encounter, and taking ownership of their assignments. They understand when to troubleshoot independently, when to engage remote technical resources, and when a customer Scope of Work requires approval before making a change. If you enjoy hands\-on technology, solving problems in the field, learning new systems, and working in an environment where no two assignments are exactly the same, this position may be a strong fit.

This position requires a person willing to go to new places. Tickets can be assigned four or more hours away to provide installation and maintenance services to voice and data networks, servers, computer systems, retail technology systems, and other network\-based hardware. **Acuative technicians are guaranteed forty (40\) hours of pay per week even if not dispatched for forty hours.** To be eligible for this role you must have a clear driver’s license (no more than 4 points), have the Covid\-19 vaccination, and willing to work mostly M\-F with opportunity for overtime and call out pay after hours and weekends. This position often works alone, and qualified applicants must be able to lift up to fifty pounds above head and climb a ladder. **Acuative is a drug free workplace.** **Overview:** Acuative, the nation's leading independent provider of telecommunications field services, seeks a Field Service Technician. The successful candidate will spend the majority of their time covering the (MARKET) area providing installation and maintenance services to voice and data networks, servers, computer systems, retail technology systems, and other network\-based hardware. **Primary Duties and Responsibilities :** The position involves a variety of tasks including but not limited to: * Install, replace, relocate, rack, stack, mount, and provide Smart Hands support for routers, switches, wireless access points, firewalls, cellular gateways, SD\-WAN equipment, servers, circuits, telephony and other network\-based hardware. * Perform physical installation and replacement of equipment from a variety of manufacturers and technology platforms, including circuit extensions, structured cabling, fixed wireless, and Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite solutions. * Perform equipment cutovers and migrations while working with remote engineers, NOCs, project teams, and customer technical resources. * Locate, identify, label, and document telecommunications circuits, circuit IDs, demarcation points, network equipment, ports, cabling, and associated infrastructure. * Troubleshoot copper cabling and connectivity using appropriate test equipment, including cable testers, toner/probe sets, and related tools. Perform circuit extensions and other low\-voltage cabling work as required. * Conduct site surveys and site audits to document existing infrastructure, equipment, cabling, power availability, installation requirements, and other site conditions. * Install LEO satellite and fixed wireless equipment, including exterior mounting, antenna installation, cable routing from exterior to interior locations, and associated indoor network equipment. Installation of Fixed Wireless Antennas, cables and hardware. * Carry and position tools, networking equipment, mounting hardware, ladders, satellite installation components, ballast/cinder blocks, and other materials required for field installations. * Complete all required job deliverables accurately and on time. Deliverables may include photographs, ticket notes, equipment and serial\-number information, Microsoft Excel survey forms, sign\-off documents, installation checklists, test results, and customer\-specific electronic forms or applications. * Maintain assigned company vehicle, inventory, tools, test equipment, and safety equipment according to departmental standards. * Ability to work off a lift or ladder at heights up to 30 feet or more. **Preferred Qualifications :** * Working knowledge of networking hardware and topologies. * Previous experience in IT field services, telecommunications, networking, structured cabling, computer hardware, electronics, or a related technical field. * Ability to identify and work with routers, switches, wireless access points, firewalls, cellular gateways, modems, servers, telecommunications circuits, and related hardware. * Basic understanding of telecommunications circuits, demarcation points, circuit extensions, and connectivity troubleshooting. * Knowledge of computing systems hardware with the ability to provide break/fix support for desktop PC and/or servers. * Physical installations of a wide variety of hardware including routers, switches, WAPs, servers, POS systems, digital signage systems, and associated peripheral equipment. * Ability to provide configuration support for a variety of technology platforms through console and remote applications. * Understanding of telephony systems (VOIP, PBX, Key Systems) with an ability to provide hands\-on hardware and troubleshooting support. * Experience with LEC circuit identification and extensions. * Familiarity with cabling standards and the ability to pull and terminate cabling in a variety of customer environments. * Ability to operate basic power tools – drills, saws, etc. * Work on ladders and lifts where required. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Excel \& Word). * Ability to follow detailed job documents. * Must be willing to travel as needed to meet customer SLAs. * On\-call, after hours, and weekend work may be required. * Must possess a valid drivers’ license with good driving record. * Experience installing LEO Satellite (such as Starlink) and/or Fixed Wireless antennas. * Ability to work off a lift or ladder at heights up to 30 feet or more. **Education \& Certifications :** * Associate’s degree in information technology or equivalent experience. * CompTIA networking, Cisco, Cabling, BICSII, Satellite, PBX or VoIP system certifications a plus! * Selected candidates will be required to attend a hardware and cabling training course at our Global Technology Center in Strongsville, OH. **The Ideal Candidate :** The ideal Field Service Technician is someone we can depend on. You do not need to know every piece of equipment you will encounter on day one. Technology, customers, and project requirements continually change, and training and remote technical support are available. What matters is having a solid technical foundation, the ability and desire to learn, good judgment, and the willingness to work through unfamiliar problems. Our strongest technicians are comfortable working independently, traveling wherever the work requires, communicating professionally with everyone they encounter, and taking ownership of their assignments. They understand when to troubleshoot independently, when to engage remote technical resources, and when a customer Scope of Work requires approval before making a change. If you enjoy hands\-on technology, solving problems in the field, learning new systems, and working in an environment where no two assignments are exactly the same, this position may be a strong fit.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician II
jobs.description: Description: **Location:** Lafayette, Indiana **Hourly rate**: $31\.50 \- $38\.75 \| OT after 8 hours of travel and work time, double time after 10 hours each day. Saturday work 0\-10 hours is paid at time and a half and Sunday work is double time. All travel is also paid. **Travel:** Position is road/client based; most travel is within home territory; however, technicians may be called to support other teams/clients as needed. Technicians are allowed to book work\-related flights and rooms directly for reimbursement so they can collect points. Technicians are scheduled on weekend rotations. **Advancement \& Training Opportunities:** Yes, after one year of satisfactory service, technicians may be eligible for additional training opportunities such as PLC, FANUC, panel automated shelving, additional electrical and leadership training etc. Internal employees are also eligible for promotions and advancement. **Education:** HSD/GED or equivalent is required, vocational or technical school degree is preferred **Experience:** Minimum 3\-5 years of troubleshooting and repair of mechanical equipment and 2 years of troubleshooting and repair of electrical equipment is required; flexibility to travel and work when customers need assistance is required, this may include some overnights and weekends, as required.? Must be able to communicate with customers and management in both written and verbal form. Must be able to stand/bend for up to 8 hours and lift\-up to 50lbs to shoulder height. Requirements: **Position Summary:** As a Field Service Technician II at Adaptec Solutions, you’ll be the go\-to expert keeping our customers’ automation and material handling systems running at peak performance. This role is hands\-on, working directly with conveyors, sorters, motors, gearboxes, lifts, hoists, and other critical equipment found in high\-volume warehouses and manufacturing environments. You’ll take ownership of installations, preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, and emergency service calls \- often solving problems independently while knowing when to loop in leadership or escalate for support. This position is built for technicians who thrive on variety and problem\-solving. One day you may be wiring a control panel or testing 480V systems, the next you could be fabricating, welding, or rigging to get machinery back online. Our techs are trusted to work directly with customers, deliver clear communication, and document work in our service system, all while operating under strict safety standards. And at Adaptec, you’re not stuck in place \- after your first year of successful service, you’ll have opportunities for advanced training (PLC, FANUC robotics, automated shelving, leadership development, and more), plus clear pathways for promotion and career advancement within our growing organization. **Responsibilities:** * Perform installations, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on electro\-mechanical material handling equipment. This includes conveyor belts, sortation systems, transfers, diverters, merges, and accumulation systems, as well as 480V electrical systems, motors, contactors, three\-phase systems, gearboxes, drives, couplings, lift tables, hoists, cranes, dock equipment, material lifts, control panels, electrical enclosures, bearings, belts, chains, sprockets, and rollers \- all with minimal support from the Lead Technician. * Respond to emergency calls within territory, as needed on a 24/7 basis; occasional but rare travel outside of home territory may be required to support other teams. (Travel time is always compensated) * Perform mechanical work including fabricating, stick welding, and painting. * Carry out maintenance on machinery at client sites as scheduled * Use a multi\-meter to check fuses, troubleshoot contactors, verify power, troubleshoot 3\-phase motors * Appropriately document all work performed in E\-360 reporting system (i.e., Field Service Reports / inspection and audit forms) * Communicate machine issues, status, repair needs/timelines effectively with clients and leadership in both written and verbal communications * Work within the safety guidelines of customers, Adaptec Solutions and OSHA; always operating by the most stringent safety protocol. * Work independently and conscientiously to complete a job, know when to escalate questions or concerns to leadership or the client. **Requirements:** * HSD/GED or equivalent is required, vocational or technical school degree is preferred * Strong electro\-mechanical reasoning ability is required * 5 years of troubleshooting and repair of mechanical equipment and 2 years of troubleshooting and repair of electrical equipment is required * Rigger, Millwright, Machine Builder experience is also acceptable * Ability to read and interpret blueprints, schematics and detailed repair drawings related to material handling equipment * Ability to use hand tools, measurement instruments (such as indicators, calipers, micrometers, tape measure, scales, etc.), power tools to include drills, grinders, welders, impact wrenches and more. Use/operation of heavy equipment such as forklifts, aerial and scissor lifts is required on some jobs * Must possess a foundational understanding of MIG/TIG/Stick welding * Must have valid driver’s license, a clean driving record and ability to comply with DOT regulations. * Must be able to pass DOT physical. * Must be able to attend emergency calls as needed, this may require overnight travel for field service work, preventative maintenance visits, equipment installation and troubleshooting (all travel is paid time) * May be required to travel outside of home territory to assist other teams and customers as needed. * Must have strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to interact with the customer and managers * Must have basic hand tools (Adaptec will provide additional tools) * Must have computer skills, experience turning in field service reports is strongly preferred * Ability to exert 50 to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or 10 to 20 pounds of force constantly to move objects. Ability to lift a minimum of 50 pounds **What We Offer** * Paid Travel Time – You’re compensated for all travel related to field service work, installations, and emergency calls. * Advancement \& Training Opportunities – After one year of satisfactory service, you’ll be eligible for additional training in PLCs, FANUC robotics, panel and automated shelving systems, advanced electrical skills, and leadership development. Internal employees are prioritized for promotions and advancement. * Comprehensive Benefits – Competitive pay, health, dental, vision, 401(k), PTO, and paid holidays. * Tools \& Equipment Support – You’ll need your own basic hand tools, but Adaptec provides specialty tools, safety gear, and ongoing resources to help you succeed. * Team Environment – You’ll work with highly skilled technicians and engineers who support one another and share knowledge openly. * Career Growth in a Growing Industry – Material handling and automation are only expanding, and you’ll have the chance to build your expertise in some of the most in\-demand skills in the field. * Culture of Safety – We never cut corners. Our customers, OSHA, and Adaptec standards are all upheld so you can do your best work with confidence. **Measurements of Success:** * Technicians cross\-trained and versatile in local market * First time fix rate is 95% or better * Strong Voice of the Customer responses/ratings * Technicians are properly utilizing service software * Projects completed safely in expected time frame In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the wage range for this role is **$31\.50 \- $38\.75**. The rate range provided is a general guideline. When extending an offer, Adaptec Solutions considers factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. Adaptec Solutions also offers a variety of benefits including generous paid time off (PTO), 11 paid company holidays including your birthday, generous health plans, dental and vision insurance, HSA/FSA accounts, generous 401(k) match and immediate vesting, short\-term/long term disability coverage and basic life/AD\&D insurance and education assistance. *Adaptec Solutions, LLC is an equal opportunity organization. We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.*

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Advisor Experience
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo. #### **The Role** The Advisor Experience team builds bespoke solutions for financial advisors to grow and sustain their business, starting with a new secure messaging experience. As a Senior Software Engineer with a frontend emphasis, you will be the primary owner of the team's user interface layer — crafting modern, performant, and intuitive experiences that financial advisors rely on daily. You will lead frontend architecture decisions, build and maintain component systems, and collaborate closely with Product Design to translate complex advisor workflows into elegant, accessible interfaces. While your primary impact will be on the frontend, you will work across the full stack as needed to deliver complete features and integrate with backend services and APIs. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment\-based visas such as H\-1B, F\-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment. #### **What You'll Do** * Lead frontend development for the Advisor Experience Secure Messaging product, building rich, performant user interfaces using modern web frameworks. * Design and maintain scalable frontend architecture, including component libraries, state management patterns, and client\-side data layer integration. * Partner closely with Product Design to translate wireframes and prototypes into polished, accessible interfaces that delight users. * Integrate frontend experiences with backend APIs and services, collaborating with backend engineers to define optimal API contracts. * Champion frontend best practices including accessibility, performance optimization, responsive design, and automated testing. #### **Who You Are** * You have a B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science or a similar technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * You have 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with most of that time focused on frontend development. * You have deep experience with at least one modern frontend framework (React, Svelte, Vue, or similar) and genuine curiosity about how they work under the hood. Experience with Ember.js migration is a strong plus. * You've built and maintained component libraries, design systems, or shared UI infrastructure — you care about reusable, well\-structured code that other engineers actually want to use. * You're comfortable navigating a backend codebase when needed — reading and contributing to server\-side code in Java, Node.js, or similar. * You have a strong intuition for frontend performance and know how to diagnose and resolve issues across the rendering and bundling pipeline. * You're familiar with AI\-assisted development workflows and see them as a natural part of how modern software gets built. * Experience with real\-time data, messaging infrastructure, or rich interactive experiences is a plus — especially if you've worked with web sockets or streaming APIs. * You have a background or strong interest in fintech, wealth management, or financial advisor workflows. **Our Values** * **Act Like an Owner \-** Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. * **Build Together \-** Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. * **Champion Our Clients \-** Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. * **Drive Innovation \-** Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. * **Embrace Learning \-** Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.

jobs.title: Data Product Engineer
jobs.description: The Opportunity Join Adobe as a Data Product Engineer on the Business Process Optimization team. This role operates much like a forward\-deployed engineer, embedded with Finance and CAO partners, translating real business needs into production\-grade data products, automation, and AI\-enabled solutions. What you'll do Develop and build reliable data products, automated pipelines, and reusable interfaces for internal business teams Take an end\-to\-end, full\-stack approach, extending beyond data pipelines into APIs, automation, and lightweight application development Build automation and intelligent solutions, including RPA workflows and AI/LLM\-powered tools Maintain engineering ownership jobs.description: Job Type **Full Time** Location **Naperville, IL** Department **Development** Reports to **Director of Development** **Position Summary** TOGA Technology is looking for a Full Stack Developer to help build and grow our platform of business applications. Producing code is no longer the hard part: knowing when AI generated code is subtly wrong, and having the discipline to verify rather than assume, is what separates a strong developer from a risky one. understanding of RESTful API design and integration * Knowledge of OAuth, JWT, and other authentication/authorization protocols * Experience working with and building automated job systems, such as workers, cron jobs, or cloud\-native schedulers * Familiarity with secure coding practices and basic performance tuning * Willingness to participate in code reviews and team discussions * Ability to jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first. We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast\-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together. The Artificial Intelligence \& Automation Engineer is a hands\-on technical contributor on the Data \& Technology Solutions team, responsible for designing, building, and deploying intelligent AI systems and automated workflows that drive operational efficiency and elevate the quality of care for our Medicare Advantage members. You will partner closely with AI Scientists, Data Engineers, Product Managers, Clinical Operations, and Application Engineering teams to translate complex business problems — from claims processing and prior authorization to member communication and revenue integrity — into scalable, production\-grade solutions. This role directly influences our ability to reduce administrative burden, accelerate payment accuracy, and create smarter, faster member experiences.**Job Duties / Responsibilities** * Build distributed, cloud\-native systems for enterprise workloads. Design and build services, APIs, and microservices that run reliably at scale in a regulated environment. Apply solid distributed systems fundamentals: fault tolerance, retries and idempotency, queuing and eventing, caching, and horizontal scaling. * Build hybrid infrastructure that bridges cloud and non\-cloud systems. Build integrations with non\-API data sources, including flat files, legacy databases, EDI feeds, mainframes, and streaming data, as well as multimodal data such as documents, images, and audio. Design for environments where not everything is cloud\-native or API\-first. * Build and operate CI/CD, containerization, and deployment pipelines. Containerize and deploy using Docker and Kubernetes. * Build CI/CD pipelines for reproducible, reliable releases, and apply infrastructure\-as\-code practices across the systems you own. * Build data and automation pipelines. Build ETL and orchestration pipelines using tools such as Airflow or Prefect. Automate high\-volume, repetitive processes using RPA platforms (e.g., UiPath, Power Automate), with proper error handling, fault tolerance, and alerting. * Apply AI/ML to production systems (applied, not research). Build and serve inferencing pipelines (batch, real\-time, streaming) for models handed off from AI Sciences, for workloads such as claims processing, risk adjustment, and member communication. Integrate LLMs into workflows using prompt engineering and RAG, and use agentic frameworks to automate multi\-step processes. This is applied integration and serving work, not model research or training. Support the Databricks platform used by AI Sciences. Help productionize models and pipelines built on Databricks, including Delta Lake, MLflow, and Unity Catalog. * Support CI/CD, orchestration, and access controls that let Databricks\-based work move into production. * Build with cost and reliability in mind. Treat cost per inference and infrastructure spend as engineering considerations, not an afterthought. Build monitoring, alerting, and drift detection to catch issues before they affect member outcomes. * Collaborate cross\-functionally. Partner with AI Scientists, Product Managers, clinical stakeholders, and business analysts to turn requirements into working systems. Contribute to code reviews and documentation, and provide informal mentorship to peers. **Supervisory Responsibilities** This is an individual contributor role with no direct supervisory responsibility. The engineer is expected to provide informal technical mentorship to peers and junior team members through code reviews, documentation, and collaborative problem\-solving. **Job Requirements** **Experience** *Required:* * 3–5 years of professional experience in software engineering with a demonstrated focus on AI/ML, data science, or intelligent process automation * Hands\-on experience building and deploying machine learning models in a production cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP) * Experience integrating systems with non\-API and multimodal data sources * Experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, insurance, or financial services) * Hands\-on experience applying AI/ML models or LLMs in a production system (integration/serving, not necessarily training) *Preferred:* * Experience integrating systems with non\-API and multimodal data sources * Experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, insurance, or financial services) * Some hands\-on experience applying AI/M  (AWS SageMaker, Azure AI, or Google Vertex AI); training or certification equivalent accepted *Preferred:* * Completion of formal certification or coursework in MLOps, cloud AI platforms, responsible AI, or agentic AI development * Certification in RPA platforms (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate) **Skills \& Competencies** **Technical / Role\-Specific Skills** * **AI/ML Engineering:** Proficiency in Python (primary), with strong command of ML frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit\-learn, and Hugging Face Transformers; experience with LLM\-based frameworks including RAG pipelines, vector databases, and agentic frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph * **Intelligent Process Automation:** Hands\-on experience with at least one RPA platform (UiPath, Power Automate, Automation Anywhere) and at least one orchestration tool (Apache Airflow, Prefect, or n8n); ability to analyze processes, identify automation opportunities, and estimate ROI * **Cloud AI Platforms:** Hands\-on experience with AWS SageMaker, Azure AI / Document Intelligence, Google Cloud Vertex AI, or Databricks; familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines for ML workflows * **Data Engineering \& MLOps:** Ability to build and maintain ETL and feature pipelines; proficiency with GitHub and model versioning tools (MLflow or equivalent); working knowledge of SQL for data transformation and workflow support * **Healthcare \& Regulatory Literacy:** Working knowledge of HIPAA compliance and data security requirements in regulated healthcare environments; familiarity with healthcare data standards including HL7 FHIR and ICD\-10/CPT as applied to AI/ML systems * **API Design \& System Integration:** Experience integrating AI models and automation services into enterprise applications via REST APIs and microservices; ability to collaborate with software engineering teams to ensure production\-grade reliability * **Responsible AI Principles:** Awareness of and commitment to ethical AI practices including bias detect **Essential Physical Functions:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 1\. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee regularly is required to stand, walk, sit, use hand to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; and reach with hands and arms. 2\. The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. Pay Range: $130,332\.00 \- $195,498\.00 Pay range may be based on a number of factors including market location, education, responsibilities, experience, etc. Alignment Health is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. * *DISCLAIMER: Please* *beware of recruitment phishing scams affecting Alignment Health and other employers where individuals receive fraudulent employment\-related offers in exchange for money or other sensitive personal* *information. Please* *be advised that Alignment Health and its subsidiaries will never ask you for a credit card, send you a check, or ask you for any type of payment as part of consideration for employment with our company. If you feel that you have been the victim of a scam such as this, please report the incident to the Federal Trade Commission at* *https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/\#/**.
