jobs.description: Overview: **Alro Steel** is currently seeking a **Machining Engineer** to join our team in **Charlotte, MI**. **Join the Alro team and start building your tomorrow!** Whether you are a recent graduate or an experienced professional, Alro offers rewarding and challenging career opportunities, as well as a competitive compensation and benefits package. We work hard to provide our teammates with comprehensive on\-the\-job training for a multitude of business disciplines, so that they can maximize their career expectations. Most importantly, employment at Alro is about being a part of something bigger. It’s about being on a team that employs the highest levels of loyalty, honesty and integrity. It’s about exceeding customer expectations on a daily basis by taking a true interest in their needs. An Alro career provides a dynamic work environment that allows our teammates to learn, grow and succeed in whatever they put their minds to, both personally and professionally. **Outstanding low cost 90/10 Healthcare benefits after 30 days of employment!****Medical/Dental/Vision/Prescription** Responsibilities: **Position Summary** We are seeking a detail\-oriented and motivated **Machining****Engineer** to provide technical and operational support for our machining departments. This position plays a critical role in ensuring CNC machining operations run efficiently by supporting tooling, machine setup, process documentation, troubleshooting, inventory management, and continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate is a team\-oriented individual who is organized, mechanically inclined, and enjoys working in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment while collaborating with machine operators, suppliers, vendors, maintenance, and production leadership. **Key Responsibilities** **Production Support** * Provide daily machining and mechanical support to CNC machining operations to ensure production goals are met. * Assist machinists with setup verification, tooling changes, and process improvements. * Coordinate machine readiness to minimize downtime and maximize productivity. * Support new product introductions and production launches. **Tooling \& Equipment** * Manage cutting tool inventory and ensure that tooling is available for scheduled production. * Assemble, preset, inspect, and maintain tooling as required. * Coordinate tooling repairs, replacements, and procurement. * Strong mechanical troubleshooting skills. **Process Support** * Maintain work instructions, setup sheets, tooling documentation, and process records. * Assist in developing and improving machining processes. * Monitor machining performance and identify opportunities for cycle time reduction and quality improvements. * Participate in root cause analysis and corrective action activities. **Quality \& Safety** * Support quality initiatives by verifying processes and assisting with inspection activities. * Ensure compliance with all safety policies and manufacturing standards. * Promote good housekeeping throughout the machining department. **Continuous Improvement** * Participate in continuous improvement projects. * Identify waste and recommend improvements to increase efficiency and reduce costs. * Support implementation of standardized work and best practices. Qualifications: **Required Qualifications** * High school diploma or GED required; associate degree or technical certification in machining, manufacturing technology, or a related field preferred. * 5\+ years of experience in a CNC machining or manufacturing environment. * Detailed understanding of CNC machining processes, cutting tools, and machine setups. * Ability to read engineering drawings and blueprints. * Familiarity with precision measuring instruments, including micrometers, calipers, and gauges. * Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills. * Excellent organizational and communication skills. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and manufacturing software systems. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with CNC mills, lathes, or multi\-axis machining centers. * Knowledge of GD\&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing). * Experience with ERP/MRP systems. * Forklift and overhead crane experience.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, AI Engineer Intelligence Layer
jobs.description: **Description** **About Alvarez \& Marsal** Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work\-guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity\-are why our people love working at A\&M. **The Team** The Senior AI Engineer helps build A\&M's Intelligence Layer, a knowledge graph based platform that makes the firm's structured and unstructured knowledge securely available through global and business unit specific search experiences. This hands\-on role works with the AI Engineering Lead and Architect, the Product Owner, internal engineering teams, and delivery partners. The team is small, the work is technically demanding, and priorities will move quickly, so this role requires sound judgment, adaptability, and a willingness to contribute wherever the build needs support. This is an opportunity to help build a state\-of\-the\-art AI architecture designed to serve an entire enterprise. Success requires technical curiosity, a forward\-looking perspective, and the ability to turn emerging approaches into reliable production capabilities on an ambitious timeline. The Senior AI Engineer will work alongside the implementation partner throughout the initial production build, contribute directly to the architecture, knowledge graph design, ingestion pipelines, retrieval services, and user\-facing capabilities, and develop deep working knowledge of the platform. From the outset, this person will help establish internal ownership and assume increasing responsibility for future iterations as the partner engagement concludes. **How you will contribute** * Build and maintain components of the Intelligence Layer, including ingestion pipelines, knowledge graph models, retrieval services, APIs, and user\-facing capabilities. * Develop and optimize graph schemas and queries using Neo4j and Cypher or comparable graph technologies. * Contribute across the stack, with particular strength in back\-end and Python development and the ability to support modern front\-end development when needed. * Integrate structured data and unstructured content from enterprise systems while preserving source permissions, metadata, and governance requirements. * Build integrations with large language model platforms and apply the Model Context Protocol to make Intelligence Layer capabilities available to approved AI tools. * Build, test, and operate production agentic pipelines, including multi\-step orchestration, tool routing, MCP\-based tool use, retrieval, state management, evaluation, guardrails, observability, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Work with the Lead and Architect and delivery partners on implementation, testing, debugging, code review, and technical documentation. * Develop secure, maintainable software that meets A\&M's requirements for client confidentiality, access control, reliability, and observability. * Communicate risks and blockers early and help the team make practical technical decisions as priorities evolve. **First Year Outcomes** * Help deliver the initial production iteration of the Intelligence Layer knowledge graphs. * Help deliver reusable agentic pipeline components that support secure, governed workflows across business units and use cases. * Enable global search and business unit specific search across approved structured and unstructured data sources. * Deliver tested ingestion, graph, retrieval, API, and user\-interface components that internal teams can operate and extend. * Establish reusable engineering patterns and documentation that support additional business units and data sources. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * Five or more years of software engineering experience building production applications or data platforms. * Hands\-on experience with knowledge graphs, graph data modeling, and graph query languages, ideally Neo4j and Cypher. * Full\-stack development experience, with strong Python and back\-end skills plus working experience with a modern front\-end framework. * Experience designing, building, and consuming APIs and integrating multiple structured and unstructured data sources. * Practical experience with Claude, ChatGPT, or comparable large language model platforms. * Hands\-on experience building production agentic pipelines or workflows, including orchestration, tool use, retrieval, state management, evaluation, guardrails, observability, or human oversight. * Working knowledge of the Model Context Protocol, including how MCP servers expose tools and data to AI clients. * Experience working directly with third\-party delivery vendors on implementation, technical review, issue resolution, and delivery coordination. * Strong problem\-solving, communication, and documentation skills. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience building MCP servers, agent tools, or custom AI integrations. * Experience with Microsoft Azure services for application hosting, data, search, identity, or AI. * Experience implementing enterprise authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, token scoping, or on\-behalf\-of flows. **Your journey at A\&M** We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person's unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals. Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez \& Marsal Holdings' fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD\&D, and disability coverages at rates determined periodically as well as a 401(k) retirement savings plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive an annual discretionary contribution to their 401(k) retirement savings plan from Alvarez \& Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy\-two (72\) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click here for more information regarding A\&M's benefits programs. The salary range is $190,000 \- $210,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A\&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details. \#LI\-LH1

jobs.title: Associate Solutions Architect, AGI-Tech, Early Career - 2027
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Shape what comes next \| Discover careers in Tech At Amazon, our tech isn't just a tool, it's your playground. Our engineers work on scalable systems, cloud services, and customer\-facing products that operate at global scale. This is an environment where you learn by building. Whether you're creating cloud\-native solutions, optimizing machine learning models, or building products that drive experiences for millions of customers around the globe, your work reaches the world, fast. You'll take ownership early, collaborate across teams and disciplines, and grow your skills as you tackle new problems. There's no single path forward here, with a chance to explore different directions and shape your journey as you go. This is where ambition meets opportunity and, where the impact of what you build helps define what comes next, for customers and for you. Do you want to help us build new things and evangelize use of AWS with customers? As an Associate Solutions Architect you will partner across AWS to help customers craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that address customer business problems. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand best practices around cloud\-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help customers use AWS within their organizations ranging from new start\-ups to large enterprise customers. This position is part of an accelerated career development program for those who want to advance both their technical and business skills. This is a unique opportunity for driven, self\-starters to play a key role in a fast\-growing business, and to deliver significant value to AWS customers of all sizes from nimble startups to global brands. The program will provide you with training and work experience that aligns in the field of technical training. This unique program consists of mentoring by subject matter experts, project\-based learning curriculum and experiential learning assignments. If this sounds exciting to you \- come build the future with us! Program Overview: This is a structured, cohort\-based accelerated development program designed for early career Solutions Architects. You'll join a cohort of peers at one of our hub locations in Arlington VA, Austin TX, or Seattle WA, building a professional network from Day 1\. You'll be embedded in a supportive team with a dedicated mentor, an onboarding buddy, and a manager who guides your technical and professional growth. You'll follow a structured learning journey that develops deep expertise in cloud architecture, AI/ML, and customer\-facing solution design. Within weeks, you'll begin working directly with AWS customers — from startups to large enterprises — helping them architect cloud solutions that solve real business problems. Start Date Details: This is a cohort\-based program where everyone is required to start on the same day. Start dates are tentatively set to occur January 25, 2027\. Key job responsibilities * Create solutions that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services * Interface with customer stakeholders, including developers and team leads * Drive effective feedback gathering from customers, distill and translate feedback into clear business and technical requirements for product and engineering teams A day in the life No two days look exactly the same, and that's what makes this role exciting. Your morning might start with a team stand\-up where you share wins and learning moments with your cohort and mentor, followed by a hands\-on lab building a serverless architecture or working with an AI model on Amazon Bedrock. By midday, you could be on a customer call helping a CTO plan a cloud migration — whiteboarding an architecture, recommending services, and walking them through a proof\-of\-concept, with your mentor there to support you. In the afternoon, you might attend a technical session led by a senior SA on emerging technology, then spend time working toward your next AWS certification. Later, you'll collaborate with your cohort on a group project — building a customer\-facing demo, writing a technical blog post, or preparing for your next development milestone. You'll also have opportunities to participate in leadership development programming and community events that go beyond your core technical work. About the team We are intentional about building pathways for early career talent, creating opportunities for people who bring fresh perspectives to cloud technology. This isn't a "sink or swim" program — you'll have a dedicated mentor who coaches you throughout the program, an onboarding buddy to help you navigate Amazon culture, and a manager focused on your development. You'll join a tight\-knit cohort culture with regular team activities, peer learning, and social events — our hubs offer collaborative workspaces where you're surrounded by peers and leaders who want to see you succeed. You'll work across industries, customer sizes, and technology domains, giving you a breadth of experience that accelerates your career faster than a traditional single\-team placement. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields * Experience with one of the following programming languages: Python, Ruby, Node.js, C\#, or C\+\+ * Experience with AI/ML technologies * Experience with one or more of the following domains: analytics, security, storage, DevOps, application development, or machine learning * Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior leadership * Must be 18 or older **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * AWS or other cloud certification * Experience applying established frameworks and design patterns to deliver working software (can include coursework, personal projects, hackathons, or previous internships) Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The starting pay for this position is listed below. Starting Day 1 of employment, Amazon offers EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, 401(k) matching. Learn more about our benefits at https://hiring.amazon.com/why\-amazon/benefits. Seattle, WA, USA \- 121,500\.00 USD Annually

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Agentic WorkSpaces Client
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers' businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use. The mission of Agentic WorkSpaces is to enable AI agents to work the way people do. Across the industry, agents are becoming digital workers. Like every team member, they need identity, permissions, governance, and a trusted place to do their work. The Agentic WorkSpaces Client team builds the front door to that place: the client software people use to securely access and operate the desktop and web applications their businesses rely on, and the software AI agents will use to do the same. We build the client software that runs on customer endpoints across major operating systems and browsers, and we own critical parts of the connection and user experience for Amazon WorkSpaces, a highly scaled system that delivers remote desktops and streamed applications to millions of end users every day. We are evolving that same client experience to carry agentic workloads, which require secure access, enterprise permissions, governance, observability, and human oversight. Learn more: https://aws.amazon.com/workspaces/ We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to design, build, and operate customer\-facing capabilities across native and web clients, advancing the client that enterprise agents will work through while supporting a system that millions of people depend on today. Industry consensus points to a growing share of cloud desktop workloads becoming agentic in the coming years. We build the client software those desktops are reached through, which is exactly why the Agentic WorkSpaces Client team can lead that shift. Today, most of the team's work is building and running the clients our users rely on; the agentic share of the roadmap grows from there. Your work includes secure session connectivity, client lifecycle, cross\-platform architecture, user experience, performance, software updates, operational telemetry, and integrations supporting human and agentic workflows. You will own features from design through production, collaborate with teams across AWS, solve complex issues in customer\-managed environments, and maintain a high bar for security, reliability, and operational excellence. Agentic WorkSpaces offers a combination most roles don't: the early build\-out of agent infrastructure on the scale of a mature AWS service. You will not be starting from a blank page, and you will not be maintaining a system in stasis. You will shape the evolution of Amazon WorkSpaces by extending a proven system rather than rewriting it. The problems span operating systems, web technologies, networking, security, and distributed services, and your work will directly influence how people and AI agents securely interact with enterprise applications. We are passionate about our customers and love to solve their most critical problems. If you enjoy hard problems that span the client and the cloud, and want to work with a talented, inclusive team that prides itself on a great work environment, join us. About the team ABOUT AWS: Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * 1\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience * 1\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience * 1\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field * Experience programming with at least one software programming language **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent * Experience leading large, fast\-moving projects * Experience handling ambiguous or undefined challenges through strong problem solving abilities * Experience architecting, securing, and operating Amazon Web Services and client software Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Agentic WorkSpaces Client
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers' businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use. The mission of Agentic WorkSpaces is to enable AI agents to work the way people do. Across the industry, agents are becoming digital workers. Like every team member, they need identity, permissions, governance, and a trusted place to do their work. The Agentic WorkSpaces Client team builds the front door to that place: the client software people use to securely access and operate the desktop and web applications their businesses rely on, and the software AI agents will use to do the same. We build the client software that runs on customer endpoints across major operating systems and browsers, and we own critical parts of the connection and user experience for Amazon WorkSpaces, a highly scaled system that delivers remote desktops and streamed applications to millions of end users every day. We are evolving that same client experience to carry agentic workloads, which require secure access, enterprise permissions, governance, observability, and human oversight. Learn more: https://aws.amazon.com/workspaces/ We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to design, build, and operate customer\-facing capabilities across native and web clients, advancing the client that enterprise agents will work through while supporting a system that millions of people depend on today. Industry consensus points to a growing share of cloud desktop workloads becoming agentic in the coming years. We build the client software those desktops are reached through, which is exactly why the Agentic WorkSpaces Client team can lead that shift. Today, most of the team's work is building and running the clients our users rely on; the agentic share of the roadmap grows from there. Your work includes secure session connectivity, client lifecycle, cross\-platform architecture, user experience, performance, software updates, operational telemetry, and integrations supporting human and agentic workflows. You will own features from design through production, collaborate with teams across AWS, solve complex issues in customer\-managed environments, and maintain a high bar for security, reliability, and operational excellence. Agentic WorkSpaces offers a combination most roles don't: the early build\-out of agent infrastructure on the scale of a mature AWS service. You will not be starting from a blank page, and you will not be maintaining a system in stasis. You will shape the evolution of Amazon WorkSpaces by extending a proven system rather than rewriting it. The problems span operating systems, web technologies, networking, security, and distributed services, and your work will directly influence how people and AI agents securely interact with enterprise applications. We are passionate about our customers and love to solve their most critical problems. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Lightsail makes AWS accessible to developers and business customers who want to get their cloud stacks running in seconds without the complexity of traditional infrastructure. As a Software Development Engineer II on the Lightsail team, you will build features and services that simplify compute, storage, networking, and website hosting for customers who need things to just work. The team is expanding quickly, adding new capabilities like website hosting and agent hosting, and you will help shape what comes next. You will work across the full software development lifecycle, from understanding customer problems through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. If you are an engineer who enjoys building products you would actually use yourself, and you want to do that at AWS scale, we would like to talk to you. Key job responsibilities * Design and build features for Amazon Lightsail's distributed systems, working in Java, Go, JavaScript, and React across both backend services and frontend experiences. * Collaborate with partner teams across AWS — including Amazon EC2, Amazon Route 53, Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3\), Amazon DynamoDB, and Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) — to integrate Lightsail capabilities with the broader AWS ecosystem. * Own the operational health of the services you build by identifying root causes of production issues and driving permanent fixes, ensuring customers experience reliable performance. * Participate actively in design reviews and code reviews, providing constructive feedback to teammates and mentoring other engineers on writing clean, maintainable code. * Evaluate new technologies and approaches, including generative artificial intelligence tools, to improve team productivity and the quality of solutions delivered to customers. A day in the life You start your morning checking operational dashboards for a Lightsail service you recently launched, then join a design review where you and a teammate work through how to integrate a new hosting capability with an existing AWS service. After lunch, you pick up a feature task, writing backend logic in Java and wiring up the React console so customers can try it out. Later, you review a pull request from a teammate, leave detailed feedback, and update documentation so the next engineer who touches this code can ramp up quickly. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Java Runtime
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The Java Runtimes Team (JRT) owns and advances the Java runtime that powers a large share of Amazon's production services. We work at the intersection of language runtimes, compilers, and hardware — tuning the JVM and its ecosystem so that thousands of services run faster, use less memory, and scale more efficiently across x86 and Graviton (AArch64\) fleets. We contribute directly to OpenJDK and our Corretto JDK, and we build the tooling that turns deep runtime expertise into automated, fleet\-wide performance gains. We are hiring a Runtime Engineer to work across three closely\-linked areas: the JIT compiler, garbage collection, and systems\-level software optimization. You will profile real production workloads, identify runtime bottlenecks, prototype and land improvements in the JVM, and help encode that expertise into tools that scale beyond one\-to\-one consultation. Key job responsibilities 1\. Analyze production JVM workloads to identify compiler, GC, and runtime bottlenecks, and translate findings into concrete optimizations. 2\. Design, implement, and benchmark improvements to JIT compilation, garbage collection, and core runtime subsystems. 3\. Contribute changes upstream to OpenJDK and to Amazon Corretto, working through code review and community processes. 4\. Tune runtime behavior for performance and efficiency across x86 and Graviton (AArch64\) architectures. 5\. Build and improve profiling, observability, and auto\-tuning tooling so runtime expertise scales across the fleet rather than through manual, per\-service consultation. 6\. Validate performance and reliability of changes against real workloads before broad rollout. 7\. Partner with service teams to drive adoption of runtime improvements and newer JDK versions. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 5\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience * 5\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 5\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent * Knowledge of ARM CPUs * Experience contributing to OpenJDK, the HotSpot JVM, or another production language runtime. * Depth in one or more GC algorithms (G1, ZGC, Shenandoah, or generational collectors) and their performance trade\-offs. * Compiler backend or optimization experience (instruction selection, code generation, escape analysis, inlining, or similar). * A track record of upstream open\-source contributions or published performance work. jobs.title: DCEO Technician 3 , ATL Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO)
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- How would you like to be a part of Earth’s most customer\-centric company? You would work with teams of front\-line responders who support the operations of some of the world’s most Customer Centric data centers. Our Data Center Engineering Operations team maintain and operate our critical infrastructure systems so that they are prepared to stand up against any situation. AWS has the world’s largest cloud computing portfolio. As an Amazonian you will work in some of the most sophisticated, safe, and secure data centers in the world. Our Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT’s) help keep them that way by working with the brightest minds from around the globe to help test and implement the newest technology and work practices to meet the demands of a changing market. We have a passion for learning and evolving, it’s how we have helped define ourselves as leaders in the industry. Let’s work hard, have fun, and make history! AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Key job responsibilities * Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability * Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS) * Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack\-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA) * Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA * Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment * Technical writing to support change management program * Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion * On\-site support of contractors, sub\-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures \& local legislation * Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12\-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule including night shift. Some locations have on\-call rotations. * Role may support more than one location/site. Physical Requirements: Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations: * Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently * Participate in group lifts for 40\+ pounds * Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder * Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position * Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection A day in the life This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands\-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission\-critical data center facility equipment including stand\-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * High school or equivalent diploma * Work a flexible work schedule including evenings, overnights, and weekends * 1\+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1\+ years of mechanical facilities **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 2\+ years of data center engineering experience * Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings * 2\+ years of data center engineering experience * Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Your work will directly influence the availability and efficiency of the physical backbone that supports millions of customers worldwide. In this role, you will tackle complex, ambiguous problems across global projects, driving solutions that are inventive, scalable, and maintainable. You will collaborate with cross\-functional engineering teams, influence facility strategy, and set standards for engineering excellence. Whether you are leading the design of new infrastructure systems or resolving root causes of endemic issues, your contributions will have a meaningful, long\-term impact on how Amazon builds and operates its data centers. Key job responsibilities * Support the Data Center Design Engineering, Principal Engineering, and Hardware Engineering teams to design and develop innovative concepts into new mechanical cooling products (AHUs, chiller, pump skids, ADACs) used in AWS data centers. * Lead the electrical aspect of new product design and development for mechanical cooling equipment, including motor controls, VFDs, power distribution panels, control wiring, and instrumentation integration. * Collaborate with other disciplines such as mechanical engineering, structural engineering, controls/automation, reliability, QA/QC, and compliance to create well\-thought\-out products. * Design and specify electrical systems for rotating equipment including fans, pumps, and compressors, ensuring proper motor sizing, protection, and control schemes. * Create designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements while delivering a return on investment. * Work with global suppliers and manufacturers to specify appropriate electrical components, devices, and bill of materials for AHUs, skids, and ADACs. * Ensure compliance with federal, state, and municipal requirements and building codes across different countries, including UL, CE, IEC, NEC/NFPA 70, and other applicable standards for mechanical cooling equipment. * Prepare, review, and approve product design and drawings including electrical schematics, single\-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, cable schedules, and bill of materials. * Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during manufacturing phases. * Work with field engineering and commissioning teams to properly set up test processes and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems within mechanical cooling products. * Develop and review control logic, interlocks, and safety circuits for AHU, skid, chillers and ADAC assemblies in coordination with controls engineers. * Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions. * Support of Operations including failure mode and root cause analysis, maintenance and troubleshooting support, and operating procedure review for electrical systems in cooling equipment. * Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center. * Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 25% of the year. A day in the life You might start your morning reviewing design documents for a new infrastructure deployment, providing feedback that strengthens the overall architecture. By midday, you could be leading a cross\-team project review, aligning engineers across regions on a shared technical approach. In the afternoon, you may dive into root\-cause analysis of a recurring facility issue, proposing a mechanism to prevent future occurrences. Throughout it all, you will coach teammates, share expertise, and help shape the direction of critical infrastructure at Amazon. About the team Our team is focused on ensuring that Amazon's data center infrastructure is reliable, efficient, and ready to meet the demands of tomorrow. We work at the intersection of electrical engineering, mechanical systems, and operational technology to design and maintain the physical environments that support Amazon's global services. We value collaboration, creative problem\-solving, and a commitment to continuous improvement. If you are excited about working on large\-scale infrastructure challenges alongside a talented group of engineers, we would love to hear from you.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field * 6\+ years of data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance experience * Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities * Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities * Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Professional Engineering or Architectural License * Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production * Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents * Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The Workplace Health and Safety Technical Solutions Team seeks an accomplished Senior Process Safety Engineer to lead global initiatives in Process Safety Management (PSM) and Process Safety Engineering. You will play a key role in designing, constructing, and operating projects involving alternative energy sources and HHC, strictly adhering to Recognized and Generally Accepted Good Engineering Practices (RAGAGEP). This position demands deep expertise in Center for Chemical Process Safety (CCPS) Risk\-Based Process Safety (RBPS) principles, coupled with comprehensive knowledge of regulatory compliance standards, including OSHA PSM and EPA RMP (North America), the Seveso Directive (Europe), and emerging regulations in the Asia\-Pacific region. As a strategic partner to technical, operational, and leadership teams, you will drive improvements in global process safety performance while fostering a robust safety culture throughout the organization. This role also involves shaping the engineering vision and strategy to ensure consistency in managing process safety risks across Worldwide (WW) Operations, focusing strongly on hydrogen fuel usage, emerging green alternative energy sources and its associated safety considerations. You will collaborate with diverse teams to implement a systematic, scalable approach to risk identification, mitigation, and management. Key job responsibilities * Risk Management and Hazard Analysis: Lead or facilitate comprehensive PHAs such as HAZOP, LOPA, and FMEA across global operations. Oversee the development of risk mitigation strategies and ensure the timely execution of corrective measures. * Risk Evaluation and Collaboration: Evaluate process safety risks, recommend effective controls, and coordinate the development of comprehensive process safety information. * Regulatory Compliance and RAGAGEP Integration: Ensure compliance with global safety regulations, including OSHA PSM, EPA RMP, Seveso Directive, and equivalent standards, while applying Recognized and Generally Accepted Good Engineering Practices (RAGAGEP) across HHC sites globally. * Governance and Framework Development: Develop and maintain a robust RBPS governance framework, including tools and processes that foster standardization and continuous improvement. * Alternative Energy Process Safety: Serve as a subject matter expert in alternative energy technologies, including hydrogen, biofuels, carbon capture, and thermal systems. Drive the safe design, commissioning, and operation of these systems in collaboration with external partners and internal teams. * Global Process Safety Management (PSM) Oversight: Spearhead the design, implementation, and continuous enhancement of global PSM systems, ensuring consistency with CCPS RBPS pillars, local regulations, corporate standards, and industry best practices. * Performance Monitoring and Reporting: Define, track, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) aligned with CCPS guidance and corporate objectives. Deliver regular updates to senior leadership, highlighting progress, risks, and strategic recommendations. * Tool Development for Compliance: Create and implement tools to ensure compliance with OSHA PSM requirements, including conducting PHAs for hazard identification, analysis, and prioritization. * Training and Mentorship: Develop and deliver training programs on process safety topics, fostering a culture of continuous learning. Establish and report process safety metrics and share best practices across the organization. * Leadership and Organizational Development: Provide technical mentorship to regional and site teams to build process safety expertise throughout the organization. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, Procurement) to embed safety in every phase of the asset lifecycle. * Incident Investigation and Audit Leadership: Lead or actively participate in incident investigations, risk assessments, and EHS self\-assessments or audits to identify root causes and implement corrective actions. * Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Support: Support WHS programs and systems across the organization, including readiness to respond to emergencies when required. Is an advanced level contributor providing input to and executing complex assignments and projects while regularly providing mentoring and coaching direction to more junior professionals. Operates as a key resource across multiple markets, technologies and regions and contributions are applicable across existing and new to market or new to Amcor technologies. Works autonomously, requiring “expert” level technical support from others occasionally. Contributes to influencing decisions, semi\-regularly outside of core area. Technical/product support across multiple products and/or processes – regularly includes key customers and/or initiatives. **WHAT YOU GET TO DO** * Leverage understanding of customer needs, their perceptions of their business in the market, and their values to rapidly drive results and relationships. Be valued by the customer in having a “seat at their table” in discussions with key developments. * Leverage market and business intelligence to identify trends, emergent technologies in order to influence the business * Partner on developing business cases for new market spaces or technologies in alignment with direction of Amcor * Leverage how existing assets are utilized in order to break into new markets * Lead programs in stage gate to support start\-ups and launches. * Chair technical reviews for the most significant and/or complex programs. Ensure technical rigor within stage gate process * Independently plan, execute and analyze production trials with Design of Experiment, Lean, and statistical analysis * Contribute to Amcor Intellectual property and protect IP through information management * Leverage understanding of business processes across functions to continuously improve performance. * Act as technical mentor within and across functions in order to advance Amcor technical acumen * Contribute technical skills and aptitude for problem solving toward regional and global challenges * Ensure proper documentation of work and contribute to knowledge beyond the organization, such as an external presentation. * Integrate and communicate complex information beyond core team/function * Enhance the knowledge and skills of the organization. * Support a culture of continuous curiosity and learning with business impact. * Scope and initiate vendor programs, including new raw material research. * Use advanced knowledge of materials and processes to influence design solutions across the organization. * Collaborate with areas such as Engineering, Operations and Quality to resolve technical challenges, supporting sustained solution ownership. This may include inputs on machine installations and improvements and participating in new capital project teams. * Define material science capabilities required in the future and resources needed to execute projects in alignment. **WHAT WE VALUE** * Leading cross\-functional teams and helping to develop technical talent, this role is to demonstrates the behaviors outlined in Amcor’s Leadership Framework: Drives Vision and Purpose, Strategic Mindset, Sets Priorities and Drives Results, Customer Focus, Cultivates Innovation, Attracts and Develops Talent, Engages People and Teams * R\&D Capability Anchors Levelling: + Business Acumen: Advanced + Customer Impact: Advanced + Technical Expertise: Proficient + Risk Management: Proficient + Value Creation: Proficient + Innovation: Advanced **WHAT WE WANT FROM YOU** * Undergraduate degree required. (Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Science or other related area preferred.) PhD or a Graduate degree is strongly preferred * 15\+ years of experience with demonstrated, progressive success in a technical capacity within a global manufacturing environment * Demonstrated ability to leverage design choices positively impacting market position with a longer term view considering multiple perspectives * Demonstration of implementing platform solutions in a collaborative, structured way with appropriate tools and methodologies * Expertise in multiple technologies/processes leveraged to deliver value to the organization and business relationships * Experience with key/national account customer relationship management – from a technical perspective as well as demonstrated ability to scale\-up with a customer’s growth * Demonstration of conceptual thinking to understand complex issued, apply judgment and proceed an agenda proactively * .Strong multi\-cultural capabilities **Our Expectations** ==================== We expect our people to be guided by The Amcor Way and demonstrate our Values every day to enable the business to win. We are winning when: * Our people are engaged and developing as part of a high\-performing Amcor team * Our customers grow and prosper from Amcor’s quality, service, and innovation * Our investors benefit from Amcor’s consistent growth and superior returns * The environment is better off because of Amcor’s leadership and products **Equal Opportunity** **Employer/Minorities/Females/Disabled/Veterans/Sexual** **Orientation/Gender Identity** ============================================================================================================== Amcor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you would like more information about your EEO rights as an applicant under the law, please click on the *"Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal" Poster*. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please call 224\-313\-7000 and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. **E\-Verify** ============= We verify the identity and employment authorization of individuals hired for employment in the United States. **Benefits** ============ When you join Amcor, you will have access to a comprehensive benefits and compensation package that includes: * Medical, dental and vision plans * Flexible time off, starting at 80 hours paid time per year for full\-time salaried employees * Company\-paid holidays starting at 8 days per year and may vary by location * Wellbeing program \& Employee Assistance Program * Health Savings Account/Flexible Spending Account * Life insurance, AD\&D, short\-term \& long\-term disability, and voluntary benefits * Paid Parental Leave * Retirement Savings Plan with company match * Tuition Reimbursement (dependent upon approval) * Discretionary annual bonus program (initial eligibility dependent upon hire date)

jobs.title: Vice President - Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Our Company** We’re a diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. Our team of 22,000 people across 19 countries, serves more than 3\.5 million individual, small business and institutional clients. We are a longstanding leader in financial planning and advice, a global asset manager and an insurer. Our unwavering focus on our clients and strong financial foundation connects each of our unique businesses – Ameriprise Financial, Columbia Threadneedle Investments and RiverSource Insurance and Annuities. Here, we foster meaningful careers, invest in the future, and make a difference for clients, institutions and communities around the world. **Job Description** The VP\-Forward Deployed Engineer operates at the intersection of investment strategy, quantitative analysis and applied artificial intelligence. The position is responsible for partnering closely with portfolio management and investment research teams to identify opportunities, design solutions, and develop, prototype, and deploy LLM\-enabled tools that enhance investment decision\-making and research processes. practices (CI/CD, version control, API design). * Fluency in at least one asset class (equities, fixed income, multi\-asset, or macro) at a level where you can challenge and contribute to investment discussions, not just support them. * Track record of delivering secure, auditable AI solutions in a regulated environment, partnering with risk and compliance. **Preferred Qualifications** * Direct jobs.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Access Programs
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ As Claude's capabilities grow, so does our responsibility to ensure those capabilities reach the right people. The Access Programs team builds the systems that verify who our customers are, grant access to advanced model capabilities for approved use cases, and ensure that access is not misused. As a software engineer on this team, you will build the identity, vetting, and access management infrastructure that underpins our trusted access programs, along with the monitoring and enforcement tooling that keeps them safe. This work sits at the center of how Anthropic deploys frontier capabilities responsibly, balancing broad access with rigorous safeguards. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * Build identity verification and vetting systems (KYC/KYB) that establish who our individual and business customers are * Design and implement access control systems that grant, scope, and revoke access to advanced capabilities based on approved use cases * Build infrastructure to configure safety systems and detection thresholds on a per\-customer basis for trusted access programs * Develop monitoring to detect misuse of expanded access, and tooling that enables enforcement teams to act on it * Partner closely with policy, enforcement, threat intelligence, product, research, and go\-to\-market teams so that access decisions are well\-informed and consistently applied * Build systems that identify account compromise and takeover, apply mitigations in real time, and carry affected accounts through to full remediation * Design and build the dashboards, alerting, and internal admin tooling that give the team and its partners clear visibility into the health and outcomes of our access programs * Integrate with third\-party identity verification and data enrichment vendors **You may be a good fit if you have:** -------------------------------------- * A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or comparable experience * Experience building and operating backend systems in production * Strong coding skills in at least one general\-purpose programming language, and experience building software with AI coding tools * Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders * Care about the societal impacts of AI and want your work to make powerful systems safer **Strong candidates may also:** ------------------------------- * 8\+ years of industry software engineering experience * Experience building shared platforms or foundational services that many teams and products depend on, rather than one\-off solutions for a single use case * A track record of working across functions (for example engineering, product, policy, operations, and go\-to\-market) to gather requirements, reconcile competing needs, and drive adoption of what you build * Experience with identity, authentication, or authorization systems at scale * Experience with KYC/KYB workflows or identity verification vendors * Experience in trust and safety, integrity, fraud, or abuse detection * Experience detecting and responding to account takeover or credential compromise * Experience partnering with operational teams to build custom internal tooling The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 \- $485,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Business Center, AutoCAD Civil 3D, and other geospatial software platforms. * Support aerial mapping, photogrammetry, LiDAR, and UAV data acquisition and processing efforts. * Prepare project scopes, reasonable timeframe. * Bachelor's or Associate's degree in Surveying, Geomatics, Civil Engineering Technology, or a related field preferred. * 8\+ years of progressive survey experience, including project management and supervision of survey personnel. * Strong knowledge of boundary law, deed interpretation, easements, ALTA/NSPS standards, and land development surveys. * Demonstrated experience managing topographic, boundary, construction, utility, transportation, and geospatial mapping projects. * Proficiency with Carlson Survey, AutoCAD Civil 3D, Trimble Business Center, Trimble GNSS equipment, and conventional survey instrumentation. * Familiarity with UAV mapping, photogrammetry, LiDAR, and geospatial data collection technologies is preferred. * Excellent communication skills jobs.title: Analog Mixed-Signal Design Software Engineer
jobs.description: Apple Silicon Engineering is seeking Hardware\-minded Software engineers to create innovative tools to design the next generation of Apple’s world\-leading systems\-on\-chip (SOCs). Apple’s multi\-billion\-transistor Ax SOCs are the brain of every iPhone and iPad. The Analog Mixed\-Signal circuits connect them to the physical world via complex IPs such as SERDES for data communication, PLLs for clock generation, and sensors for measuring physical quantities. Modeling Software Engineers bring a unique and versatile combination of software and hardware expertise. On their way from the designer's mind to becoming a piece of silicon, circuits take form in software. Modeling Software Engineers develop those software\-representations of future hardware and then make them real. This includes both the circuits themselves, and the underlying tools to enable hundreds more designers. We use modern software design methodology and apply it to Hardware design. **Description** This role develops specialized software tools and simulation platforms that enable the design of analog mixed\-signal circuits for Apple's custom silicon chips. You'll combine software engineering expertise with hardware knowledge to build automation frameworks, optimization algorithms, and modeling environments that help circuit designers create the physical interfaces connecting Apple's processors to the real world. The position requires strong programming skills in Python or C\+\+ and involves working on challenging problems at the intersection of software development and hardware design.","responsibilities":"Architect and maintain tools, frameworks, and simulation environments within the platform to support analog design workflows Design and manage the platform's data storage and compute architecture \- including schemas, data models, and access layers \- to support analog/mixed\-signal design data and agentic AI orchestration at scale Own and extend the platform's agent trust surface \- the registry that versions, rolls back, and audits automated agents, plus the human\-in\-the\-loop review workflow that gates what they commit Develop web\-based interfaces and visualization tools within the platform to improve designer productivity and workflow transparency Partner with analog/mixed\-signal design teams to gather requirements and triage issues, feeding them into platform feature development and pipeline behavior discussions Support platform deployment and rollout across design teams, and contribute to adoption efforts through onboarding, documentation, and training **Preferred Qualifications** Expert\-level proficiency in Python and/or C\+\+ Strong background in object\-oriented programming (OOP) and software architecture design Experience with data storage systems, schema design, and database architecture Knowledge of event\-driven programming and system\-level simulation frameworks Experience developing web applications (e.g., Flask, React) and designing frontend user interfaces Experience with CI/CD pipelines, packaging, and deployment (e.g docker/cloud) Strong communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering with design engineers to gather requirements and drive adoption **Minimum Qualifications** Bachelors of Science in Electrical Engineering or equivalent. **Pay \& Benefits** At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $129,300 and $225,300, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.title: Analog/Mixed-Signal IP Engineering Program Manager
jobs.description: Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new insights have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Dynamic, intelligent people and inspiring, innovative technologies, are the norm here. The people who work here have reinvented entire industries with all Apple Hardware products. The same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices strengthening our dedication to leave the world better than we found it. Join us to help deliver the next groundbreaking Apple product! Are you a hard\-working and proactive design engineering lead with a curiosity about leadership and a thirst for knowledge? We are absolutely seeking you out! **Description** Apple is seeking a high\-energy, results\-driven engineering professional with exceptional leadership ability to join our Silicon Engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring that Analog and Mixed\-Signal (AMS) IPs for Apple's custom SoCs meet the highest standards of technical excellence, quality, and schedule execution. You will collaborate with world\-class engineers across disciplines \- from concept to mass production \- on the most advanced IP in cutting\-edge technology nodes, spanning Apple's consumer devices and large\-scale data center infrastructure. This is a rare opportunity to shape the silicon that powers Apple's most iconic products and the data centers that support them at global scale.","responsibilities":"Drive the development of state\-of\-the\-art Analog/Mixed\-Signal IPs from early concept to mass production. Partner closely with AMS IP design and SoC Integration teams to drive high\-impact development milestones \- owning issue resolution, bug tracking, and IP consumer syncs to proactively address technical challenges across consumer silicon and data center platforms.
