jobs.title: Venture Associate
jobs.description: *Washington, DC, United States* *Venture Team reporting to Venture Principal* *This is an on\-site role* **The next generation of American industry is being built by engineers, scientists, and operators who left the lab, the prime, or the program to start something.** Your job is to find them first. As a Venture Associate at Capital Factory, you bring the technical credibility these founders want on their cap table. You’ll meet new founders everyday, determine the true breakthrough ventures and recruit the real ones into CF’s All Access Fund. **What you will do…** * Meet the best technology entrepreneurs and recruit them into CF’s All Access Fund. * Participate in startup community events \& programs as a speaker. * Use Twitter, LinkedIn, and other digital platforms to discover new startups and connect with the founders. * Develop relationships with CEOs, Angel Investors, and Venture Capitalists and connect them with startups that matter. * Read all of the local startup news and engage in social media. * Use a suite of AI tools provided by Capital Factory to manage deal flow, publish deal memos and perform at a high level. * Get ten years of venture capital experience in three years time! **Requirements** **You'll know you're successful if....** * You sponsor 25\+ DC startups who are accepted into Capital Factory’s All Access Fund each year. * You can convince a startup to join Capital Factory based on the benefits of being part of our community and not just because they need money. * People think “you’re everywhere” because you are a speaker on a local or online panel or event every week and they are always seeing you at relevant community events and around Capital Factory. * Founders, mentors and investors come to you to ask for introductions. * Every slot gets booked up at your office hours. * Your leads are accurately and promptly tracked in our CRM. **About you…** * You are an expert in the making. Regardless of whether you launched an award winning initiative, lead a team in the military, have patents under your belt, or launched hardware off\-world, you are an expert in the making in an area of technology which is changing the world. * You are a builder. You’ve built a community, product, team, program, startup or initiative and know the value and hard work of building something impactful * You have at least two years experience as a founder, employee, or investor at a tech startup. * You love founders and startups, * You are passionate about emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence, quantum, energy, agtech, advanced manufacturing, and robotics. * You are committed to building the best AI version of yourself. You are embracing AI tools and using them to delegate and supercharge your abilities. * You are outgoing and can talk to just about anyone. * You are a documenter. You make lists and spreadsheets. * You are a problem solver. You look for ways to make things work better and how to turn chaos into systems. * You are organized and plan ahead, but you don’t get stressed out when things change at the last minute… because they will. You roll with it. * You check your email in the evenings and are available to work during evening events and over the weekends when there is a tight deadline. You do what it takes to get the job done. * You have a reliable laptop computer \& smartphone that you are comfortable using for work. * You plan to stay in Washington, DC for at least three years. **About our team...** * We have a passion for startups and technology. * We are transparent and we over\-communicate. * We are AI first * We have excellent written and verbal communication skills. * We communicate when we are not able to meet a deadline and suggest a solution. * We are professional and presentable and greet everyone cheerfully. We’re ready to deal with an immature student, a pushy salesperson, top VC’s, a fortune 500 CEO, and even the President of the United States. * We are excited to work in downtown DC and have reliable transportation. * We have a quiet place where we can work remotely with fast internet. * We are security aware. We have a passcode on our computers and phones and use a password manager. * We are able to efficiently use the Google suite of productivity tools (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides). * We are available to work during SXSW (Spring Break), DREAMCON (one week long staff summits twice a year), and Austin Tech Week. * We respond to critical communications within hours and never more than 24 hours. **Benefits** * 4 weeks paid time off (one week is between Christmas and New Year’s) * Personal health, vision and dental insurance paid 100% by Capital Factory * Additional benefits such as 401k program (50% company matching), life insurance, short \& long term disability and and employee assistance program * Parental leave including 12 weeks paid maternity and 4 weeks for paternity leave or adoptive parents * $1,000 personal innovation budget on your first year anniversary and then an additional $500 each anniversary thereafter * A priceless network **About Capital Factory** Capital Factory is a leading deep tech venture capital firm headquartered in Austin, Texas. We back the most ambitious founders working on the hardest problems, investing nationally from early stage through growth across defense, space, energy, advanced manufacturing, robotics, and the life sciences. With deep ties to the government and the national security sector, Capital Factory backs founders with the capital and institutional resources to build companies that strengthen American industry and advance civilization.

jobs.title: AI Engineer 4 (AI Foundations)
jobs.description: AI Engineer 4 (AI Foundations) At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact. **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One. * Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, agents and multi\-agent workflows, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Leverage a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more. * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems. * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One. * Own the end\-to\-end architecture for complex AI systems \- ensuring maintainability, observability, and ethical alignment * Define and maintain service\-level objectives (SLOs) for AI reliability, including latency, uptime, and model performance drift * Collaborate with infrastructure engineering to optimize GPU/TPU utilization and accelerate model inference pipelines * Lead cross\-functional technical reviews for new AI system deployments, ensuring security, data governance, and compliance standards are met * Mentor Principal and Senior Associates on scalable design, performance tuning and research\-to\-production translation **The Ideal Candidate:** * You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good * Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production * You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven * You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enables you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss * You are a resilient trailblazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 4 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 2 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies * At least 4 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, CUDA, or Java **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience leading development AI systems with tradeoff decisions around cost, latency, throughput and accuracy * 6 years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalen cy, throughput, and cost * Experience in building agentic AI systems and agentic workflows * Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems, and judiciously apply novel techniques in production * Proficiency in designing distributed systems for model training, evaluation, and online inference at petabyte scale * Experience defining AI model governance processes, including producibility, lineage tracking, and automated retaining schedules * Demonstrated ability to influence architectural decisions across multiple AI product lines or platforms ***Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.*** The minimum and maximum full\-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part\-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked. Sales Territory: $179,400 \- $204,700 for AI Engineer 4 McLean, VA: $197,300 \- $225,100 for AI Engineer 4 Cambridge, MA: $197,300 \- $225,100 for AI Engineer 4 New York, NY: $215,200 \- $245,600 for AI Engineer 4 San Jose, CA: $215,200 \- $245,600 for AI Engineer 4 Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter. This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan. Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well\-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part\-time status, exempt or non\-exempt status, and management level. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days. No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non\-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Capital One promotes a drug\-free workplace. Capital One will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable laws regarding criminal background inquiries, including, to the extent applicable, Article 23\-A of the New York Correction Law; San Francisco, California Police Code Article 49, Sections 4901\-4920; New York City’s Fair Chance Act; Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Records Screening Act; and other applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations regarding criminal background inquiries. jobs.description: Manager, Data Science \- People Tech Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast\-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data\-driven decision\-making. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Ledger
jobs.description: Cardless is building the infrastructure for the world's best companies to design, build, and launch financial products of their own. Companies like Coinbase and Bilt use Cardless to create credit cards that feel entirely their own. In an industry where branded financial products usually mean shared logos and shared control, Cardless is built to disappear. Our APIs and components shape the journey from the first application to every purchase, reward, and moment of support that follows, while we handle lending, compliance, and operations behind the scenes. In September 2025, we raised a $60 million Series C led by Spark Capital, bringing our total funding to $170 million. The team is over 70 people and scaling toward profitability by year\-end 2026\. We're looking for kind, humble people with high standards and low egos. We take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. We see what could be improved, make it so, and leave every product, system, and team better than we found it. **About the role** ------------------ As a Software Engineer on Ledger at Cardless, you'll own the system that tracks what every cardholder owes us and what we owe them. The ledger is the system of record for balances across every card program we run. Statements, interest, how payments get applied, what a customer sees in the app, what we report to our partners: all of it depends on the ledger being right. You'll own its architecture. Credit ledgers are harder than most. A balance revolves, accrues interest, gets billed on a cycle, and takes payments that have to be applied across principal, fees, and interest in a particular order. When any of that is wrong it turns up in someone's statement, or in a regulatory filing, or in a reconciliation break three weeks later. This is a senior\-to\-staff role with real architectural ownership, and it's a founding engineering role on our ledger and credit systems. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Own the double\-entry ledger that is the system of record for balances across every card program we run, and the invariants it has to hold * Build the credit mechanics on top of it: billing cycle close, statement generation, interest accrual, payment allocation, fees, delinquency, and charge\-off * Own reconciliation from sub\-ledger to GL, and build the break detection that catches silent failures before close * Set the architecture and decide what gets built in what order * Work directly with Finance, Compliance, and our partners on the requirements a ledger has to satisfy to survive an audit **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * 6\+ years building production backend systems, with meaningful time on ledger, core banking, money movement, or payments platform work * You've built one, not integrated with one. At least one of: a double\-entry ledger that became the system of record for balances; in\-house card processing or authorization and settlement infrastructure; or a migration of a card or money\-movement program off a third\-party processor onto in\-house rails * You think in invariants: idempotency, immutability, event sourcing, what has to hold at all times and how you'd prove it holds * Strong distributed systems and API fundamentals in a modern backend language * You're comfortable with ambiguity. You'll be scoping your own work, and you'll have to explain your tradeoffs to colleagues across functions **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Credit card ledgers specifically: revolving credit, billing cycles, interest accrual, APR, minimum payments, payment waterfalls, installment plans, Reg Z / TILA * Auth\-to\-settlement lifecycle: pending versus posted, capture, clearing, network files, ISO 8583, refunds and reversals, dispute and chargeback accounting * You built or rewrote the ledger at a Chime, Stripe, Block, Affirm, Brex, Ramp, Mercury, Increase, or Modern Treasury and want to own one end to end * You built an issuing platform at a Marqeta, Lithic, Highnote, Galileo and want to be on the program side of it **This role isn't a fit if** ---------------------------- * You want a spec handed to you. Scoping the work is part of the job * You reach for eventual consistency by default * You want distance from Finance, Compliance, and operations * You want to work remotely **Why this role** ----------------- A ledger is one of the few systems where there's no partial credit. A balance is either right or it isn't, and everyone downstream finds out which. You'd own that across every program on the platform, which is a wider surface than most ledger roles come with. **Compensation** ---------------- This role has an annual starting salary range of $190,000 \- $295,000 \+ equity \+ benefits (see below). Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, and specific work location. **Benefits** ------------ We're headquartered in San Francisco, CA, with a beautiful office in the Financial District. We're proud to offer our team excellent benefits: Meaningful Start\-up equity 100% health, vision \& dental primary coverage 75% health, vision \& dental dependent coverage Catered lunches $250/month Commuter benefit Parental leave Team building events \& happy hours Flexible PTO with a minimum of 15 days off per year Apple equipment 401k plan **Location** ------------ San Francisco, CA — our office is in the Jackson Square district. This role is 5 days a week in office.

jobs.title: Engineer II_Chicago Area
jobs.description: About This Opportunity We are seeking an Engineer II. In this role, you will work directly with clients to assess their industrial operations and identify opportunities to maximize energy efficiency and performance. You'll take a consultative approach — gathering data, building optimization models, and writing feasibility reports — while leading overall project management and contributing to peer support and quality control. Future\-Focused AI\-Ready Culture At Cascade Energy, we’re actively shaping how AI gets deployed in the real world, in our tools, our client engagements, and our daily work. Our approach has always been relationship\-driven and expertise\-led, and AI is how we multiply the impact of both. Successful Cascadians are curious and resilient. They embrace change, seek smarter ways to create impact, and take ownership of their own growth. We embed AI into our work in ways that are responsible and human\-centered, and we actively develop our people to deploy it creatively and confidently. We believe the future belongs to organizations that pair emerging technology with genuine human expertise. That future is being built here… come be a part of it! What You Will Be Doing * Lead projects and provide overall management, direction, and accountability on assigned projects * Calculate energy savings for various system or equipment changes using existing calculation tools, original spreadsheets, and/or generally accepted methodologies * Engage with clients at their industrial locations to fully understand their equipment and operations, identifying opportunities for energy efficiency and providing recommendations * Foster and grow client relationships, and identify opportunities for generating additional work from current and new clients, including through mentoring less experienced team members * Discuss and explain complex technical issues with a diverse audience in a way that facilitates understanding and consensus, and compose energy efficiency project reports based on analyses and observations * Document performance through data collection from customer sources or installed data\-logging equipment, and maintain a solid understanding of utility programs and their compliance requirements This is a full\-time, exempt position located in the Chicagoland Area. We are open to candidates within the region who are available for day trips to customer sites and client meetings. Travel up to 20% annually is expected, with some assignments requiring up to 50%. Qualifications **Applicants for this role are required to have:** * Bachelor's Degree (or higher) in Mechanical or Chemical Engineering, or a related field of study * 3 \-5 years of engineering experience * Technical knowledge of refrigeration, compressed air systems, steam systems, custom computer modeling of systems, electrical distribution system design, industrial control, and data\-logging of system results A successful candidate should also demonstrate these preferred characteristics and/or skills: * Experience with utility custom energy efficiency programs * Experience working with both commercial and industrial clients * Experience mentoring team members * Critical thinking, problem solving, and decision\-making capabilities demonstrated by educational or professional experience * Ability to work both independently and in a team environment * Strong project management and organizational skills * Excellent communication skills with the ability to comfortably interact with internal and external customers and stakeholders * Proactive, resourceful, and highly motivated to achieve project results For candidates whose experience may not align perfectly with all these preferred skills but can see themselves adding value in this role, we encourage you to still apply. Cascade is dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace and places strong importance on learning and development. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions. Compensation \& Benefits The annual salary range for this full\-time, exempt position in the Chicagoland Area, IL is $81,270 \- $122,010\. At Cascade, transparency and fairness are core to how we work. We post the full salary range for every role because we value clarity and equity. Our offers are thoughtfully determined based on factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and internal equity, to ensure fairness. We aim to ensure consistency and integrity in every decision. Our total rewards include competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing and financial security. We provide health, dental, and vision coverage, along with flexible spending and health savings account options that include employer contributions. Additional benefits include life insurance, short\- and long\-term disability coverage, paid parental leave, and a 401(k)\-retirement plan with a guaranteed 3% employer contribution. Cascade r of interest describing why our team or the position resonates with you, and how your experience makes you a great choice for the role. * Please, no phone calls. * Please, no outside recruiters or agencies. * Cascade Energy is not able to provide sponsorship for work authorization in the U.S., which includes OPT. Click here to join our Talent Community \-\- it’s the best way to keep up with and learn more about Cascade Energy! In occasional mailings, we’ll brief you on our industrial decarbonization efforts and share more about our company culture and what makes Cascade a great place to join and to grow. About Us Cascade Energy is a leading provider of energy efficiency, energy management, decarbonization, and sustainability solutions for the industrial, commercial, and public sectors across North America. We have a 30\-year history of delivering high\-value services through electric and gas utility\-offered programs and directly to industrial and commercial enterprises. Our reputation for stellar, high\-quality work has expanded our reach throughout North America to serve clients ranging in size from small to Fortune 500 companies in their pursuit of wide\-ranging decarbonization and energy savings objectives. Cascade Energy has 14 offices throughout the US and employees in 30 states. Why Work at Cascade? As a 100% Employee\-Owned Company (ESOP), Cascadians foster and value a culture of equals, initiative, and ownership. Our teams reflect our core company values: Do the Right Thing; Put Others First; Seek Shared Success; Learn Constantly; and Be Industrious. Our customers are vitally important to us, and we pride ourselves on stellar customer service. Our team members are a dedicated and diverse group of ambassadors, representing Cascade Energy, striving to embody our values, ensure we are responsive, and consistently delighting our customers. In alignment with our values and doing better, Cascade Energy celebrates and values diversity as vital for increased creativity and innovation and faster problem solving, and we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect, free of discrimination and harassment. Learn more about what we do to create a welcoming environment at Cascade by visiting Culture and Belonging \| Cascade Energy. Cascade promotes a healthy work\-life balance and appreciates employee contribution in all areas. We walk the talk about our commitment to learning constantly, with a focus on the ongoing development of every team member. Cascade is a strong supporter of flexible working arrangements, and offers role\-dependent options for remote, hybrid, and in\-office work. AI Usage During our Recruitment Process We value doing the right thing and authenticity in our hiring process. All application materials, including resumes, cover letters, and assessments, must reflect your own original work. The use of AI tools including Gemini, Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, other large language models or generative AI, Grammarly, and resume builders to assist is acceptable only when your personal experiences, voice, and descriptions of your knowledge, skills, abilities, and other qualifications are accurately and meaningfully represented. Submission of work that is not your own or the use of AI impersonation or deepfake simulators during screening calls and videos will disqualify you from consideration. AAP/EEO Statement Cascade is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion and religious practices, sex (including pregnancy, gender expression, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or family, marital, or veteran status. To request a reasonable accommodation during the application and interviewing process, please contact the Cascade recruiter. Cascade Energy uses the federal E\-Verify system to determine eligibility for work in the United States and conducts post\-job offer, pre\-employment drug screening.

jobs.description: **Discover your future at Citi** -------------------------------- Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. **Job Overview** ---------------- **About Citi:** Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients' best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations \& Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first\-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services. Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well\-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We'll enable growth and progress together. **About the Team:** The **Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst** is a senior\-level technologist and a pivotal force within Citi's Enterprise Operations \& Technology organization. This is not a role for those content with the status quo — it is designed for a seasoned professional who thrives at the intersection of deep technical expertise and enterprise\-scale impact. The ideal candidate brings a commanding command of modern application development, a sharp analytical mind capable of navigating complex system architectures, and the vision to translate business imperatives into resilient, future\-ready technology solutions. In an organization where technology is the backbone of global financial services, this role carries meaningful weight in shaping how Citi builds, evolves, and governs its most critical systems. In this capacity, the successful candidate will operate as both a hands\-on practitioner and a trusted thought partner to cross\-functional management teams, engineering leads, and technology architects. They will drive the full lifecycle of application development — from identifying system enhancements that unlock new products and process efficiencies, to setting the standards by which code is written, tested, and deployed at scale. Their influence will extend beyond their immediate team, as they serve as a subject matter authority and coach to mid\-level developers and analysts, elevating the technical caliber of those around them while ensuring every solution aligns with Citi's architectural blueprint and risk management standards. high\-throughput, event\-driven architectures * Proficiency working with **NoSQL databases** such as **MongoDB**, including **data modeling, schema design, query optimization,** and **integration with distributed application systems** * Experience leveraging **AI\-assisted development tools** such as **Claude** or **Devin to accelerate engineering workflows**, **improve code quality,** and **solve complex technical problems more efficiently** * Proven experience designing and implementing solutions that adhere to enterprise architecture blueprints, coding standards, and technology governance frameworks * Subject Matter Expert (SME) in at least one domain of Applications Development, with the ability to provide authoritative technical guidance and influence solution design decisions * Strong knowledge of **CI/CD tools** including **Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions,** or **ArgoCD**, with experience a**utomating build, test,** and **deployment workflows** to support continuous delivery * Strong knowledge leveraging **AI tools** to make development more efficient. * Demonstrated ability to adjust priorities quickly as circumstances dictate and manage concurrent technical workstreams in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment * Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both jobs.title: Director, Paid & Digital
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- Marketing **We are an applied AI lab building end\-to\-end software agents.** ------------------------------------------------------------------- We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. Our team is extremely talent\-dense. Among our founding team, we have world\-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro. Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real\-world tasks, apply to join us. **The Role** We're looking for a Director of Paid \& Digital to build and scale Cognition's paid demand engine. You'll own the strategy and execution behind how we use paid distribution to reach the engineers, technical leaders, and enterprise buyers shaping the future of software development. This goes well beyond managing ad platforms. You'll determine where Cognition should invest, which audiences we need to reach, what we should put in front of them, and how we turn that attention into qualified enterprise pipeline. You'll operate across established channels like paid search, LinkedIn, YouTube, Reddit, and other social platforms, while continuously identifying new opportunities across technical publications, newsletters, communities, creators, sponsorships, and emerging channels. This is a highly hands\-on role. You'll build the strategy and execute it: launching campaigns, analyzing performance, developing audiences, reviewing search queries, testing creative, evaluating new channels, and deciding where the next dollar should go. **What You’ll Do** **Build Cognition's Paid Demand Engine** * Own Cognition's paid acquisition and distribution strategy with a focus on generating qualified enterprise pipeline. * Determine the right channel mix, investment strategy, audiences, offers, and campaign architecture as we scale. * Build a clear understanding of where our highest\-value audiences spend their time and how we can reach them. * Allocate budget dynamically based on performance and opportunity rather than fixed channel assumptions. * Build the systems, processes, and measurement framework required to scale paid investment significantly. * Partner with sales, operations, and sales enablement to ensure leads are qualified and are effectively worked. **Own Paid Media** * Own strategy and execution across paid search, LinkedIn, YouTube, Reddit, Meta, X, and other relevant platforms. * Build sophisticated audience and account strategies around enterprise segments, personas, intent, and buying stage. * Capture high\-intent demand while creating demand among accounts that may not yet be actively searching. * Continuously optimize campaigns based on pipeline quality and downstream business outcomes—not just clicks, leads, or platform\-reported conversions. * Maintain deep expertise in the platforms and stay close enough to execution to identify opportunities others miss. **Expand Paid Distribution Beyond Traditional Advertising** * Identify and test new channels where technical and enterprise audiences spend attention. * Build partnerships across relevant newsletters, technical publications, developer and enterprise communities, podcasts, creators, influencers, and other emerging distribution channels. * Evaluate opportunities based on audience quality, enterprise relevance, scale potential, economics, and ability to test. * Build a repeatable process for finding, testing, measuring, and scaling new sources of demand. * Continuously challenge where Cognition should be spending its next dollar. **Build a High\-Velocity Experimentation Engine** * Run a continuous pipeline of experiments across **channel × audience × message × creative × offer × format × landing experience**. * Develop clear hypotheses and success criteria before launching tests. * Test fundamentally different approaches rather than only optimizing existing campaigns. * Quickly scale what works and shut down what doesn't. * Build a culture where experimentation velocity increases as the paid program grows. * Track investment impact throughout the sales journey. * Turn individual campaign learnings into insights that improve the broader Demand Gen strategy. **Build the Creative Testing System** * Develop a systematic approach to paid creative experimentation. * Identify which messages, narratives, customer proof, product capabilities, and formats resonate with different audiences. * Partner with Product Marketing and Design to maintain a consistent pipeline of new creative concepts. * Test across video, static, product\-led creative, customer proof, technical content, executive perspectives, and emerging form  than sending every campaign to the same conversion path. **Optimize for Enterprise Pipeline** * Measure success based on qualified enterprise pipeline and downstream business impact. * Partner with RevOps to understand performance from impression account engagement opportunity pipeline. * Understand performance by audience, account segment, channel, campaign, offer, and creative. * Develop clear frameworks for CAC, pipeline efficiency, marginal spend, and incrementality. * Use data to determine where Cognition should increase, decrease, or reallocate investment. **Work AI\-Natively** * Use AI aggressively across research, audience development, campaign creation, creative iteration, analysis, and optimization. * Build workflows that allow the paid program to operate with exceptional speed and leverage. * Experiment with emerging AI\-native advertising, discovery, and distribution channels as they develop. **What Success Looks Like** * Paid becomes a predictable and scalable source of qualified enterprise pipeline. * Cognition has a clear understanding of which channels, audiences, messages, offers, and creative combinations generate the highest\-quality opportunities. * We're consistently discovering and validating new distribution channels. * Experimentation velocity increases over time. * Creative is continuously refreshed based on real market feedback. * Budget can scale materially without sacrificing pipeline quality or efficiency. * We can confidently explain where the next incremental dollar should go—and why. * Paid insights are helping the broader marketing organization understand what resonates with the market. **You Should Be** * 8\+ years of experience in paid acquisition, growth marketing, digital marketing, or demand generation, ideally in a high\-growth B2B technology company. * Experience managing and scaling significant paid media budgets. * Deep hands\-on expertise across major advertising platforms, particularly paid search and LinkedIn. * Strong understanding of enterprise B2B buying journeys and account\-based marketing. * Experience testing channels beyond traditional paid media. * Strong creative instincts and experience building systematic creative testing programs. * Exceptional analytical ability and comfort connecting media performance to pipeline and revenue. * Comfortable owning both **strategy and execution**. * Experience working closely with Product Marketing, Design, Web/Growth, RevOps, and Sales. * Strong commercial judgment and the ability to distinguish meaningful business outcomes from attractive marketing metrics. * Highly hands\-on. You're comfortable opening an ad account, digging into campaign performance, writing a brief, evaluating a media opportunity, launching a test, and deciding what to do next. * Excited about AI and interested in using it to fundamentally change how performance marketing operates. **The Ideal Candidate** You're not looking to inherit a media plan and optimize it. You want to figure out where Cognition's next million dollars of efficient growth should come from. You're equally comfortable scaling a proven channel, killing an underperforming campaign, testing an unconventional distribution partner, developing a new offer, or digging into the data to understand why a campaign generated leads but no pipeline. You combine the analytical rigor of a performance marketer with the curiosity of a growth marketer and the commercial instincts of an enterprise demand generation leader. And you want to build, not just manage. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process \- please let us know if you need any.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Relay Protection - Central Engineering, P&C Standards
jobs.description: **Mission Statement:** Consolidated Edison Company of New York, Inc. (Con Edison), Orange \& Rockland Utilities (O\&R), and Consolidated Edison Transmission (CET) employees are required to follow health, safety, and environmental policies, EEO, Standards of Business Conduct, and all other applicable company policy and procedures. We all share a responsibility to advance the company’s mission by excelling at our three corporate priorities – safety of our people and the public, operational excellence in all that we do, and ensuring the best possible customer experience. **Benefits:** We are dedicated to supporting the physical, mental, and financial health of our employees and their families. This commitment extends beyond the workplace to foster personal growth and holistic wellbeing. Our life\-changing rewards package includes: * Rich medical \& pharmacy benefits, including vision benefits * Dental benefits * Health Savings Accounts * Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts * 401(k) with robust matching * Employer paid Pension Plan * Employee Stock Purchase Plan with a generous matching contribution * State of the art Employee Assistance Program * Paid Parental Leave * Generous paid time off plus paid holidays * Family support: emergency backup child, \& elder care assistance * Social responsibility and volunteer opportunities * Employee discount program * Commuter Benefits * Culture of growth and learning: career development; tuition reimbursement; recognition program Life and Long\-Term Disability Benefits * \*Please be aware that some benefits may not apply to provisional or part\-time job titles. The Senior Engineer will support Con Edisons Protective Relay Strategy Implementation (PRSI) team, contributing to strategic initiatives focused on modernizing and standardizing Protection and Control (P\&C) systems. This role is responsible for developing forward looking relay protection designs that integrate advanced technologies to enhance system reliability, resiliency, and support the clean energy transition. The position works closely with crossfunctional stakeholders in a collaborative environment that promotes technical excellence, innovation, and knowledge sharing across Con Edisons unique electric system. This position does not provide employment pursuant to the terms of a STEM OPT Training Plan. **Core Responsibilities*** Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to develop, test, implement, and maintain Protection and Control (P\&C) standards, including philosophy documents, setting guidelines, calculation templates, configuration files, drawings, procedures, and training on standards. * Research industry best practices and emerging technologies to continuously improve and modernize relay protection and controls standards. * Perform engineering analyses and evaluations to assess new hardware and software solutions and support the deployment of protection system upgrade programs. * Support the Protective Relay Strategy Implementation (PRSI) team in executing new strategies, initiatives, and processes that enhance the design, operation, and reliability of P\&C systems. * Manage and oversee vendor and contractor technical performance, including review of designs, deliverables, and field implementations. * Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to implement relay protection standards, gather feedback, and manage expectations across organizations. * Perform technical reviews of relay protection scopes and designs to ensure alignment with approved standards and system requirements. * Apply technical and analytical skills to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex relay protection issues, recommending effective engineering solutions. * Provide technical leadership and mentorship to Engineers and Associate Engineers within the group. * Deliver technical and safetyrelated presentations to engineering teams, management, and executive leadership as required. **Required Education/Experience*** Bachelor's Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering and 8 years of engineering work experience. A minimum of three years of relevant experience in relay protection and/or control systems engineering disciplines, required. or * Master's Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering and 6 years of engineering work experience. A minimum of three years of relevant experience in relay protection and/or control systems engineering disciplines, required. **Relevant Work Experience*** A minimum of three years of relevant experience in relay protection and/or control systems engineering disciplines, required. * Excellent communication skills, the ability to champion change, and the capacity to influence others to improve management processes, required. * Proficient in computer applications, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, required. * Experience with microprocessor relay platforms and related configuration software, required. * Working knowledge of IEC61850, preferred. * Industry involvement with EPRI, NATF and other organizations on relay applications, preferred. **Licenses and Certifications*** Driver's License Required **Physical Demands*** Sit or stand to use a keyboard, mouse, and computer for the duration of the workday * Stand to use/operate office equipment for the duration of the workday **Additional Physical Demands*** The selected candidate will be assigned a System Emergency Assignment (i.e., an emergency response role) and will be expected to work non\-business hours during emergencies, which may include nights, weekends, and holidays. * Ability to travel throughout the company service territory and work at company locations as needed. * Ability to wear the required PPE as needed. * Ability to work in various indoor and outdoor conditions, and in all weather conditions. * Ability to work in power plants and high voltage substations. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of the individual’s actual or perceived disability, protected veteran status, race, color, creed, religion, sex, age, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship, domestic violence victim status, or any other actual or perceived status protected by law. jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Water Structures
jobs.description: As a Consor teammate, you’ll join a collaborative network of water and transportation experts dedicated to supporting clients through the entire project lifecycle. You’ll have access to the resources of a large consulting firm while experiencing the community feel of a local team. Grow your career by working on impactful projects that shape inspiring communities—and expand your potential along the way. * Regular Full\-Time * Remote ***What Your Day Will Look Like:*** As a Senior Structural Engineer focused on water infrastructure, you will lead the planning, analysis, and design of critical water and wastewater facilities, including treatment plants, pump stations, reservoirs, elevated tanks, intake structures, and other hydraulic infrastructure. Working closely with multidisciplinary teams, clients, and regulatory agencies, you will develop innovative, resilient solutions that support essential community services and long\-term system reliability. Your day will involve performing structural analyses, developing design calculations, preparing construction documents, and conducting technical reviews to ensure compliance with industry standards and client requirements. You will provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers, guide project deliverables through all phases of design, and support business development efforts through client engagement and proposal development. You will also participate in site visits, condition assessments, and construction support activities, helping resolve field issues and ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards. Balancing technical excellence with project execution, you will play a key role in delivering sustainable water infrastructure projects that have a lasting impact on the communities we serve. **Projected Compensation:** $160,000 \- $200,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications. Compensation above this range may be considered for candidates whose experience and expertise significantly exceed the minimum requirements. ***What You'll Do:*** * Lead the structural design and analysis of water and wastewater infrastructure, including treatment facilities, pump stations, reservoirs, tanks, and hydraulic structures. * Serve as the technical lead on multidisciplinary projects, ensuring designs meet client requirements, applicable codes, and industry standards. * Develop structural calculations, specifications, reports, and construction documents for projects ranging from rehabilitation efforts to new facility expansions. * Perform condition assessments and structural evaluations of existing water infrastructure to identify deficiencies and recommend practical solutions. * Collaborate with civil, mechanical, electrical, process, and geotechnical engineers to deliver integrated and efficient project designs. * Review and seal engineering deliverables, providing quality assurance and ensuring technical accuracy throughout all phases of project development. * Mentor and support junior engineers and designers through technical guidance, project oversight, and professional development. * Participate in client meetings, presentations, and workshops, serving as a trusted advisor and primary structural engineering resource. * Provide construction\-phase services, including responding to RFIs, reviewing submittals, conducting site visits, and resolving field\-related engineering challenges. * Support business development efforts by cultivating client relationships, identifying new opportunities, and contributing to proposals, interviews, and strategic growth initiatives. ***What You'll Need:*** * 10\+ years of structural engineering experience with water, wastewater, transportation, or other public infrastructure projects. * Project management experience on Water Resources and applicable structures projects * Experience managing public\-sector projects (state, county, city, and federal). * Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, motivate, and collaborate within multidisciplinary teams. * Ability to develop productive, long\-term relationships and communicate with clients, peers, multi\-disciplinary teams, and management * Ability to manage several subconsultants and internal staff on a multi\-disciplinary team * Bachelor's degree in Civil or Structural Engineering * Active California Structural Engineer (SE) License, or ability to obtain California licensure within a reasonable timeframe. * Excellent written and verbal communications skills * Self\-motivated with the ability to work independently with multiple priorities * Attention to detail, delivering quality work products, and excellent client service This hybrid job operates between an office environment and a field environment and routinely requires the use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones and copy machines. May require occasional exposure to work environments that may include inclement weather, heat, humidity, noise, hazard, atmo te work options for some employees based on role responsibilities. * **Wellness –** Medical, dental and vision insurance, employee assistance program, fitness and wellness reimbursement, and HSA and FSA options. * **Life –** Employer\-paid STD and LTD, employer\-paid term life insurance, and retirement 401(k) with company match. * **Community –** Quarterly social events, paid group volunteering events, and employee networks and groups. ***How Your Career Will Grow:*** We know career growth is not always linear or streamlined—it’s often dynamic. You may want to explore a management track, try a new technical track, or move laterally to reposition your skills and talents. No matter what level you join us at or how you want to shape your career, we want Consor to be a place where you can learn and grow. ***Why You’ll Love Consor:*** You’ll experience a culture where we share in our successes and support one another through challenges. Here, there are countless opportunities to explore your career path by working on projects that help you expand your potential and take your career to new heights! Join our diverse team of experts who live and work alongside client partners, providing thoughtful solutions to create inspiring communities together. Click here (opens in new window) to learn more about Consor. **Consor’s Commitment to Equal Opportunity in the Workplace** Consor welcomes and celebrates equality and diversity in the workplace. jobs.title: Gaming Designer
jobs.description: About the Role: Culmen International is seeking a Gaming Designer. This position involves designing and developing serious games, simulation\-supported activities, and interactive exercise experiences for public health and medical preparedness, response, recovery, and continuity missions. The position transforms exercise objectives, operational plans, threat information, and subject\-matter expertise into realistic game mechanics, scenarios, participant decisions, and multimedia products that enable readiness and improve performance. What You’ll Do in Your New Role: * Design, develop, test, facilitate, and refine serious games and simulation\-supported activities for federal, state, local, tribal, territorial, regional, and interagency audiences. * Translate exercise objectives, plans, policies, capabilities, corrective actions, and operational challenges into game concepts, rules, roles, decision points, scenario modules, and measurable outcomes. * Develop realistic scenarios, storylines, injects, timelines, participant materials, facilitation questions, control\-cell products, and Master Scenario Events Lists. * Apply HSEEP doctrine and sound instructional, experiential\-learning, and game\-design principles to seminars, workshops, tabletop exercises, games, drills, functional exercises, and full\-scale exercises. * Incorporate computer simulation, model outputs, visual interfaces, video vignettes, video injects, and virtual\-delivery capabilities into exercise programs when appropriate. * Collaborate with modeling and simulation specialists, systems designers, planners, facilitators, evaluators, analysts, multimedia personnel, and subject matter experts to produce integrated exercise experiences. * Support concept and objectives meetings, initial and midterm planning meetings, in\-progress reviews, MSEL development and synchronization meetings, final planning meetings, exercise execution, hotwashes, and after\-action meetings. * Prototype and playtest game mechanics and supporting materials; collect participant and stakeholder feedback and revise products to improve realism, usability, accessibility, and alignment with objectives. * Develop evaluation criteria and data\-collection opportunities that allow exercise teams to assess decisions, actions, coordination, plans, policies, and corrective\-action implementation. * Review technical and analytical products and interpret modeling or simulation results for incorporation into exercise design and real\-time participant play. * Prepare and deliver briefings, demonstrations, facilitator guidance, participant instructions, technical documentation, and decision\-support materials. * Maintain awareness of current industry standards, emerging technologies, virtual environments, and best practices in serious gaming, simulation, and exercise design. * Complete recurring and short\-turn assignments within established deadlines and maintain accessible, organized project files and deliverables. * Travel as authorized to support planning conferences, exercise delivery, evaluation, training, real\-world response activities, or stakeholder meetings. Required Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in game design, simulation, instructional design, emergency management, public health, computer science, digital media, or a related field. * Relevant experience designing games, simulations, or interactive exercises for the U.S. Government or another complex operational organization. * Experience developing scenarios, game mechanics, injects, participant materials, facilitation content, and exercise\-support products. * Experience incorporating technical data, model results, or simulation capabilities into realistic decision\-based activities. * Ability to interpret operational requirements and convert complex subject matter into clear, engaging, and objective\-driven participant experiences. * Ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications and the ability to learn and use Government\-provided exercise, collaboration, multimedia, and virtual\-delivery tools. * Ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities and respond effectively to short\-notice or surge requirements. Desired Qualifications: * Knowledge of HSEEP doctrine and experience supporting the full exercise planning, conduct, evaluation, and improvement\-planning cycle. * Experience supporting public health preparedness, emergency management, incident response, continuity, consequence modeling, or interagency operations. * Experience creating visual interfaces, video vignettes, video injects, digital game assets, or virtual simulation environments. * Experience facilitating games or exercises for senior leaders, government personnel, emergency responders, healthcare partners, or interagency audiences. * Familiarity with the National Response Framework, National Incident Management System, Emergency Support Function \#8, and federal preparedness and response doctrine. * Experience developing accessible digital and multimedia products consistent with Section 508 requirements. dashboards, and other analytical products, including data preparation, calculations, filtering, and output validation. * Develop and maintain data integration and ETL processes as needed to support data movement between operational systems, databases, reporting platforms, and analytical applications. * Collaborate with application developers, application owners, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand complex data requirements, integrate database solutions with applications, and recommend appropriate solutions. * Perform peer code reviews, testing, troubleshooting, and performance optimization to ensure database solutions meet established quality, reliability, maintainability, and performance standards. * Partner with Enterprise IT on database administration, infrastructure, enterprise ETL/data engineering, deployment, security, and platform\-related activities. * Ensure the security and confidentiality of data and apply established development, documentation, and Agile practices as appropriate. * Maintain an understanding of and comply with applicable HIPAA requirements, relevant FDA regulations, organizational policies, and data privacy and security standards. * Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be accepted in lieu of a degree. * Approximately 3–5 years of experience in database development, data development, data analysis, or a related role. * Strong SQL development skills, including experience developing, troubleshooting, and optimizing complex queries, stored procedures, views, functions, and other database objects. * Strong understanding of relational databases, database design, data modeling, and data processing concepts and methodologies. * Experience analyzing large or complex datasets, transforming data into meaningful information, and performing data validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting of data discrepancies. * Experience developing database and data solutions that support business applications, reporting, analytics, migrations, and data conversions. * Working knowledge of ETL and data integration concepts, tools, and techniques, along with an understanding of DevOps and IT controls related to database development and deployment. * Experience developing and supporting reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions using Microsoft Power BI or similar technologies. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical and data concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences and collaborate effectively with application development teams, business stakeholders, and Enterprise IT. **REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS:** * Reports to the Director of the Patient Registry **WORKING CONDITIONS:** * Normal office jobs.title: SAFETY MANAGER
jobs.description: At Daniel Defense, ***Only the Best Build the Best…*** Daniel Defense engineers and manufactures the world’s finest weapon systems and accessories. Our mission of *Honor God. Defend Freedom* is accomplished by serving customers and providing top quality solutions to our military, law enforcement and civilians that are seeking premium firearms for home defense, hunting, and sport shooting. As the **Environmental Health \& Safety Manager,** you will be responsible for the functions outlined below: **Key Responsibilities:** * Responsible for demonstrating commitment to and leadership of environmental health and safety principles, policies and procedures. * Partner with department leadership to develop and establish competency models and career paths for various functional areas in the manufacturing environment. * Maintain employee records of participation for all EHS/departmental training and development courses and creates and produces reports accordingly. * Responsible for the development, implementation and updating of required written environmental, health and safety programs, operator work instructions and procedures. * Responsible for company EHS inspection program of all workplace areas. * Manage monthly and annual OSHA recordkeeping and reporting requirements. * Document timely investigations of accidents and incidents, root cause analysis, and corrective action/preventative strategies based on findings. * Plan, organize, and facilitate safety training for new hire and temp employees. * Identify, document, and communicate observations of safety concerns and unsafe employee behaviors or issues to Safety Director and departmental managers/leaders. * Responsible for Company Hazardous Communication (HAZCOM) program including chemical inventory, Safety Data Sheets (SDS), new chemical review process and electronic filing systems. * Ensures all vendors, contractors and subcontractors are fully qualified to perform required services at Daniel Defense including insurance requirements, contactor and vendor safety agreement, and perform all Services in accordance with State and Federal OSHA requirements (including, but not limited to, the requirements incorporation by reference in 29 CFR § 1910\.6\), the relevant Federal, State, and Local rules and regulations, as well any other applicable requirement(s) related to the performance of Services. * Work collaboratively with managers, supervisors, employees, consultants, agency officials and others in an effort to reduce adverse safety, health, property and negative environmental exposures on company property. * Contributes and engages in the development, maintenance and reporting of Stormwater, Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plan (SWPPP), Hazardous and Universal Waste, Spill Prevention, Control, and Countermeasures (SPCC) plan, and other environmental requirements. * Manage the Company's Emergency Planning and Community Right\-to\-Know Act (EPCRA) compliance program, including evaluation, preparation, and timely submission of required federal, state, and local reports such as Tier II Hazardous Chemical Inventory Reports and Toxic Release Inventory (TRI) Form R reporting under Section 313\. Maintain supporting documentation, conduct annual threshold determinations, and ensure compliance with all applicable reporting requirements. * Manages the company’s Worker’s Compensation Program effectively. This includes a focus on accident prevention, cost reduction, effective case management, return\-to\-work programs, and similar relative to work related illness and injuries. * Maintain confidentiality of records, reports, investigations, and medical information. * Provides adequate support, training and development to team members to continuously improve Safety, 6S, Quality, Delivery and Productivity. * Responsible for ensuring compliance with all applicable U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations governing the transportation of hazardous materials, including proper classification, packaging, marking, labeling, placarding, shipping documentation, employee training, security awareness, and recordkeeping in accordance with 49 CFR Parts 171–180\. * Expected to be a contributor to the company standards on high integrity, safety, fair and equitable treatment and a positive work environment * Other responsibilities as deemed appropriate or necessary by management. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** * Bachelor’s Degree with an emphasis on risk management; 7\+ years of Safety management or a combination of related experience, education and/or training to sufficiently and successfully perform the essential functions of the job. * Prefer OSHA 30\-hour certification. * Prefer OSHA 501/511 certification Trainer’s Course in Occupational Safety and Health Standards for General Industry. * Understands the complexities of a large organization. jobs.title: Sr Product Manager
jobs.description: **Department Description** Disney isn't just another job; it's a career. We are a global leader in entertainment and experiences, committed to delivering exceptional Guest and Cast experiences through innovation, technology, and operational excellence. As a Senior Product Manager at Disney, you can combine your passion for technology and Guest experience to create compelling and delightful experiences for our valued Guests and Cast. **Team Description:** The Senior Product Manager – Point of Sale Platform is a senior individual contributor role on the Retail and Restaurant Technology team, responsible for owning and delivering large, multi\-quarter product initiatives for Disney's Point of Sale (POS) platform across Retail and Food \& Beverage businesses — including POS modernization, international deployments, and enterprise platform replacement programs. Working in close collaboration with key stakeholders and partners, this role develops an understanding of business and technical capabilities, identifies gaps, and executes product roadmaps for assigned initiative threads. A successful candidate is highly collaborative, works effectively in a matrixed organization while wearing multiple hats, is comfortable working autonomously on complex programs, and is adept at synthesizing a variety of technologies and capabilities into high\-quality, simple products and applications. Serving as a product leader for assigned large programs, the Senior PM acts as a liaison to development, implementation, and support teams, and drives enhancements, backlog ownership, and the prioritization of features and capabilities. This role brings a working understanding of how POS systems connect to the broader technology ecosystem — including supply chain, mobile platforms, data warehousing, and payments — and ensures cross\-system dependencies are surfaced, understood, and reflected in product decisions. **What You’ll Do:** *Product Strategy \& Roadmap* * Owns product direction and execution for assigned large POS initiatives, contributing to the development of product strategy and feature vision that enhances Guest and Cast experiences across Retail and Food \& Beverage programs. * Develops and maintains a prioritized, outcomes\-driven product roadmap for assigned initiative threads, prioritizing initiatives relative to business needs and aligning to strategic and tactical business objectives. * Works with the business to determine the real issue that needs to be solved or the opportunity to do things differently, translating ambiguous needs into clear, actionable product direction. * Supports business cases and business, technical, and financial feasibility assessments to ensure benefits align to enterprise priorities. * Identifies product improvement opportunities by staying involved in initiative delivery and stakeholder feedback, and recommends process and technology improvements that increase product effectiveness. * Provides advice and recommendations on emerging trends and technologies useful to both the business and Technology in the delivery of POS initiatives. *POS Domain Expertise \& Industry Knowledge* * Develops subject matter expertise in Point of Sale, with knowledge spanning hardware (terminals, handhelds, kiosks, peripherals), software, payment processing, menu/catalog management, reporting, and offline resilience across both retail and restaurant environments. * Understands the distinct requirements of retail POS (item lookup, inventory integration, returns, loyalty, associate\-facing workflows) versus restaurant POS (order sequencing, kitchen display systems, modifier management, table management, and speed of service). * Applies operational knowledge of Food \& Beverage and Merchandise environments — including Quick Service, Table Service, kiosk, grab\-and\-go, and specialty retail — to inform product decisions. * Stays current on the broader POS industry, including leading vendors (e.g., Oracle MICROS, Toast, Lightspeed, Square, Stripe) and emerging trends in unified commerce, mobile payment, and AI\-enabled ordering, and applies relevant insights to Disney's platform direction. *Feature Definition \& Product Lifecycle Execution* * Owns and manages key phases of the product lifecycle — including requirements gathering, backlog grooming, and delivery tracking — from problem definition through feature delivery, adoption, and outcome measurement. * Leads the creation of technical specifications and user stories to enable system modification or development, refined to a sufficient level of detail to allow Architects and Software Engineers to design, develop, and implement appropriate solutions. * Defines and refines product features by synthesizing inputs from end users (e.g., surveys, analytics), business stakeholders (e.g., pricing, marketing), and industry trends. * Combines business requirements into a prioritized backlog grouped into project iterations, and manages the scope and traceability of requirement t align with the product vision to validate technical viability and business assumptions. * Partners with Technology and Data teams to ensure responsible, secure, and effective integration of AI capabilities into the POS platform and product development processes. *Collaboration, Communication \& Stakeholder Engagement* * Collaborates with fellow Product Managers and cross\-functional teams, contributing to team effectiveness by sharing product management best practices and lessons learned. * Develops and maintains relationships with business, vendor, and technology stakeholders, and manages engagement, expectations, scope, and budget discussions for large or complex initiatives. * Provides thought leadership and asserts influence by driving complex projects to completion effectively and efficiently, escalating issues and recommending appropriate solutions. * Communicates effectively through written documentation, presentations, and verbal updates across various levels of the organization, providing updates to leadership as needed. * Supports go\-to\-market efforts in coordination with marketing, content, training, consumer insights, and operations, and participates in change control processes to ensure alignment with business and technology expectations. **Required Qualifications \& Skills:** * 5\+ years (3\+ years with a Master's degree) of product management or equivalent experience driving product strategy and execution, ideally in digital or technology roles within the retail or hospitality industry. * Strong technical product knowledge in the Point of Sale space, with functional understanding of retail and restaurant POS environments, payment processing, and reporting. * Demonstrated ability to identify, understand, and drive resolution of complex, critical issues, and to think strategically and drive ideas into action with a positive outlook and willingness to take personal initiative. * Understanding of Agile technical practices, DevOps, and testing concepts (CI/CD, TDD), and strong command of agile tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar). * Basic knowledge of public cloud technologies (e.g., AWS) and an understanding of the nuances of data pipeline issues and solutions. * Experience working in a collaborative, matrixed environment with cross\-functional Technology teams and operational departments. * Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex or diverse project data and information and articulate a compelling vision for complex and seemingly disparate concepts. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Direct experience with Disney theme park or resort operations, or equivalent large\-scale, multi\-site hospitality or retail operations. * Hands\-on experience with one or more enterprise POS platforms (e.g., Oracle MICROS, Toast, Lightspeed, NCR, or equivalent) in a retail or restaurant context. * Experience delivering enterprise POS platforms across multi\-location environments with high transaction volume and complex operational requirements. * Experience applying AI, analytics, or automation to platform capabilities or operational workflows to improve Guest or Cast outcomes. * Familiarity with various funding models and driving products through the stages of the product funding lifecycle. **Required Education:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a similar field, or equivalent work experience. The hiring range for this position in Lake Buena Vista, FL is $135,200 \- $181,200 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

We are responsible for the end\-to\-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology \& digital\-led initiatives across the Attractions \& Entertainment, Food \& Beverage, Resorts \& Transportation and Merchandise lines of business as well as other initiatives including MyDisneyExperience and Hey, Disney! a DevOps culture by building automation and tooling that improve reliability, reduce friction for developers, and enhance observability across identity and access services. * Design, build, and support secure IAM solutions, including role\-based access control, authentication flows, and governance standards for enterprise environments. * Evaluate and implement Privileged Access Management, secrets management, and access governance tools to safeguard sensitive systems and data. * Automate user provisioning, deprovisioning, license assignment, and account lifecycle management using CI/CD pipelines and configuration management platforms. * Perform systems administration across Active Directory, Windows, Linux, and other platforms, ensuring stability, performance, capacity management, and strong security controls. * Collaborate with Security Operations and partner teams to design secure solutions, maintain vulnerability management practices, and uphold Disney security standards. *
