jobs.title: Sales Engineer - Supply
jobs.description: Department Customer Success Location Short Hills, NJ Job scope USA Work setting Hybrid Reporting to Senior Director \- Technical Account Management **About Doceree** ----------------- Doceree is the world's only AI\-powered Operating System for healthcare marketing. We aim to be a catalyst for change, improving healthcare by enabling more meaningful interactions with HCPs. Our patented AI brings deeper context to every HCP touchpoint\-understanding who HCPs are, what they're exploring, how they engage, and when they make decisions, all in a privacy\-compliant way. With this enriched context, every message becomes clearer, more relevant, and more likely to drive better healthcare outcomes. In our journey of 5 years, we have earned four patents for innovation and even won a Silver award at the Cannes Lions, one of the world's top advertising honors. Over the years, we've also had the opportunity to work with 115\+ pharma companies and collaborate with 30\+ media publications, 150\+ EHR platforms, 2,000\+ publisher networks, and 35\+ hospitals and health systems. Our ecosystem connects us with more than 6 million verified doctors worldwide. Today, Doceree operates across 25\+ countries, with teams based in New Jersey, London, and India. Technology can connect the fragmented healthcare ecosystem to deliver information when it is most needed to improve patients' outcomes. We are expanding our footprints across the globe and enhancing our services, offering, and developing new products and solutions to address the unmet needs of industry. **Purpose of the Job** ---------------------- We are looking for a highly skilled and partner\-focused **Sales Engineer** to join our **Global Supply, Identity, Data \& Partnerships team**. This role sits at the intersection of strategic account management, technical integrations, programmatic operations, and partner success. You will work closely with publishers, SSPs, identity partners, point\-of\-care platforms, data providers, and strategic ecosystem partners to drive onboarding, integrations, operational excellence, inventory quality, and long\-term partnership growth across **Doceree’s** global marketplace. This role reports into the Technical Account Management function and will play a critical role in scaling **Doceree’s** supply\-side infrastructure and partner ecosystem. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Strategic Partner Management \& Growth** * Build and maintain strong relationships with strategic publishers, SSPs, identity providers, data partners, and point\-of\-care networks * Act as a trusted technical and operational advisor for partners across onboarding, optimization, troubleshooting, and growth initiatives * Identify opportunities to expand partner adoption, inventory coverage, data collaboration, and platform utilization * Drive partner engagement through regular business and technical reviews **Technical Onboarding \& Integrations** * Lead end\-to\-end onboarding and integration efforts for publishers and ecosystem partners, including: SSP integrations, API integrations, Identity and audience enablement, Tagging and ad\-serving implementation, Supply onboarding and inventory mapping, Data and measurement integrations * Collaborate with engineering and product teams to ensure seamless partner activation and successful launches * Validate implementation quality and troubleshoot integration issues across platforms and environments **Supply, Identity \& Inventory Quality Operations** * Support and optimize Doceree’s global supply ecosystem across web, mobile, app, EHR, and point\-of\-care environments * Monitor inventory quality, traffic integrity, ad quality, and operational performance across partners * Partner with internal Quality, Product, and Operations teams to identify and resolve supply\-side issues proactively * Help maintain and improve standards around identity resolution, targeting readiness, inventory transparency, and marketplace quality **Technical Support \& Optimization** * Serve as the primary technical point of contact for assigned partners * Investigate and resolve technical, operational, and delivery\-related issues with urgency and accountability * Analyze platform performance, bidstream quality, and partner health metrics to recommend optimizations * Coordinate cross\-functional escalations involving Product, Engineering, Operations, and Customer Success teams **Solution Enablement \& Collaboration** * Conduct technical walkthroughs, platform demos, and enablement sessions tailored to partner needs * Translate complex technical concepts into clear business\-oriented communication for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Data, and Operations teams to align on strategic initiatives and partner requirements * Provide structured feedback and market insights to help shape future platform capabilities and partnership strategy **Qualifications \- Experience, Skills \& Education** ----------------------------------------------------- * 5–8\+ years of experience in Technical Account Management, Sales Engineering, Publisher Operations, Partner Solutions, or similar client\-facing technical roles within AdTech, Programmatic Advertising, Healthcare Media, or Digital Media * Strong understanding of the programmatic ecosystem, including SSPs, DSPs, ad serving, bidstream mechanics, identity solutions, APIs, and publisher monetization workflows * Experience managing technical and operational relationships with publishers, data providers, identity partners, or point\-of\-care networks * Comfortable navigating both strategic relationship management and hands\-on technical troubleshooting * Familiarity with inventory quality, supply\-path optimization, identity frameworks, and advertising operations, best practices **Key Competencies** -------------------- * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across business and technical audiences * Collaborative, proactive, and detail\-oriented mindset with strong ownership mentality **Why Explore a Career at Doceree** ----------------------------------- Doceree has been recognized and certified Best places to work NJ 2023 and Great Place to work 2026\. If you are passionate about health technology and have a knack for turning complex concepts into compelling narratives, we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity to contribute to the success of our innovative health tech company. **Doceree USA Benefits** ------------------------ * Competitive Salary Package * Performance Based Bonuses * Generous Leave Policy * Flexible Working Hours * Health Care Benefits * 401K \+ 4% Matching * Extensive Paid Parental Leave **Doceree DEI Vision \& Mission** --------------------------------- Doceree DEI (Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion) is to create and sustain a one team culture globally with a mission to provide equal opportunity to people from diverse social, cultural, physical and psychological backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, national origin, sex, age, citizenship status, disability status, genetic information, sexual orientation, or gender identity or expression of an otherwise qualified individual, or membership in any other class protected by applicable law. Doceree fosters an inclusive culture by inculcating a sense of belonging within our ONE team through appropriate behaviours, policies and systems, while also being fair to one and all. To support this Doceree has taken formal strides with a 5C model and 4E's pledge, to ensure, encourage and exhibit our commitment to DEI, and move towards our DEI vision. **Apply for This Position** --------------------------- Ready to take the next step in your career? Share your details and resume below and our talent team will be in touch. Prefer email? Reach us at careers@doceree.com.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: Our Marine organization is a trusted provider of innovative solutions for the worldwide boating and boat building industry, and we recently expanded our scope to lead the boating industry into an electrified future. Dometic has won numerous NMMA Innovation Awards over the years, and we are always striving for new ways to make boating easier, safer, and more enjoyable. We are on a journey of continuous growth – now looking for our next star – a passionate **Mechanical Engineer**. This position reports to **Operations Manager** and will work in Stuart/Port St Lucie. As **Mechanical Engineer** of the Stuart team, you will be involved in product development including design, verification, validation, launch, and support of products and components primarily used in digital switching for OEM boat manufacturers. You will develop and evaluate mechanical and electromechanical products to meet cost and functional targets. ***Main responsibilities:*** * Design and assemble components including concept generation, 3D modeling, material selection, stress analysis, etc. * Research and develop system solutions for identified market opportunities * Prepare design documentation for new products and components such as drawings, engineering specifications, and test reports * Design products and components utilizing prescribed tools such as QFD, CAD, and DFMEA’s in accordance with ISO9001 requirements and procedures * Participate in the full development cycle including requirements analysis, design, development, implementation, validation, documentation, and on\-going support. * Work within multi\-function/new product development teams including program and product management, manufacturing, engineering, supply chain management, and production * Hold design reviews and conduct validation tests (salt spray, lifecycle, etc.). * Manage Bill of Materials for production assemblies * Participate in “make versus buy” decisions for components and/or assemblies * Develop project plans, coordinate activities, and report on project status * Build and maintain relationships with suppliers **What do we offer?** You are offered an interesting role in a dynamic, fast\-paced and global environment with great opportunities to grow, evolve with the company and take on new challenges. * Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Disability insurance (STD/LTD) * 401 (k) with company match * PTO * Company defined holidays and two floating holidays for you to use as you choose * Paid maternity/paternity leave * Tuition assistance * Membership reimbursement (wholesale club and gym) * Employee discounts on our incredible products * Opportunities to make an impact **Skills \& Requirements** A suitable background would be a solid experience within **Engineering** and **Manufacturing** as well as the following qualifications and experiences: * Undergraduate or graduate degree in Mechanical or Electromechanical Engineering * Well\-developed organizational skills with the ability to manage a variety of tasks * 2\+ years of Mechanical Design experience specializing in electro\-mechanical products * Proficient with Solid Works, Creo Parametric and PDMLink/Windchill or similar CAD suites * Strong proficiency with MS Office programs including * Familiar with volume production processes including casting, extrusions, powdered metals, injection molding, precision machining, sheet metal fabrication, and welding * Thorough knowledge of various materials and secondary coatings * Familiar with MRP systems to control engineering applications * Strong understanding of test methodology and design of experiments * Familiar with instrumentation, sensors, and test equipment * Working knowledge of safety regulations (UL, CSA, CE and other regulatory requirements) * Apply industry standards such as SAE, ASTM, ISO; familiarity with ISO9001 requirements * Familiarity with QFD, design, and process FMEAs To be successful in this role, we believe that you possess the following skills, competencies \& characteristics: * Strong written and verbal communication skills * Exemplary standards of ethics, integrity, and accountability * Detail oriented with strong organizational skills * Must have the ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines * Sense of urgency and self\-motivation * Able to work independently and in team environments * Must be able to solve complex situations and be resourceful * Must be able to teach and generate results while enhancing the Dometic work environment and supporting the Company philosophy **Dometic’s Core Values** To thrive and succeed in this role, you understand the importance of our core values – Together We build our future, We play to win, We embrace change and We walk the talk; these values reflect the heart and soul of Dometic and they define what it takes to work here and how we do things. **Are you our next star?** Then we would love to see your application. If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Lisa Mayes, Human Resources Manager, at lisa.mayes@dometic.com *Dometic is passionate about building together an inclusive and equitable working environment, that respects individual strengths, views, and experiences. Dometic evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, gender, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.* Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Product Technical Support Specialist
jobs.description: The Product Technical Support Specialist provides technical phone support to Customers, Third\-party Service Providers, and the Field Service team (customers) for issues that require in\-depth technical knowledge and/or access to the company’s engineering documentation and knowledge base. This role drives complete resolution to field based product issues. As a product expert with significant problem identification knowledge and product expertise, this role is expected to assess and address all incoming issues and as required, collaborate with other internal stakeholders where appropriate. As required the Specialist will review and correct electrical schematics issued by engineering prior to and after product build and installation. The Specialist leverages their expert experience with the products, in\-depth understanding of the products installation, operation, and application, and troubleshooting experience to resolve issues quickly. Inquiries may include troubleshooting, repair, and corrective maintenance advice related to controls, electrical, mechanical, piping, and electronics issues. Specialists must manage the customer to de\-escalate the situation while resolving the issue(s) or ensure a smooth hand off to other internal stakeholders. They will be accountable to address through resolution, critical customer issues and notify/inform supervision appropriately as issues need escalation. The Specialist manages customer relationships to boost customer retention and satisfaction while working closely with various internal departments to optimize service operations and uphold our commitment to customer satisfaction. This role may require work after normal business hours and weekends on occasion. #### **KEY DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES** * Being the first line of support and contact for customers with parts, service, or technical issues. a. Responds to customer inquiries, resolves issues, and escalates complex problems to the appropriate personnel. b. Troubleshoots equipment that is not functioning or not functioning as expected or built. c. Effectively provides customers with technical assistance with the proper operation and maintenance of the installed equipment. * Assists in resolving scheduling conflicts or emergencies that may arise during ThirdParty Service Provider service calls. * Assists the Douglas Field Service Technicians. a. Provides troubleshooting input to resolve issues with commissioning new machines and repairing existing machines b. Works closely with the Field Service Installation Coordinator to ensure necessary parts support is provided both before the engineer is dispatched and while they are onsite. * Proactively handles inbound calls, emails, and texts/chat to provide product technical support to customers and makes outbound calls, emails, and texts/chat in response to inquiries in a timely manner. * Utilizes business systems, MS Office software, and webbased software as required to provide quotes, place parts and service orders, advise of leadtimes, tracking information, and place order corrections. * Utilizes the SalesForce customer relationship management (CRM) system to document tech assist actions, assisting in maintaining equipment history. * Provides customers with technical drawings, parts lists, and manuals for customer specific machines a. Reviews and updates electrical schematics prior to and after product build and installation using AutoCAD. b. Reviews and provides inputs for machine technical manuals c. Creates and provides customers with spare parts lists by customer specific machines. d. Provides the customer with other documentation as required. * Works closely with departmental peers and utilizes skills obtained, documentation, and various methods to perform their role in delivering effective and efficient customer service. * On occasion assists in machine testing and factory acceptance tests (FAT). * Assist less experienced departmental Customer Service Representatives, as necessary. * Fosters clear communication between the various internal company departments (i.e., Engineering, Application Engineering, Procurement, Sales, Production, and Management). * Identifies areas for improvement and communicates them to supervision for review and implementation. * Maintains and prepares reports as requested by supervision. * Alerts supervisor when there is an absence of information or tools for completing their key responsibilities. #### **QUALIFICATIONS and TRAINING** * A high school/trade school diploma and a minimum of 4 years’ experience working on commercial or industrial equipment in the Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) facility or in the field and a minimum of 3 years’ experience relative to troubleshooting electrical control systems, conveying systems, and fluid flow systems. Industrial ware washing equipment experience is a plus. * An associate degree in mechatronics/mechanical engineering technology/electrical engineering technology is a plus * Understanding the theories of combustion, heat transfer, fluid distribution, hydraulic, pneumatic, conveyance, process controls, and electrical systems are required. * Ability to read engineering documents, including mechanical and electrical prints/schematics. * Experience with project management is a plus. * The ability to utilize AutoCAD to modify electrical diagrams/ schematics is a plus. * Ability to instruct customers to troubleshoot and diagnose problems with malfunctioning equipment using proper tools and testing apparatus. * Strong communication skills, both verbal and written. * Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and multitasking abilities. * Ability to work in a fastpaced environment and adapt to changing priorities. * Customerfocused with a commitment to providing excellent service. * Ability to be reliable, responsible, dependable, and fulfill obligations. * Ability to remain calm and make quick, informed decisions in highpressure situations. * Knowledge of the commercial or industrial equipment industry and service offerings is a plus. * Proficiency in Microsoft Suite Applications (Word \& Excel), as well as Internet software and Email, is required. * Proficiency in AutoCAD is a plus. * The employee is occasionally required to lift 50 pounds. * This position may require periodic travel (up to 25% of the time). * This position is not a fulltime remote position.

jobs.title: Senior Lead Site Reliability Engineer, Database
jobs.description: **About DraftKings** -------------------- At DraftKings, AI is becoming an integral part of both our present and future, powering how work gets done today, guiding smarter decisions, and sparking bold ideas. It’s transforming how we enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and unlock new possibilities. Our teams are energized by innovation and readily embrace emerging technology. We’re not waiting for the future to arrive. We’re shaping it, one bold step at a time. To those who see AI as a driver of progress, come build the future together. ### **The Crown Is Yours** As a Senior Lead Reliability Engineer, Database, you'll own the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of the database infrastructure powering one of the most demanding real time platforms in sports betting and gaming. In this role, you'll combine deep database expertise with software engineering and infrastructure automation to build resilient, self healing systems, improve platform performance, and drive reliability across cloud and on premises database environments. ### **What You'll Do** * Drive the technical roadmap for database reliability across PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, ScyllaDB, Aerospike, and managed cloud services, while shaping architecture for high availability, replication, partitioning, storage, and connection management. * Design and build automation first database platforms by developing Kubernetes operators, infrastructure as code, GitOps workflows, and production quality tooling in Go or Python to automate provisioning, failover, backups, schema migrations, and lifecycle management. * Lead operational excellence by defining service level objectives, monitoring database health, capacity, and performance, eliminating recurring reliability issues, validating backup and recovery processes, and leading critical production incidents through resolution and continuous improvement. * Optimize database performance and cost across cloud and on premises environments by driving capacity planning, resource efficiency, storage optimization, workload consolidation, and performance tuning for large scale systems. * Partner closely with application engineering teams to establish safe database practices, including schema reviews, migration strategies, query optimization, connection management, and zero downtime deployment processes. * Leverage AI to improve engineering productivity and database operations through intelligent observability, anomaly detection, root cause analysis, documentation, predictive insights, and evaluation of AI generated code to ensure reliability and security. * Mentor engineers across the organization by sharing best practices, leading design and code reviews, influencing technical direction, supporting hiring efforts, and raising the overall maturity of database reliability engineering. ### **What You'll Bring** * At least 6 years of experience in Database Reliability Engineering, Database Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering with a strong database focus, including technical leadership experience delivering complex database infrastructure projects at scale. * Deep expertise in at least one major relational database, preferably PostgreSQL, along with operational experience supporting technologies such as MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, ScyllaDB, Aerospike, Aurora, Cloud SQL, and other managed cloud database services. * Strong experience building and operating stateful workloads on Kubernetes using technologies such as StatefulSets, Persistent Volumes, database operators, Terraform, Pulumi, FluxCD, ArgoCD, GKE, and EKS. * Hands on software development experience using Go or Python to create automation, platform tooling, Kubernetes controllers, APIs, and infrastructure that reduces manual effort and improves engineering efficiency. * A data driven, automation first mindset with proven experience improving reliability through observability, monitoring, service level objectives, capacity planning, performance optimization, and self service engineering solutions. * Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, MCP, or similar technologies to improve design, coding, documentation, troubleshooting, and operational workflows while applying sound engineering judgment to validate AI generated outputs. * Excellent leadership and communication skills with a track record of mentoring engineers, influencing architectural decisions, collaborating across engineering teams, producing clear technical documentation, and driving continuous improvement in highly available production environments. ### **Join Our Team** We’re a publicly traded (NASDAQ: DKNG) technology company headquartered in Boston. As a regulated gaming company, you may be required to obtain a gaming license issued by the appropriate state agency as a condition of employment. Don’t worry, we’ll guide you through the process if this is relevant to your role. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is 168,000\.00 USD \- 210,000\.00 USD, plus bonus, equity, and benefits as applicable. Our ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The compensation information displayed on each job posting reflects the range for new hire pay rates for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range and how that was determined during the hiring process. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. **Ready to Own What's Next?** ----------------------------- We know finding a new job can be intimidating. Don't let imposter syndrome stop you from applying! Even if you don't think you tick off every box in this job description, we'd still love for you to apply or join our Talent Community. DraftKings is proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. We do not tolerate discrimination of any kind and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of your gender identity, race, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, status as a protected veteran, or status as an individual with a disability. jobs.title: Senior ERP Developer
jobs.description: Drew Marine is a global leader providing technical solutions and services to the marine industry with a comprehensive line of advanced marine chemicals, and equipment. Supported by a worldwide network of service engineers and a global supply chain delivering to more than 900 ports, we have a portfolio of products and services including: Water Treatment, Fuel Treatment, Maintenance Cleaners, Welding \& Refrigeration, Engineered Systems \& Products, Onboard Test Kits, and Analytical Services. Drew Marine offers a competitive compensation package with the following benefits: * Medical, vision, and dental insurance starting on day 1 * Drew Marine Employee Savings Plan – Current Employer Match is 100% of the first 5% contributed. * Company paid Life Insurance, Short Term Disability, and Long\-Term Disability * 26 Paid Days Off in the first year of employment (17 personal days \+ 9 holidays) * Community engagement and volunteer opportunities **Job Summary:** ================ The Senior ERP Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting JD Edwards solutions that meet business needs across Supply Chain and Finance. This role provides advanced technical expertise for JDE enhancements, implementations, and ongoing system maintenance while partnering with business stakeholders and cross\-functional teams. We are looking for an advanced\-level technology professional with strong JD Edwards EnterpriseOne (JDE E1\) ERP development experience. Exposure to modern ERP systems such as SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion Cloud, or similar platforms is considered a strong advantage. The ideal candidate demonstrates a hard\-working mentality, flexibility, a team\-player attitude, and excellent communication skills. **Principal Duties and Responsibilities:** * Provide advanced\-level expertise by consulting with internal and external stakeholders to resolve issues and address new functional business requirements through JDE system development. * Conduct feasibility analysis for requested enhancements and developments to ensure alignment with business needs within the JD Edwards environment. * Execute development activities across all phases of system implementation, including the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile Scrum methodologies. * Work both independently and collaboratively with cross\-functional teams to deliver projects on time and within budget. * Develop and maintain detailed technical specifications and documentation to support JDE implementations, enhancements, and ongoing maintenance in an efficient and effective manner. * Apply functional knowledge of Supply Chain and Finance domains to design and deliver effective ERP solutions that meet business requirements. * Share knowledge and expertise to support the IT team in driving business value through JD Edwards and modern ERP solutions. **Required / Desired Knowledge, Experiences and Skills:** * Strong Knowledge of JDE Development Toolsets (9\.0\) in the areas of Object Management Workbench (OMW), Object Librarian (OL), Data Dictionary (DD), Table Browser, Debugging Tools, Forms, UBE (reports), Named Event Rule (NER), and Business Functions and Processing Options * In addition to the standard Development Toolsets, experience with JDE Workflow and C programming experience and SQL procedures is a plus * BI Publisher or Bottomline Transform experience is required. * Need to have the knowledge to maintain JDE Security, Job Scheduler, DSI administrator and JDE System Administration with understanding the CNC process. * Very good written and verbal communication skills and can work with all levels of the company * Strong experience with JDE or similar ERP required **Education/Certifications:** * College degree preferred **Physical Working Environment:** This role is based in a climate\-controlled office environment and involves prolonged periods of sitting. The position requires onsite presence five days per week (5 days in office). Occasional travel to Drew Marine’s international regional offices may be required, as dictated by project requirements. The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees so classified. ***Drew Marine is a global leader providing technical solutions and services to the marine industry with a comprehensive line of advanced marine chemicals, and equipment. Supported by a worldwide network of service engineers, and global supply chain delivering to more than 900 ports, we have a portfolio of products and services including: Water Treatment, Fuel Treatment, Maintenance Cleaners, Welding \& Refrigeration, Engineered Systems \& Products, Onboard Test Kits, and Analytical Services***

jobs.title: Customer Success Lead
jobs.description: **About Dust** ============== **Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.** With enterprise\-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest\-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%\+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. **We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.** We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026\. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50\. **Summary** =========== As Dust’s first dedicated US Customer Success leader, you will build the post\-sales motion for one of our most important growth markets. You will begin as a player\-coach: personally owning a focused portfolio of strategic customers, leading the coordination of CSMs, Deployment Strategists, and Solutions Engineers, and partnering closely with Sales and Product to drive adoption, retention, and expansion. You will start close to the customer and close to the work, building conviction about what great post\-sales looks like at Dust. You will then turn those learnings into the operating rhythms, segmentation, playbooks, and team needed to scale. This is an opportunity to define how Customer Success works at a fast\-growing, AI\-native company, not simply inherit an existing process. **What you'll do** ================== **Own the US customer\-success motion** --------------------------------------- * Define and lead the Customer Success approach for Dust’s US customers. * Establish how we segment customers and determine the right level of engagement for each account. * Coordinate CSMs, Deployment Strategists, Solutions Engineers, and other post\-sales partners around shared customer outcomes. * Create the operating rhythms that keep the team aligned on adoption, customer health, renewals, escalations, and expansion. * Make clear prioritization and resourcing decisions as customer needs evolve. **Personally own strategic customers** -------------------------------------- * Manage a focused portfolio of strategic and high\-complexity accounts. * Build trusted relationships with users, champions, technical stakeholders, and executive sponsors. * Lead customers from deployment through adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion. * Develop clear success plans tied to the customer’s business priorities and measurable outcomes. * Serve as the senior escalation point for high\-stakes customer situations. * Bring firsthand customer context into decisions about product, process, and team priorities. **Build the US post\-sales playbook** ------------------------------------- * Define what great post\-sales delivery looks like across the customer lifecycle. * Improve the transition from Sales to Customer Success, including handoff quality, stakeholder mapping, use\-case definition, and success criteria. * Identify patterns across accounts and turn what works into repeatable playbooks. * Create practical approaches to customer health, risk management, executive engagement, adoption, and expansion. * Use Dust and other AI tools to increase the leverage of the Customer Success team. **Develop the team** -------------------- * Coach CSMs and Deployment Strategists to raise the quality of customer work across the board * Help define the roles, capabilities, and hiring plan required for the next stage of the US post\-sales organization. * Evolve from execution\-heavy to strategy\-heavy as the team grows building an organization that can operate independently * Create an environment where people develop faster than they would anywhere else **Partner cross\-functionally with Sales and Product** ------------------------------------------------------ * Work closely with AEs to align pre\- and post\-sales motions and unlock expansion opportunities * Represent the voice of the US customer internally with clarity and conviction * Surface recurring customer needs and product gaps, and help Product prioritize them. * Contribute to how Dust thinks about customer value, retention, and growth at a company level. **Requirements** ---------------- Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency. **Aptitude** ------------ * **Has been an excellent Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, or Post\-Sales Leader**, with strong judgment across account strategy, executive communication, discovery, value articulation, adoption planning, stakeholder management, renewal strategy, and expansion. * **Has owned strategic B e with technical products and complex customer environments,** and can translate between business priorities, product capabilities, and operational execution. * **Uses AI tools actively in their own work** and can identify practical ways to create leverage across the Customer Success motion. **Attitude** ------------ * **Treats customer outcomes as the north star,** not activity metrics, and builds trust through preparation, clarity, follow\-through, and honest communication. * **Surfaces risks and difficult information early,** and collaborates naturally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and other teams around shared customer outcomes. * **Is comfortable operating in a fluid, cross\-functional environment** where titles do not determine contribution. * **Develops the people around them** through coaching, direct feedback, and example, while maintaining high standards in a rapidly evolving company. **Agency** ---------- * **Is willing to stay close to the work,** personally own strategic accounts, and engage directly in complex customer situations. * **Can define and build the US post\-sales model without waiting for a complete blueprint,** turning customer patterns into repeatable processes and playbooks. * **Makes prioritization and resourcing decisions autonomously,** balancing customer urgency, strategic value, commercial importance, and team capacity. * **Finds ways to create customer outcomes** with limited resources and imperfect information, and treats the player\-coach phase as an opportunity to build conviction and organizational leverage. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- * Competitive compensation: $260,000–$340,000 OTE * Significant equity package in a Sequoia\-backed startup * Health insurance for you and your dependents * New MacBook Pro or Linux machine, monitor, keyboard, etc. * Beautiful office in the heart of SoHo (NYC) * Opportunity to travel to Paris multiple times a year * Regular team events and offsites **Location** ============ We're prioritizing building our team with an in\-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office\-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. **Why Dust** ============ The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. *Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.* **Learn how we think and work.** * Our product constitution, *a story about our mission* * Agents at work \- Latent Space, podcast with our cofounder, Stanislas Polu, 2024 * LLMs reasoning and agentic capabilities over time \- dotAI, podcast with our cofounder, Stanislas Polu, 2024 Compensation Range: $260K \- $340K

This is a senior position in which you’ll operate as if a co\-founder, working alongside an experienced sales leader, of an effective startup moving from 0 \-\> 1 within our broader org, aiming to deploy our voice AI technology at the most Strategic customers in the market against their most challenging problems. All the while you’ll be able to leverage support from the rest of ElevenLabs to accelerate. You will be responsible for hiring the team you need, winning the first customers in the market and ensuring that our product generates impact for them. No two days are the same, but you should expect to: * Meet with strategic customers to understand their critical audio and voice AI needs and locate their biggest pain points. * Build and lead a team of forward deployed engineers within the region. * Identify relevant use cases through deep engagement with customer problems and workflows, and work with Engineers to implement our voice and audio AI technology into innovative solutions. * Design and architect bespoke integrations for customers, ensuring our technology fits seamlessly into their products and operations. * Guide customers on best practices for implementing our voice and audio AI models to maximize their effectiveness. * Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from technical teams to jobs.title: Senior Real-Time Software Developer
jobs.description: Are you a software engineer who is excited by the challenge of building both embedded firmware and user\-facing applications that power industrial automation systems? Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you. We are looking for curious, motivated engineers who enjoy working across the full software stack, from real\-time controller firmware running on Linux and VxWorks RTOS to workstation applications used by engineers to configure, program, visualize, and manage industrial automation systems. Based in Austin, Texas, you will join a diverse community and work as a contributing member of a cross\-functional Agile team focused on the development of Emerson's PACSystems technologies. PACSystems is trusted by leading companies across discrete and hybrid manufacturing industries to safely and reliably control critical processes. In this role, you will contribute to both the embedded controller platform and the engineering software tools that interact with PACSystems controllers. Your work may include PLC programming capabilities, deterministic control execution, industrial communications, diagnostics, configuration, visualization, and management workflows used in demanding industrial environments. You will contribute to the design and development of next\-generation PACSystems software capabilities across embedded and workstation layers. Our work includes C and C\+\+ software development, real\-time distributed computing, Linux and VxWorks RTOS environments, workstation application development, and systems where timing, reliability, usability, and predictable behavior are critical. Our team also embraces modern development practices, including automated testing, AI\-assisted development, and spec\-driven methods that improve quality and reduce ambiguity. You will be part of an organization led by leaders who are deeply committed to technical excellence, Agile principles, mentorship, and building an environment where engineers do their best work. Take part in Hackathons, Tech Talks, and Communities of Practice with like\-minded engineers. * **Learn from Domain Experts** \- Work alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and subject matter experts in industrial automation to build your understanding of the domain and learn how real\-world requirements translate into software. * **Contribute to Specifications** \- Support the authoring and review of structured software specifications, gaining hands\-on experience with spec\-driven development practices and AI\-assisted development workflows. * **Innovate** \- Write software using modern tools, frameworks, and AI\-enabled development practices. Learn to apply spec\-driven methodologies to improve quality, reduce ambiguity, and accelerate your own delivery. * **Automate** \- Write automated unit tests and contribute to system\-level testing to support a healthy automation pipeline and a release\-ready product. * Iterate \- Actively participate in team retrospectives and bring ideas for how the team can improve its processes and ways of working. * **Tech Savvy** — Stay curious about emerging technologies, AI development tooling, and spec\-driven methodologies, and look for opportunities to apply new skills to real problems. * **Always Curious** — Ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take time to understand the problem before diving into solutions. You are comfortable moving between low\-level firmware development and higher\-level workstation application software. jobs.title: AI Engineer Internship | Undergraduate or Graduate - Summer 2027
jobs.description: **ABOUT THE ROLE:** Endeavor's Platform team builds the data, tools, and AI infrastructure that powers our global network across 50\+ markets. With Claude Enterprise now deployed to 390\+ staff across 43\+ markets, access to AI is no longer our constraint. The next challenge is organizational: converting that access into institutional capabilities that one team can build, another market can reuse, and Endeavor retains when people move on. We're looking for a **curious, hands\-on, builder\-minded intern** to help create Endeavor's **AI organizational infrastructure**: the reusable capabilities, templates, governance rails, and enablement systems that let our local offices and functional teams design their own AI\-augmented processes safely and effectively, instead of 50 markets reinventing the same tools in isolation. This is not a shadowing role. It is a hybrid role between discovery and applied AI engineering. You will interview local offices and functional departments to understand their workflows and what infrastructure they actually need, and you will get your hands dirty: prototyping agentic workflows, Claude skills, MicroApps, and retrieval systems on Endeavor's enterprise AI stack (Claude Enterprise, MCP integrations, Snowflake, Salesforce, and Notion). You will also support the Platform team's deeper work on knowledge capture and institutional memory, helping turn the network's interactions into structured, trusted, actionable knowledge. By the end of the internship, you'll have shipped real capabilities used by teams across markets, creating a tangible output with lasting impact on how nearly 500 Endeavor colleagues work worldwide. This internship is ideal for someone excited by applied AI, organizational systems, and building things that scale globally, while gaining real responsibility and visibility inside a mission\-driven organization. ##### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Responsibility \#1: Discover What Teams Actually Need** + Lead structured interviews with local offices and functional departments to map their workflows, pain points, and existing AI experiments. Find where a shared, governed capability would beat fifty isolated ones, and identify what infrastructure, training, or guardrails each team needs to build effectively on their own. * **Responsibility \#2: Build Reusable AI Capabilities** + Prototype agentic workflows, Claude skills, MicroApps, and retrieval features on our enterprise stack (Claude Enterprise, MCP, APIs), always choosing the lightest technical pattern that supports the behavior we want. Package what works so another market can adopt it without rebuilding it. * **Responsibility \#3: Create the Enablement Infrastructure** + Help create the templates, playbooks, starter kits, and documentation that let teams self\-serve: how to build a skill, an Artifact, a plugin, etc.; how to connect to governed data and use our MCPs; and how to stay within Endeavor's AI Policy. Make the right way the easy way. * **Responsibility \#4: Support Knowledge Capture \& Institutional Memory** + Support the Platform team's work on turning captured knowledge (meetings, founder ratings, network interactions) into structured, actionable intelligence, including retrieval pipelines and early knowledge graph work that makes institutional memory usable at the moment of key decisions. * **Responsibility \#5: Govern and Evaluate What You Ship** + Define what "working" means for the capabilities you build: success metrics, output quality checks, and simple eval loops. Contribute everything to Endeavor's AI Registry so it is human\-owned, tracked, permission\-aware, and auditable in line with Endeavor's AI Policy. ##### **SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS \- WHO YOU ARE** * **Student Status:** Undergraduate Junior or Senior, or Graduate student in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field; candidates from other disciplines with relevant skills and demonstrated building experience are encouraged to apply. * **Interests / Areas of Focus:** + Strong interest in applied AI and how organizations, not just individuals, adopt it: workflows, governance, change management, and knowledge systems. + Hands\-on experience building with LLMs beyond casual chatting: class projects, hackathons, or personal projects involving prompting, agents, RAG, or API integrations (Anthropic/Claude, OpenAI, or similar). Fluency with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) is a strong plus. Things you have shipped matter more than credentials. + Working knowledge of Python or TypeScript/JavaScript and basic SQL, enough to build a prototype and query data with AI assistance. + Ability to understand technical architectures (APIs, databases, retrieval systems) and explain them clearly to non\-technical colleagues; much of this role is translating between technical and non\-technical worlds. + Exceptional written and verbal communication with an analytical\-first mindset; comfortable asking "why" to get to the root of a problem and turning research into actionable recommendations. + Comfortable working in a multilingual, global, cross\-cultural environment and incorporating feedback from multiple stakeholders. + Nice to have: familiarity with Git, Snowflake, Salesforce, Notion, or workflow automation tools; interest in entrepreneurship or the startup ecosystem. * **Must be legally eligible to work in the U.S. We will not be able to interview or select candidates without valid U.S. work authorization for the 2027 year.** ##### **HIRING TIMELINE** * **Applications close:** October 7, 2026 at 11:59pm * **Interview process:** + **I****nitial Phone Screen:** A 30\-minute introductory conversation with a member of the Platform team to discuss your background and interest in the role. + **Final Interview:** A 1\-hour deep dive with the Hiring Manager covering discovery thinking, research methodology, and technical literacy, plus a short practical exercise. Using AI tools during the exercise is expected and encouraged; we want to see how you drive them. * **Offer extension:** November 16, 2026 #### **INTERNSHIP PROGRAM OVERVIEW** **The Endeavor Summer Internship Program**gives students 10 weeks to do more than just watch from the sidelines. You'll be put side by side with our Headquarters teams in NYC, San Francisco, London, Dubai, or Singapore, owning meaningful projects that move Endeavor forward. You'll contribute to real work from day one, and by the end of the summer, you'll present it directly to our CEO. Along the way you’ll get access most internships can’t offer, including fireside chats with our CEO, candid conversations with category\-defining Endeavor Entrepreneurs, and face time with executives across our global HQ. You’ll leave with new skills, relationships across 50\+ countries, and a much deeper understanding of how entrepreneurship works around the world. **This is your front\-row seat to how a global organization helps ambitious entrepreneurs build, scale, and shape what’s next.** * **Program Duration:** June 7th, 2027 to August 13th 2027 * **Pay:** New York State minimum wage ($17/hr), up to 40 hours/week * **Structure:** This is a hybrid internship in New York City, with three days per week to be spent at Endeavor Global’s HQ office in Downtown Manhattan * Read more about out program here #### **ABOUT ENDEAVOR** **WHO WE ARE:** Endeavor is the leading network of entrepreneurs scaling exceptional businesses around the world. **OUR MISSION:** We exist to develop thriving entrepreneurial ecosystems in places where talent is abundant, but capital and opportunity are not. **OUR MODEL:** At Endeavor we: * **Select** the highest\-potential scale\-up founders as Endeavor Entrepreneurs (EEs), including some of the fastest\-growing AI companies in our markets. * **Support** EEs through pivotal moments as they go big. * Invest in EEs through our pioneering co\-investment fund, Endeavor Catalyst, with $840M\+ AUM across five funds. * **Elevate** the top entrepreneurs as role models. * **Advance** the field of global entrepreneurship through data\-driven research and thought leadership, including measuring entrepreneurs’ Multiplier Effects across ecosystems. Endeavor Entrepreneurs (EEs) prove that category\-defining companies can come from anywhere in the world. Since our founding 29 years ago, Endeavor has selected 3,100\+ Endeavor Entrepreneurs across 50\+ countries, including the founders of 100\+ Unicorns (companies valued at $1B\+)

jobs.title: Vibration Analyst - Salt Lake City
jobs.description: **Why Join EMC?** At EMC, we provide comprehensive electrical and reliability solutions spanning motors, variable frequency drives (VFDs), and power generation systems. With more than 40 years of experience, we've earned a reputation for technical expertise, strong customer partnerships, and dependable performance. Our culture is grounded in three core values: supporting one another, continuously improving, and achieving results together. If you want your work to directly influence equipment reliability and customer success, EMC offers that opportunity. We offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life insurance; short\- and long\-term disability protection; a 401(k) plan with a 3% company match; as well as generous paid time off and holiday leave. **The Opportunity** We are seeking Vibration Analysts (Category II or Category III) to join our expanding reliability team. In these roles, you will help customers prevent equipment failures, extend asset life, and enhance operational performance through condition monitoring and predictive maintenance. You'll collaborate with maintenance teams, engineers, and operations leaders\-both in the field and remotely\-across multiple facilities**.** **Vibration Analyst – ISO Category II** **Position Summary** Support predictive maintenance (PdM) and reliability efforts through vibration data collection, analysis, and reporting on rotating equipment. **Key Responsibilities** * Collect and analyze vibration data using portable and online systems * Perform remote monitoring across multiple customer sites * Ensure data integrity, sensor performance, and route compliance * Interpret FFT spectra, time waveforms, and trends to identify common faults (imbalance, misalignment, looseness, bearing defects) * Maintain data collection routes and schedules * Set up basic alarm limits and measurement parameters * Generate clear reports with actionable maintenance recommendations * Assist in managing PdM programs and maintaining database accuracy * Communicate findings with maintenance and operations teams **Qualifications** * ISO 18436\-2 Category II certification * Solid understanding of vibration fundamentals and rotating equipment * Experience with condition monitoring tools and data collectors * Basic knowledge of alignment and balancing * Ability to interpret vibration data and trends * Strong communication and reporting skills **Vibration Analyst – ISO Category III** **Position Summary** Lead and enhance predictive maintenance and reliability programs through advanced vibration analysis, remote monitoring, and technical leadership. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead remote monitoring and oversight of vibration assets across sites * Manage and optimize PdM programs, including strategy and alarm development * Perform advanced analysis (FFT, waveform, phase, orbit, modal, resonance) * Diagnose complex issues such as gear faults, resonance, structural, and fluid\-related problems * Conduct and lead root cause failure analysis (RCFA) * Integrate additional technologies (oil analysis, thermography, ultrasound) * Establish standards, processes, and best practices * Mentor and develop junior analysts * Act as the primary technical contact for customers * Deliver in\-depth technical reports and strategic recommendations **Qualifications** * ISO 18436\-2 Category III certification * Advanced knowledge of vibration theory and machinery dynamics * Experience with online monitoring systems and analysis software * Demonstrated ability to lead and manage PdM programs * Strong leadership, communication, and customer\-facing skills

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer - Hardware
jobs.description: **About Etched** Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co\-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best\-in\-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on **inference**. Backed by hundreds of millions from top\-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history. **Job Summary** Designing frontier AI hardware means solving electrical and mechanical problems together: schematics and board layouts, power delivery and signal integrity, packaging and cooling, manufacturing and assembly. Every decision changes the constraints on the next. Future breakthroughs will come from AI systems that can reason across these domains, operate engineering tools, run thousands of experiments, and learn which designs work in the physical world. You will build those systems. Your mandate is to build agents that take electrical and mechanical designs from requirements through verified, manufacturable outputs. These agents should create and modify CAD models, design schematics and PCB layouts, run simulations, diagnose failures, and iterate with our engineers, pushing the limits of how much of the design process AI can own end to end. Etched offers a uniquely tight research loop: chips, boards, racks, cooling systems, manufacturing, and dedicated in\-office compute under one roof. By architecting and orchestrating agent loops, you will turn proprietary designs, simulation results, engineering decisions, and physical test data into systems that get better with every experiment—and ship the hardware they help design. **Key Responsibilities** * Build and own AI systems that turn engineering requirements into verified electrical and mechanical designs, carrying intent and constraints from initial concepts through manufacturing outputs. * Build agents that operate CAD, EDA, and simulation tools to generate designs, run experiments, inspect results, diagnose problems, and iterate with our teams, to the limits of model autonomy. * Develop workflows spanning component selection, schematic capture, PCB layout, mechanical CAD, assemblies, thermal analysis, and electrical and structural simulation. * Build the tool integrations and representations agents need to reason about geometry, connectivity, materials, tolerances, and coupled electrical, mechanical, thermal, and manufacturing constraints. * Design evals that measure engineering correctness, constraint satisfaction, simulation accuracy, manufacturability, and performance on real design tasks. * Turn simulation outputs, design\-rule checks, engineering reviews, and physical measurements into structured feedback models can learn from. * Curate proprietary datasets and design memory from complete trajectories, expert demonstrations, failed approaches, and manufactured outcomes. * Build reproducible experiment infrastructure so design revisions, tool actions, simulation settings, and results remain traceable and experiments can run at scale. * Ship agent\-generated designs with our electrical, mechanical, and manufacturing teams, and quantify improvements in design cycle time, hardware performance, and engineering effort. * Continuously evaluate new model releases and deploy the best models and methods for each stage of the design loop. **You may be a good fit if you have (Must\-have qualifications)** * A track record of solving hard problems across stacks and domains—you enjoy being dropped into unfamiliar territory and figuring it out. * Hands\-on experience building and shipping LLM\-based agents or AI tooling that people depend on: context engineering, tool integration, orchestration, evaluation, and failure analysis. * Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python. You can build reliable integrations with complex engineering tools, debug unfamiliar systems, and direct AI to write code well. We do not care whether you write code from scratch—we care whether you ship things that work. * Interest, experience, or an academic exposure to in electrical or mechanical engineering, or a record of learning a technical domain deeply enough to build useful tools for its practitioners. You can reason about physical constraints and distinguish a plausible design from a verified one. * Fluency using AI to learn and ramp on new problems—agentic coding tools, deep research, and frontier models are how you work, not an add\-on. * An eval\-driven mindset: you measure whether AI systems work, investigate where they fail, and use those failures to improve them. * Comfort moving between research exploration, agentic experimentation, engineering\-tool debugging, and production execution. **Strong candidates may also have experience with (Nice\-to\-have qualifications)** * High agency and comfort with ambiguity—you find the real problem to solve. * Automating CAD or EDA tools through APIs, scripting, plugins, or GUI interaction. * Schematic design, PCB layout, component selection, power delivery, or signal and power integrity. * Parametric CAD, mechanical assemblies, tolerance analysis, thermal management, CFD, or FEA. * Design optimization, constraint solving, or search over large engineering design spaces. * Fine\-tuning or post\-training models using tool\-use trajectories, simulation feedback, or expert demonstrations. * Multimodal reasoning over engineering drawings, schematics, geometry, and simulation results. * Taking hardware through fabrication, assembly, bring\-up, and testing, and understanding where simulation and physical behavior diverge. **Benefits** * Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage + $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits * Housing subsidy of $2,500 per month for those living within walking distance of the office * Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row) * Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more * Daily lunch and dinner in our office * Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification **Base Compensation Range** * $150K – $250K * Plus Significant Equity **How we’re different** Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We are the first inference\-focused frontier AI system, betting early on transformer and transformer\-like architectures and on increasing model sizes. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors. We are a fully in\-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

jobs.title: Associate Web Development Software Engineer (SDK)
jobs.description: *Eulerity is a fast\-growing marketing technology company transforming how franchises and small businesses approach digital advertising. Built by former leaders from Google, Facebook, and Yahoo!, our platform combines decades of experience in engineering and marketing to deliver an industry\-leading, automated solution. We make it easy to plan, launch, and analyze paid campaigns across Google Search, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Display, Video, and organic social \- all from one intuitive platform. We believe breakthrough results happen when technology, strategy, and creativity come together. By combining automation with human insight, we empower brands to scale smarter, move faster, and grow stronger. Internally, we're just as committed to growth. We cultivate a culture where ambitious, curious, and driven individuals are empowered to lead, learn, and elevate those around them.* **Your Role** * Designing, building, and shipping **developer\-facing SDKs** consumed by other engineers. * Owning the SDK as a product: the public API surface, TypeScript types, semantic versioning, packaging/distribution, backwards compatibility, and documentation. * Building and maintaining AI\-powered automation workflows that connect our product to internal and external systems. * Developing and testing new features using AI\-assisted tooling and autonomous agents, maintaining the codebase, integrating with APIs and data models, and owning the PR lifecycle (writing, reviewing, and incorporating feedback). * Collaborating across web, mobile, and backend teams to align on best practices, shared architecture, and product direction. * Partnering with Product and Design to translate designs and prototypes into shipped solutions for our users and the engineers who build on our SDK. **About You** * **SDK/library builder.** You design clean, intuitive, hard\-to\-misuse APIs and think about the developer on the other side of your interface. * **AI\-first engineer.** You've set up custom automation workflows (e.g., wiring Claude or similar LLMs into forms, APIs, or internal tools to replace manual work). * A self\-starter who can take ownership of a project and work independently and collaboratively. * Rigorous about reviewing AI\-generated output and taking full ownership of the code you ship. * Good attention to detail and initiative. * Strong written and verbal communication skills — including the ability to document an SDK so another engineer can succeed with it. **Requirements** * **Proven experience designing and shipping a developer\-facing SDK, library, or public API consumed by other engineers** — including the public API/interface design, semantic versioning, and backwards\-compatibility discipline that come with it. * **Strong separation\-of\-concerns judgment** — able to design framework\-agnostic core logic (data, state, domain types) cleanly decoupled from thin, framework\-specific bindings, so the same core can support multiple front\-end frameworks over time. * Experience packaging and distributing libraries: bundling (e.g., tsup, Rollup, Vite), ESM/CJS output, tree\-shaking and bundle\-size awareness, and npm publishing. * **2–3 years of professional experience with React \& TypeScript**, including building reusable, composable components and using strong types as a public contract. * Well\-versed in building custom AI automation workflows (LLM API integrations, agentic tooling, or similar). * Solid understanding of fundamentals (HTML/CSS/JavaScript, working with APIs). * Familiarity with standard engineering workflows (PRs, code review, agile). * Strong written communication, including clear technical documentation. * Based in the NYC Metro Area and able to work hybrid from our NYC office 3x per week. * Authorized to work in the US. **A Strong Plus** * Experience building **embeddable / third\-party components** — style and CSS isolation (shadow DOM or scoped styles), theming and customization, and secure auth/token handling inside a host app. * Monorepo and release tooling (e.g., Changesets, Turborepo, Nx) and automated CI release pipelines. * Backend / full\-stack work (Java). * Technical writing and developer documentation experience. **Benefits:** * Comprehensive benefits + Medical + Dental + Vision * ️ Unlimited PTO * ️ In\-office lunch stipend * Commuter benefits * 401(k) with company match * Hybrid model (3x in office per week) * Summer Fridays **Compensation:** Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our company's size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes benefits, perks and other opportunities at Eulerity. The expected range for this role is $100,000 \- $125,000, commensurate with experience and level. \*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\* ***IMPORTANT*** ***PLEASE FILL THIS FORM TO COMPLETE YOUR APPLICATION*** ***\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\****

jobs.title: Software Engineer, New Products
jobs.description: EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more. We are one of the fastest\-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com. In the past year, our engineering and data science team grew from 40 to 100\+ team members and we rolled out infrastructure updates, new products, and updates to existing workflows \- combining data, ML frontend and backend work. The next 12 months are very exciting for us; we expect the technical team to double as we deliver on a roadmap to handle 10x our current volume and build new products. As a Software Engineer on our New Products team, you’ll be responsible for helping build and launch brand new products that directly impact our customers' workflows \- which in turn has the opportunity to impact millions of lives in the personal injury space. **This is a hybrid role with the expectation of working at least 3 days a week from our downtown San Francisco hub.** **What you’ll do:** * **Build impactful technology**: You will build first\-of\-a\-kind technology that will transform an analog industry to improve the lives of millions of injury victims that got their lives turned upside down at no fault of their own. * **Have immediate impact in a small and tightly\-knit team**: be a key part of building the foundational blocks of their software and the team culture. Start shipping production code in less than two weeks! * **Be a core part of our engineering team**: Be a key part of building the foundational blocks of EvenUp's software and the team culture. Build and deploy and work on our core software product, whereby you’ll tackle hard problems, explore and deliver solutions while working with key people across the organization. * **Work with a world\-class team**: Our team has deep expertise in technology, machine learning, law, and finance, combining experiences from careers at Google, Uber, Waymo, Quora, Vimeo, Blizzard, and more. * **Learn new technologies from the best**: Our team emphasizes a culture of continual learning and you will have opportunities to work on projects in machine learning, data engineering, back\-end, front\-end, DevOps. * **Work with our tech\-stack**: Python, Typescript, React, Postgres, Kubernetes, Elasticsearch. **What we look for:** * 5\-10\+ years of experience with backend or frontend engineering, working with relational databases and/or other database technologies \- **we're hiring frontend, backend, and full\-stack engineers for this team!** * Have several years of industry experience building high\-quality software, shipping production\-ready code and infrastructure. * Ability to communicate technical ideas or issues in easy\-to\-understand and actionable terms. * Learn quickly and are seeking opportunities to work cross\-functionally (including data engineering \& DevOps) and with a diverse group of people. * Experience owning a project from start to finish and loves to drive a project across the finish line. * Demonstrated success in mentoring and upleveling teammates. * Engineering excellence \- you’ve helped build what “great” looks like at scale (both product \+ team culture). * Kubernetes experience is a plus! **Benefits \& Perks:** As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including: * Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family. * Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness. * Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short\-term and long\-term disability. * 10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province. * A home office stipend. * 401(k) for US\-based employees and RRSP for Canada\-based employees. * Paid parental leave. * A local in\-person meet\-up program. * Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto. *(Please note the above benefits \& perks are for full\-time employees)* ***Notice to Candidates:*** *To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our* *careers page**.* *Please note that EvenUp may use AI notetakers and other recording devices in the recruiting process. jobs.description: **Position Type :** Full time**Type Of Hire :** Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)**Job Description** We are FIS. If you’re ready to start learning, growing and making an impact with a career in fintech, we’d like to know: Are you FIS? **What’s it like to work on our team?** Our Platform and Product Engineering team is composed of technical Swiss army knives whose combined ability to craft new capabilities in a rapid, prototype\-oriented environment sharpens the overall quality standards of FIS\-TSYS Issuing. Every member of our hard\-working collective is truly spearheading the evolution of fintech, meaning that every day you’ll be in lockstep with the history\-makers and future\-builders of this industry. jobs.description: ### **Description** Fehr Graham is a leading engineering and environmental firm with a passion for helping communities thrive. Our team of experts works collaboratively across disciplines to improve quality of life for our clients and the communities we serve. **What’s in it for you?** We offer an exciting and engaging work environment where every day brings new challenges and opportunities. At Fehr Graham, we don’t just manage projects – we bring them to life! This position will put you in the driver’s seat to help steer our water resources projects. If you have a passion for transforming concepts into tangible achievements and hope to accelerate your career, we want you on our team. **Where you’ll work** The position is based in our East Peoria, IL office. We also believe in work\-life balance, and that includes injecting a healthy dose of fun into everything we do. It’s even part of our Core Values!
