jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Director-Records & Tax Platforms (Remote)
jobs.description: **Staff Engineer, Director — Records \& Tax Platforms** ------------------------------------------------------- ### **About Neumo** Neumo builds the cloud software that powers government. More than 4,500 state, local, and federal agencies across North America run on our platforms, processing over 900 million transactions and collecting $44 billion in revenue for the communities they serve. When a county records a deed, a family orders a birth certificate, or a business files a local tax return, that transaction often runs through our systems. That comes with a particular kind of engineering responsibility. Our platforms are systems of record for legally binding documents and public funds. Correctness is not negotiable, downtime has civic consequences, and the data we hold is expected to remain accurate and retrievable for decades. ### **The Role** We're hiring a Staff Engineer to serve as the senior\-most technical individual contributor across our Records and Tax platforms. You'll own the technical direction of two platform families that share deep infrastructure but serve distinct agency workflows, and you'll be accountable for how well they're engineered. This includes architecture, standards, resiliency, and performance. This is a pure IC role at director level, reporting to the VP of Engineering. Your influence comes from technical judgment, written clarity, and the trust of the engineers and leaders you work with. You'll partner closely with engineering managers, product, and security, but you will not carry direct reports. This role is fully remote. Because much of your impact will come through written architecture work and asynchronous influence across distributed teams, we're looking for someone who communicates exceptionally well in writing and builds trust without relying on hallway time. We're looking for someone who is energized rather than deterred by legacy. Much of what we're modernizing has been running in production for years and cannot be broken. The interesting problem here is raising the bar on live, high\-consequence systems, not designing on a blank page. ### **What You'll Do** **Architecture and design** * Own the target architecture for the Records and Tax platforms, including how they share services, data models, and infrastructure with the broader Neumo platform. * Lead design reviews for significant changes, and set the bar for what a good design document looks like here. * Drive multi\-quarter modernization work, decomposing legacy components, defining service boundaries, and sequencing migrations so agencies experience no disruption. * Make and document consequential build/buy/refactor decisions, including the trade\-offs you rejected. **Engineering standards and practices** * Define and evolve engineering standards across both platforms: code quality, testing strategy, API design, data modeling, observability, deployment, and technical documentation. * Make standards real rather than aspirational through tooling, automated checks, templates, and paved paths that make the right approach the easy one. * Raise the quality of code review and technical decision\-making across teams by participating directly and by coaching senior engineers. **Resiliency and performance** * Set availability, latency, and durability targets appropriate to each workload, and define the SLOs and error budgets that hold us to them. * Lead architecture for fault tolerance, graceful degradation, disaster recovery, and data integrity, including recovery objectives for systems of record that must survive far longer than any single application. * Plan capacity for the seasonal load our platforms face: tax filing deadlines, recording volume spikes, and end\-of\-period reconciliation. * Own performance engineering practice including load testing, profiling, query optimization, and the instrumentation needed to diagnose issues in production. * Lead or advise on major incident response and post\-incident review, and make sure findings turn into durable fixes. **Security, compliance, and data stewardship** * Partner with Security and Compliance to embed requirements into architecture rather than bolting them on. This includes access control, auditability, data retention, redaction of sensitive record data, and payment\-adjacent controls. * Design for the regulatory reality of public\-sector software, where audit trails and defensible data handling are product requirements. **Technical leadership and influence** * Act as a force multiplier: mentor senior and staff\-track engineers, and grow the depth of the bench across both platforms. * Translate between engineering and executive audiences to make technical risk legible to people making investment decisions. * Represent engineering in conversations with agency customers when technical credibility is what's needed. ### **What We're Looking For** * 12\+ years building and operating production software, including significant time at staff/principal level or equivalent scope. * Demonstrated ownership of architecture for large, multi\-team, multi\-service systems and evidence those systems held up over time. * Deep experience with distributed systems, data modeling, and relational databases at scale, including migrations of live data with no tolerance for loss. * A track record of establishing engineering standards that teams actually adopted, and the judgment to know which standards are worth the friction. * Hands\-on depth in resiliency and performance: SLOs, capacity planning, failure\-mode analysis, observability, and incident command. * Strong experience with cloud infrastructure and modern delivery practice (IaC, CI/CD, progressive rollout). * Exceptional written communication. Much of your impact will arrive as design documents, RFCs, and architectural decision records. * The ability to lead through influence in an organization where you have no formal authority over the teams doing the work. * Proven effectiveness in a remote, distributed engineering organization. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience in government technology, regtech, fintech, payments, or another regulated domain with strong audit and compliance requirements. * Experience with tax calculation, billing, or financial reconciliation systems. * Experience with document management, content\-heavy systems, or search at scale. * History of modernizing legacy platforms incrementally while keeping them running. * Familiarity with public\-sector security frameworks (StateRAMP, FedRAMP, SOC 2, CJIS, PCI DSS). ### **What Success Looks Like** **First 90 days:** You've built a clear picture of the current architecture of both platforms, identified the highest\-leverage risks in resiliency and performance, and earned the trust of the engineering teams and leaders you'll work through. **First 6 months:** You've published a target architecture and modernization roadmap for Records and Tax, established the standards that matter most, and driven at least one meaningful improvement in reliability or performance. **First year:** Engineering standards are embedded in how teams work. Resiliency and performance targets are defined, measured, and being met. Architectural decisions are being made faster and better because of the frameworks you've put in place including decisions you weren't in the room for. **Neumo Summary:** With the backing of four decades of public sector expertise and corporate capability, Neumo has successfully supported government services. Neumo was honored and recognized for four (4\) consecutive years as a GovTech 100 Company representing the top 100 companies focused on making a difference in and selling to state and local government agencies across the United States. Neumo is committed to helping communities thrive and brings a wealth of experience combined with innovation. Today, Neumo offers more administrative and financial support to government officials than any other organization. And with a responsive, client\-focused approach, we foster partnerships that give our customers the certainty they need to accomplish more. Neumo offers a competitive benefits and compensation package and are looking for team members who will thrive in our dynamic environment. *Neumo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Selection for a position will be made without regard to race, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, marital status, non\-disqualifying physical handicap, and age.*

jobs.title: Manager Service Delivery
jobs.description: **Are you looking for limitless career opportunities with a company that values growth, innovation, and teamwork?** At Ntiva, we’re more than a Managed Services Provider, we’re a community dedicated to helping each other, our clients, and their businesses thrive both personally and professionally. Ntiva is a culture of people who are passionate about the work…and each other. Our clients view us as an essential part of their teams, relying on us for strategic guidance, fast solutions to complex challenges, and proactive support. With strategic locations across the U.S. and leadership from our founder, Steven Freidkin, we’re on the front lines of a fast\-paced industry, facing cybersecurity threats and rapid technology changes together. If you thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment and enjoy going above and beyond, we’d love to meet you. Come explore one of our many opportunities and grow with us! **How you’ll make an Impact** As a Manager, Service Delivery, you’ll lead a team of Service Desk and Field Operations professionals who are responsible for delivering exceptional experience to a dedicated group of clients. You’ll have the ownership and autonomy to shape how your team operates, anticipate client needs, and turn challenges into better outcomes. You’ll balance people, service, and business performance, making sure your team has the right capacity to deliver while using data to understand what’s working and where there’s room to improve. Just as importantly, you’ll coach and develop your team members, helping them grow while raising the bar for the service your clients receive. Success in this role isn’t just about keeping work moving. It’s about building a strong team, earning client trust, and delivering results you can see and measure. **Location and work expectations** * This is a remote position; however, team members should be willing and able to travel 5\-10% of the time, as necessary. * To best support our clients and team, this role is open only to candidates who are physically located in the greater Chicagoland area. **What you will be doing** ***Own the client experience*** * Own service delivery outcomes for a named set of clients in your market, and maintain direct, ongoing relationships with them. * Serve as the standing escalation point for service delivery, especially for at\-risk and strategic accounts. * Own major client\-impacting incidents end to end, including the client conversation, root cause, and corrective action through to closure. * Partner with Account Managers and Client Success on account health, renewal risk, and service reviews. ***Lead and grow the team*** * Lead a pod of typically 7–10 team members spanning Service Desk Technician I–III (Tier 1–3\), Systems Administrator, and Systems Engineer roles, including Field Operations staff. * Coach each technician through a personal growth plan, using Ntiva's structured development framework. * Spot who's ready for the next step and champion their promotion. * Set clear expectations and hold people accountable, coaching first and escalating formal action when required. ***Design the coverage*** * Own your pod’s coverage design: which hours, days, and geographies are covered, by whom, and who backs them up. * Build backup into every shift and client site, so coverage never depends on a single person. * Run weekend, holiday, and shoulder\-hour coverage as a documented rota, and escalate gaps before a client is exposed to them. * Direct work, prioritization, and dispatch for the pod, balancing scheduled onsite field work against reactive demand. ***Manage capacity like a business*** * Understand your pod’s demand — volume, mix, effort per ticket — and plan delivery capacity against it. * Manage utilization to a healthy, sustainable band and flag capacity risk early, with numbers. * Make the case for new or backfilled roles with data, weighing options like process change, automation, and reallocation alongside hiring. ***Deliver to the numbers*** * Be directly accountable for your pod scorecard: CSAT, survey response rate, kill rate and backlog, SLO attainment (response, resolution plan, and resolution), and phone metrics. * Improve first\-contact resolution and Tier 1 handle time to get the most from the team you have. * Identify recurring issues and drive permanent fixes rather than repeat remediation. * Ensure ticket data is complete and accurate, including time entry and priority coding, so your pod's work is visible and measurable. ***Raise the bar*** * Reinforce Ntiva’s values through daily actions and expectations. * Contribute ideas for innovation and best practice across pod leadership, including automation and AI\-assisted service delivery. * Invest in your own growth and participate in company\-wide initiatives. **You’ll be successful in this role if you bring** * 3\+ years in a Managed Services Provider or comparable multi\-client service delivery environment. * 2\+ years of direct people management including hiri on any one person. * A team that's growing: people are developing, staying, and earning promotions from within. * Capacity you can defend and Staffing decisions backed by clear data. **Benefits and Perks** * Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employee and family * 401k \+ company\-matched contributions 4% match on 5% contribution \- no vesting period! (Employee and Company contribute after 90 days) * Group Term Life and Accidental Death and Dismemberment coverage (company provided) * Short\-Term (voluntary enrollment) and Long\-Term Disability coverage (company provided) * Health Savings Account (HSA) Options / PPO Options * Employee Assistance Program * Paid Time Off (PTO) \+ Volunteer Time Off (VTO) \+ 8 Paid Holidays \+ 3 Floating Holidays * Education Reimbursement Program * Generous Employee Referral Program \- cash bonus for successful referrals! * Dynamic Recognition and Rewards * Clear Promotion and Advancement Tracks * Work with Industry\-Leading Talent The base pay range for this position is expected to be between $80,000 and $100,000 per year, plus an annual on\-target bonus of 5\-10%. The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple non\-discriminatory factors including, but not limited to, market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position also includes medical benefits, 401(k) eligibility, and PTO. Additional details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. **FLSA Status:** Salaried, Exempt **Work Authorization Criteria** In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. At this time, we are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of an employment visa. **Workspace Requirements and Remote Work Policy** Team members must establish a dedicated safe workspace that is free from distractions, hazards, and that is secure from unauthorized access. This includes following Ntiva’s IT User and Security Policies that include but are not limited to password\-protecting all equipment, keeping confidential and proprietary documents secure, refraining from using public Wi\-Fi, having adequate arrangements in place to avoid significant interruptions from caregiving responsibilities during work hours (except in emergency situations with manager approval). Any remote work away from a team member’s normal expected dedicated safe workspace must be requested by team member, is subject to review by management, and must adhere to Ntiva policies and procedures. **Our Commitment to a Diverse Workforce** At Ntiva, we are committed to creating and maintaining a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming work environment for all employees and job applicants. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters a wider range of perspectives, experiences, and ideas that lead to increased creativity, innovation, and problem\-solving capabilities. As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the communities we serve. We prohibit discrimination of any kind, including but not limited to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, hair length, protective hairstyles, organ donor status, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and comply with all applicable laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. **Application Deadline:** The sooner you apply, the sooner we can get to know you! Submit your resume today! Applications will be accepted until 10/9/26\. Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Intern – Laboratory Testing Support
jobs.description: ON.energy is setting the standard for large load interconnection. ON's patented AI UPS™ is a medium\-voltage UPS that serves as a firewall, protecting the data center from the grid, and the grid from the data center. With multiple gigawatts currently under construction, we are enabling grid\-safe data centers. ### **ROLE SUMMARY** This is a six\-month internship with structured assignments and increasing ownership. Strong performers may be considered for future full\-time opportunities based on business need and role availability. This Intern will support test planning and reporting product and system testing at the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) and ON.energy's Houston laboratory. The intern will help turn engineering requirements into practical test plans, organize execution evidence, prepare clear draft reports by giving support to the laboratory engineers. This is a variable\-term, remote R\&D internship with optional travel. Please Note: This is a remote position. Optional travel may include visits to NLR, Houston, or other test locations. On\-site participation is subject to applicable access, training, and safety requirements. ### ### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Test Plans:** Help develop test plans and procedures that define the objective, required software/hardware setup and acceptance criteria. Maintain clear links between requirements, test activities, and results. * **Readiness:** Support test readiness and daily planning by tracking key resources, dependencies, and open items. * **Execution Records:** Maintain clear test logs and organize the supporting data, observations, and evidence for each test. * **Coordination:** Keep plans and status information current across R\&D, Commissioning Engineering, and external consultants. Follow up on missing inputs and review actions with the responsible technical leads. * **Issues:** Document deviations and open questions for engineering review. Support test plan revisions and retest planning when needed. * **Data Analysis Tool:** Build a reusable tool that can ingest lab test data in different formats and produce consistent, report\-ready graphs. Document the tool so future data sets can be processed efficiently and results can be reproduced. * **Data Review:** Check data quality, create plots, interpret and compare measured results with defined criteria under engineering direction. * **Reporting:** Draft test reports and concise campaign summaries covering results, issues, and next steps. Clearly distinguish measured facts from interpretation and open questions. * **Document Control:** Maintain organized revisions and source evidence in designated ON.energy repositories. * **Process Improvement:** Help improve reusable templates and workflows for test planning, evidence management, and reporting. ### **KEY REQUIREMENTS** * **Education:** Currently pursuing or recently completed a B.S. or M.S. in electrical engineering, data science, or a related technical field. * **Technical Background:** Coursework or project experience related to power systems, energy storage, power electronics or laboratory testing is preferred. * **Tools:** Working knowledge of Excel and experience with Python, MATLAB/Simulink, or a similar data\-analysis tool. * **Core Skills:** Strong technical writing, attention to detail, and the ability to organize engineering information across a distributed team. * **Safety and Confidentiality:** Follow laboratory safety, access, and confidentiality requirements. The intern will not perform energized electrical work unless a separately qualified and authorized user is present. **For US\-based roles \- What you'll get:** * Competitive salary \+ annual performance\-based bonus eligibility * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off and company holidays **For Mexico\-based roles \- What you'll get:** * Competitive salary \+ annual performance bonus eligibility * Christmas Bonus (Aguinaldo): 30 days * Major medical expenses and life insurance * Paid time off and holidays (per local policy) **For all roles:** * Professional development and growth opportunities * Opportunity to grow with a mission\-driven team shaping the future of clean energy * Equal Opportunity: ON.energy is committed to equal employment opportunity and to maintaining a work environment free of harassment, discrimination, or retaliation. * Benefits vary by role and location and are subject to change. **Agency Notice:** ON.energy does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or third\-party recruiters. Resumes submitted without a fully executed Master Services Agreement (MSA) and a written request from an authorized member of our Talent Acquisition team will be considered the property of ON.energy. No placement fees or compensation will be paid for unsolicited candidate submissions.

jobs.description: Forward Deployed Engineering \- San Francisco **About the team** OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development. **About the Role** As a Deployment Lead Life Sciences, you will define how OpenAI delivers complex systems to customers. You will own how they are built, shipped, and adopted. You’ll translate business outcomes into a technical plan, run day\-to\-day execution across FDEs, Researchers, and Customer Engineers, and partner with customer teams to ensure delivery supports their goals. You will focus on the Life Sciences vertical, partnering with pharmaceutical companies, clinical research organizations, and other data and services providers to deploy next\-generation AI capabilities across their drug discovery, development, and operations. You will own delivery end\-to\-end: embedding with Life Sciences customers to map workflows and success criteria, ensuring components ship on time, and leading readiness and change management for adoption. You’ll track progress, manage dependencies, make sequencing decisions, and drive 0 1 prototypes through MVP and scale. You will also share field insights with Product and Research to guide roadmap and priorities. Success will be measured first and foremost by impact \- deployments that deliver measurable value against customer goals, drive adoption, and become critical to their workflows. Additional measures of success include delivery reliability (milestones hit, low reopen/churn), operating leverage (patterns reused across deployments), judgment under pressure, and product impact (field signal that shifts roadmaps/architectures). This is a high\-trust, high\-autonomy role. Success requires deep technical project management expertise, extreme ownership of outcomes, and an ability to immerse in customer workflows and partner with customer teams to solve complex engineering problems at pace. This role is based in New York. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required. **In this role, you will:** * Own the technical delivery plan for multiple interdependent workstreams. Translate business objectives into a roadmap with milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria. * Run day\-to\-day engineering execution. Track and drive delivery across OpenAI FDE and customer teams. Keep progress unblocked and sequenced. Make real\-time trade\-offs on scope and priority to protect the critical path. * Embed with customer teams to land production deployments and drive adoption. Map workflows, shape tools/integrations, and translate requirements into a delivery plan. Lead onboarding, adoption, and change management. * Partner with Product and Research so platform components and research workstreams land in time to support deployment goals. * Codify solution patterns and evals. Extract reusable patterns and package field signals to improve product and models. * Own value cases and ROI. Set impact hypotheses, baselines, and KPIs; run pre\-/post\-deployment measurement and report to exec sponsors. * Shape how we engage Life Sciences customers **You’ll thrive in this role if you:** * Bring 7\+ years of customer‑facing technical delivery leadership and have expertise in the Life Sciences space. * Track record of successfully leading large, complex, high\-stakes customer engagements where customer outcomes depended on tight coordination and fast decision making, ideally involving AI. * Excel in high ambiguity environments. Know how to simplify complex and dynamic work. * Move fluidly between system level understanding and execution level detail; can dive into customer workflows/data, map constraints, sketch architectures and move ambiguous problems to shipped systems. * Think strategically and pattern\-match. Able to step back from execution detail, recognise broader trends across deployments, and connect customer needs to scalable, reusable solutions. * Have strong technical fluency and sharp sequencing instincts. Confident discussing technical details, pressure\-testing architectures, and making trade\-offs. * Have shipped AI/LLM systems. You understand solution patterns, integration basics, and production pitfalls. * You’re a translator with executive presence. You make complex technical trade\-offs legible to business leaders and convert strategy into day\-to\-day technical execution. * Enjoy being onsite with customers to accelerate delivery (often 25\-50%, sometimes higher). **About OpenAI** OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. jobs.title: Lead Principal Data Center Commissioning Engineer - Salt Lake City area
jobs.description: In response to increased concurrent projects for the delivery of our data centers, Oracle is recruiting a Lead Principle Commissioning Engineer. The role is a senior multi\-disciplinary data center commissioning lead with a focus all levels of commissioning activities up to IST, and responsible for the direct interface between Oracle and our data center partners in the completion and testing of building systems to bring a data center reliably to ready for service and eventually turn over to operations. With extensive experience reviewing design and delivering mission critical facilities, professional qualifications in mechanical, control or electrical engineering with a commissioning focus. The role is responsible for setting Oracle’s stance for commissioning activities and working with our delivery, construction and collocation partners to ensure successful IST and turnover to operations. Location: Salt Lake City, UT Area * Oversight of the commissioning of multiple lease provider projects. jobs.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer - AI Infrastructure
jobs.description: As a Principal Member of Technical Staff, you will own the software design and development for major components of Oracle's Cloud Infrastructure. You should be both a rock\-solid lead developer, curious problem solver, a distributed systems generalist and/or skilled Linux engineer with Systems triage experiance able to dive deep into any part of the stack and low\-level systems to design broad distributed system interactions. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn. This role resides within the Compute AI Infrastructure Bare Metal Provisioning team, which owns the critical infrastructure responsible for automating the full server lifecycle from new platform shape (AMD/Intel/Arm/Nvidia) creation, hardware bring\-up to customer\-ready instance provisioning and firmware management. The services operate at the intersection of bare metal hardware and full\-stack orchestration frameworks, a unique combination where both distributed systems engineers and engineers with background in Linux and firmware are highly valued. The team interfaces directly with components like BMCs, NICs, SmartNICs, ILOMs, GPUs, and custom firmware stacks. The team builds high performance, scalable micro\-services and tooling that provision, configure, secure, and validate server platforms across OCI’s massive fleet of Compute and GPU Infrastructure. You will partner closely across other teams in Compute, Networking, Security, Data center Engineering, and Hardware Development to ensure OCI can launch, scale, and maintain new server platforms with minimal operational overhead and high reliability. You will work directly with cutting edge GPU hardware and see the direct impact of your work on the business. We strive for equity, inclusion, and respect for all. We are committed to the greater good in our products and our actions. We are constantly learning and taking opportunities to grow our careers and ourselves. Quality:** Set rigorous standards for code quality through constructive code reviews, comprehensive automated testing (including AI\-driven test suites), and continuous integration/delivery (CI/CD). * **Technical Leadership \& Mentorship:** Guide junior and mid\- * * **Education:** 4\-year Bachelor’s degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) major or a Master's degree in Technology or Computer Science or related field. * **Professional Experience:** 10\+ years of professional software development experience, with a minimum of 4\+ years in a Senior Software Engineer role (or equivalent). ### **Core Technical Expertise** * **Backend Ecosystem:** Strong, hands\-on experience with the .NET Ecosystem (.NET Core / .NET Framework) and robust relational database design using SQL Server (including query optimization). * **Frontend Ecosystem:** Extensive experience building highly responsive, scalable user interfaces using modern JavaScript frameworks—specifically **React and/or Angular (Required)**. * **Architecture \& Design:** Practical experience applying **Domain\-Driven Design (DDD)** principles and building service\-based or distributed architectures. * **Cloud \& DevOps:** Strong proficiency with AWS services (or other major cloud architectures), CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure provisioning. * **Batch \& Data Processing:** Familiarity with high\-volume batch processing, background automated jobs, and handling complex data streams. ### **Preferred Technical Pluses** * Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. * Familiarity with event\-driven architectures and system monitoring/APM tools (e.g., Datadog). * Prior domain knowledge in orthodontic/dental billing, medical insurance, or healthcare fintech. * **Delivery:** You roadmap large tracks of work, identify non\-functional requirements (NFRs) for Epics, and maintain high execution integrity without needing close supervision. * **Problem Solving:** concise, and fact\-backed technical communications tailored to both engineering teams and non\-technical stakeholders. * **Leadership:** You raise the bar for code quality, manage stakeholder expectations, and proactively identify cross\-team dependencies. * **Code Fluency:** You design reusable, modular components that adapt to changing business needs, prioritizing long\-term jobs.description: Overview: At PNNL, our core capabilities are divided among major departments that we refer to as Directorates within the Lab, focused on a specific area of scientific research or other function, with its own leadership team and dedicated budget. Our directorates related to Mission Support \& Operations include Office of General Counsel, Business Services, Communications and External Engagement, Operational Systems, Communications and Information Technology, and Performance Management. The Operational Systems Directorate (OSD) leads delivery of PNNL’s 10\-year, $1\.2 billion campus construction portfolio— the single largest construction and modernization effort in the Laboratory’s history. OSD oversees operations and facility services, maintenance, and infrastructure planning. A team of nearly 800 staff comprise OSD, spanning in a wide range of disciplines, including craftspeople, engineers, construction professionals, technicians, scientists, administrators, and specialists. Together, they ensure that PNNL’s assets, services, and OSD\-led programs are managed and performing safely, securely, reliably, effectively, and efficiently. The directorate stewards more than $250 million in annual budget authority; managing more than 2\.5 million square feet of facility space across two campuses; overseeing approximately 200 regulatory program areas; and executing a multi\-million\-dollar facility and infrastructure project portfolio. The Facilities \& Infrastructure Operations (F\&IO) Division is responsible for operating and maintaining PNNL’s buildings, grounds, and utilities. The F\&IO team includes plant engineering, fabrication, craft services, duplicating and mail services, facility program support, relocations, and receiving. F\&IO is home to approximately 363 staff including more than 250 bargaining unit (union) staff. Rockstar Rewards: Employees and their families are offered medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, robust telehealth care options, several mental health benefits, free wellness coaching, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, basic life insurance, disability insurance\*, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, tuition assistance, relocation, backup childcare, legal benefits, supplemental parental bonding leave, surrogacy and adoption assistance, and fertility support. In addition, the Division oversees campus infrastructure such as fabrication and craft services, duplicating and mail services, relocations, receiving, distributed services, and maintains operations of roads, grounds, and utilities for the campus. The PNNL **Campus Sustainability / Energy Efficiency Lead** is a unique opportunity to make an immediate impact as Federal agencies lead by example in net\-zero emission buildings, clean energy, and resilient operation targets. In this role, you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end lifecycle of feature development, from initial design and API integration to automated testing and cloud deployment. You will work across a modern stack, leveraging Java\-based microservices and serverless functions to build scalable, high\-availability systems. **Key Responsibilities** * **Feature Development:** Lead the design and implementation of new functional modules using **Java** and **Spring Boot** , ensuring high performance and responsiveness to requests from the front\-end. * **Full\-Stack Quality:** Write comprehensive, automated **unit tests** (using JUnit/Mockito) for every feature to ensure code reliability, maintainability, and a high level of test coverage. * **Cloud\-Native Actions). * **Testing:** Expertise in writing unit tests and familiarity with Test\-Driven Development (TDD) practices. * **Version Control:** Expert knowledge of Git for branching, merging, and pull request workflows. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, DynamoDB). * Understanding of containerization principles using Docker. * Knowledge of jobs.title: Water Quality Specialist 2
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- **Summary** ----------- **Why It's a Great Opportunity:** In this public\-facing role with the Pierce County Surface Water Management (SWM) team, you will be focused on identifying and responding to activities or incidents that could lead to the discharge of pollutants into stormwater systems and the environment. You will collaborate with other departments and teams to support the implementation of Pierce County's Phase I NPDES Municipal Stormwater Permits. You and your team’s efforts will contribute to reducing stormwater pollution that reaches streams, lakes, groundwater, the Puget Sound, and neighboring municipalities' stormwater drainage systems. **Why It's a Great Department:** PPW stewards a healthy and vibrant community by collaboratively planning and investing in our people, infrastructure, systems, and policies. PPW’s team has more than 800 members who collaborate, innovate, and inspire as they provide essential services to the community. The department is responsible for the County road and levee systems, sewer systems, airports, ferries, building permits, environmental review, sustainability, community planning, and code enforcement \- just to name a few! Learn more about Planning and Public Works here. The Surface Water Management (SWM) division enjoys working together to continuously improve our program by keeping up with new scientific technologies and solving problems to protect our surface waters. We are a supportive and collaborative group of professional scientists, planners, and engineers who strive to protect and maintain surface water quality for fish, wildlife, and the public. Learn more about Surface Water Management at About Surface Water Management \| Pierce County, WA \- Official Website (piercecountywa.gov) **How to Be Successful in This Role:** Your success will come from combining strong technical, investigative, and communication skills with the ability to perform field work in a variety of conditions. Your experience interpreting environmental data, conducting inspections, maintaining field documentation, updating GIS maps, and calibrating and maintaining field equipment will be utilized often. Your ability to collaborate with colleagues, regulatory agencies, businesses, and the public, as well as resolve conflicts, work independently, and apply stormwater regulations, will also be important. Your flexibility, attention to detail, problem\-solving skills, and willingness to learn and train others on IDDE procedures, source control practices, and field inspection techniques will help ensure your success. **Your Future in this Role:** You will have access to professional development through robust online learning and other training opportunities throughout your career to ensure your success. This position has multiple career growth and promotional opportunities in Pierce County to build on a great career while directly impacting the communities in Pierce County. **Core Daily Responsibilities:** * Conduct and assist with complex on\-site inspections of stormwater management facilities associated with industrial, commercial, and multi\-family land use; determine or verify the proper operation and maintenance of stormwater management facilities and implementation of stormwater Best Management Practices. * Refer and direct citizens, engineers, contractors, and other agencies in matters of spill prevention, water quality protection, and stormwater management; respond to routine questions and information requests. * Perform calibration and maintenance procedures on field sampling and monitoring equipment. * Perform water\-level measurements from surface/ground water monitoring wells. * Perform field measurements such as water temperature, specific conductance, pH, turbidity and dissolved oxygen from both surface and ground water sources. * Perform data quality assurance and control and chain of custody processing. * Perform routine water quality sampling, prepare labels, and complete chain\-of\-custody reports; conduct sampling and field investigations for Surface Water Management staff, other County departments, governmental agencies and members of the public. A classification description with a more detailed list of essential functions can be found here. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * Additional education or experience may substitute for the recruiting requirements. * One or more years of progressively responsible related experience AND * Two years of college or post\-high school technical training. * A resume and cover letter are required for this position. * A valid driver’s license is required. As a condition of employment, the applicant will need to authorize and complete a background check. Information received from the background check is reviewed case\-by\-case and will not necessarily remove an applicant from consideration. **Supplemental Information** ---------------------------- **How to Apply:** * Complete and submit a detailed online Pierce County Employment Application by selecting “APPLY” above or visiting www.piercecountywa.gov/jobs. * If you have questions about this opportunity, email the Recruitment Team at PCHRRecruit@piercecountywa.gov and include the job number and title. * Individuals who need accommodation in the application or interview process may contact Human Resources at (253\) 798\-7480 at least two days prior to the need. * Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship. **Our Recruitment Practices:** This is a competitive and meritorious selection process. Pierce County applications are reviewed by human hiring staff in accordance with the qualifications listed for the position**.** Pierce County understands applicants may use AI tools when preparing application materials. We recognize these tools can make the process easier; however, we ask that everything you submit genuinely reflects your own experience, skills, knowledge, and writing style. During the interview process, you may be asked to demonstrate your skills, including writing and subject knowledge, and to speak to your experience in your own voice. Applicants should be prepared to respond to interview questions without relying on AI\-generated responses or reading prepared answers from a screen. Any misrepresentation may result in disqualification or separation. Applicants whose qualifications most closely align with the County’s needs will be eligible for further consideration. Notification of application status typically occurs within two to three weeks after the closing date. Some applicants may receive short notice to participate in additional selection steps, which may include assessments, phone screens, or interviews. Upon offer, compensation is based on a range of job\-related factors, including the requirements of the role, your skills and experience, and internal pay equity. **Our Welcoming Workplace Commitment:** Pierce County is committed to fostering a Welcoming Workplace where employees are supported, respected, and able to thrive. We believe a strong public workforce is representative of the community it serves and that fair and just access to opportunity strengthens public service. Guided by the County Executive’s Forward Together mission, Pierce County works to build communities that are safe, welcoming, and connected. This same commitment shapes how we recruit, develop, and retain our employees. County employees make a direct and visible impact in the lives of residents every day, and we invite you to join us in helping keep Pierce County a place people are proud to call home. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

jobs.title: Power Engineering Technologist I
jobs.description: **Position Overview:** This is an entry\-level position that supports our Engineering team and reports directly to regional operational leadership. The role includes a combination of office and field work, providing hands\-on experience applying technical skills to help design safe, reliable, and cost\-effective solutions for power distribution projects. You should be comfortable learning design tools, following company and client workflows and procedures, accurately entering data, and developing a foundational understanding of each project's technical requirements. **Essential Functions:** * This role requires regular on\-site attendance and is not eligible for remote or hybrid work. * Interpret and comply with all applicable codes, regulations, policies, and procedures while maintaining accurate, well\-organized project documentation. * Support Project Design \& Preparation: Assist with the development of complete project and job packages, including drawings, material lists, estimates, and requisitions, using company and client design software and work management tools. * Develop Technical Field \& Construction Knowledge: Prepare comprehensive project and job packages—such as drawings, material lists, estimates, and requisitions—while utilizing company and client design software and work management tools. * Provide regular project status updates and build strong working relationships with internal and external partners to ensure expectations, timelines, and business objectives are met. * Engage in Continuous Learning \& Mentorship: Actively build technical, design, and field knowledge through ongoing training and mentorship from experienced team members, supervisors, and Professional Engineers. * Participate in storm restoration activities as needed. **Minimum Requirements:** * Regular attendance is required. * High school diploma or GED (Certain client projects or contractual requirements may require an Associate degree from a two \- year college or technical school). * 0\-2 years of experience in power distribution engineering, electrical craft work, or GIS/CAD\-related work. **Other Abilities:** * Valid driver's license and vehicle suitable for business use (mileage reimbursement may apply). **Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. This role involves primarily office\-based work with regular sitting and frequent use of hands for computer and tool handling, and talking and hearing throughout the day. The position also includes occasional standing, walking, reaching, climbing or balancing, and stooping or kneeling during field activities. We may require employees to lift up to 10 pounds regularly. The job also requires visual abilities, including close and distance vision, color distinction, peripheral vision, and depth perception. Reasonable accommodations can be made for individuals with disabilities. **Work Environment:** Your work will involve a mix of office and field work. While most duties are performed in a typical office setting, you may occasionally perform work outdoors in various weather conditions and in areas that you or others elevate or deem hazardous. Some tasks may also involve exposure to a risk of electrical shock during field visits. We make reasonable accommodations to support individuals with disabilities. **Our Benefits:** * Medical, dental and vision insurance * HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * 401(k) with company match * Life insurance, and short\-term and long\-term disability * Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave If this sounds like you, come join the PIKE family. NOTE: We do not intend this job description to be all\-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as required to meet the ongoing needs of the organization. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Pike Engineering is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin and/or status as a protected veteran or individual with a disability.

jobs.description: At PGE, our work involves dreaming about, planning for, and realizing a smarter, cleaner, more enduring Oregon neighborhood. jobs.description: The Opportunity PrimeCo is hiring an experienced Business Development Executive to own our North County San Diego territory, from Oceanside to Del Mar and east through Escondido and Rancho Bernardo. strategy, and value \- not price alone · Steady progress toward the territory's approximately $5 million annual booked\-sales target after the ramp period · Clients who remain confident through construction and return to PrimeCo for future work The PrimeCo Platform You will be supported by: · In\-house estimating, project management, superintendents, foremen, and skilled field crews · PrimeTrack, our client communication platform for schedules, progress, documentation, and project visibility · A leadership team that understands complex HOA sales and supports decisive, responsible deal strategy · Proven systems for large, multi\-phase painting, carpentry, waterproofing, and reconstruction projects · A team culture built on trust, accountability, empathy, pride in workmanship, construction professionals · Disciplined CRM, pipeline\-management, follow\-up, and forecasting habits · A consultative approach, sound judgment, personal accountability, and the ability to work independently **Highly valued:** experience in estimating, preconstruction, project management, HOA reconstruction, construction\-defect work, or reading plans, specifications, and technical reports. Compensation and Benefits · $80,000 base salary · Uncapped commission; expected total annual earnings of approximately $150,000\-$250,000\+, based on performance · Vehicle allowance and business expense account/company credit card · Health insurance · 401(k) with 6% company match · Unlimited PTO · Company\-provided iPhone and MacBook Application Process Apply with your resume and brief written answers to the following: · What approximate sales volume have you personally closed during the last 12\-24 months? · What experience and relationships do you have in HOA reconstruction, construction defect, or a related construction market? · Why are you interested in owning the North County San Diego territory? Creates and updates electrical and electronic control system drawings using computer\-aided drafting methods. Performs wiring tracing, reviews PLC layouts and control system components, and updates “as\-built” documentation after rewiring instrumentation and system configurations. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** ----------------------------------------- * Installs, calibrates, tests, troubleshoots, repairs and maintains electrical control systems, equipment, and components in the SCADA System and for Pueblo Water. * Assists SCADA Administrator and/or department lead with designing installing, maintaining, troubleshooting and updating Pueblo Water’s SCADA System. * Installs, calibrates, tests, troubleshoots, repairs and maintains SCADA System communication systems for Pueblo Water. (Cellular, Telemetry, Wired, etc.) * Integrates, maintains, troubleshoots, and repairs Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) both large and small within the treatment plant and distribution system. * Integrates, maintains, troubleshoots, and repairs Motor Control Centers (MCC) systems and components. * Integrates, installs, maintains, and troubleshoots instrumentation in the SCADA System and for Pueblo Water including but not limited to, level, pressure, flow, actuators, drives, process controllers, instrumentation controllers, and etc. * Maintains and installs Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS) systems and batteries per Pueblo Waters Risk Management Plan. * Works with the SCADA Administrator and IS Department to install and test Pueblo Water Security systems as required. * Works with IS Department to troubleshoot and resolve problems with communication systems related to the SCADA Department. * Works with SCADA Administrator and IS Department to maintain, troubleshoot, and install data communication equipment such as modems, routers, switches, antennas, fiber and copper cable, lightning arrestors, etc.. * Performs work on and around medium to high voltage equipment. * Performs computer\-aided drafting in the creation of electrical, electronic, and control system drawings and schematics. * Utilizes test equipment including, but not limited to, analog multitesters, digital assigned. * Prepares and completes work order processes and procedures as assigned. * Maintains inventory of tools, parts and equipment. Interacts with co\-workers and supervisors. * Intermediate Knowledge of the NEC and electrical codes related to the field of work. * Must possess the ability to perform the essential functions of the position. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** ----------------------------------- **Working Environment and Level of Physical Activity****:** Work is performed in both indoor and outdoor environments. Physical hazards are present approximately 75% of the time and may inhibit the normal performance of duties. Position may be exposed to adverse weather conditions, confined spaces, noise and traffic hazards, chemical solvents or fumes, and high voltage areas. Work may include climbing water storage tanks and other structures as directed. Work will also require performing full duties of the job description while on a surface other than the ground such as, but not limited to, water storage tanks, buildings, communication towers and other structures that house Pueblo Water infrastructure. Work requires continuous standing, walking, bending, climbing, and/or kneeling for extended periods of the time on a regular basis. Lifting, pulling, and/or pushing of items (sometimes in excess of 40 pounds) is moderate and necessary for the performance of required duties. ***The essential functions and major responsibilities listed above are intended only as illustrations of the various types of work that may be performed. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position. Duties and responsibilities are also subject to change by the employer as the needs of Pueblo Water and requirements of the job change. The above are the duties performed by employees in this classification. Not all duties listed are necessarily performed by each individual in the classification.*** We are an equal opportunity employer (EEO)

jobs.title: Lead Application Security Engineer, Code to Cloud
jobs.description: Overview: As a Lead Application Security Engineer, Code to Cloud at QXO, you’ll be the recognized subject matter expert for application security across the company and own the engineering behind Code to Cloud: continuous security coverage across QXO’s software delivery lifecycle, from source code through pipeline execution to cloud runtime. QXO is building a modern cybersecurity function from the ground up, automation\-first. This is a large, enterprise\-wide program spanning three engineering organizations, and you will run your part of it with limited oversight, defining the standards QXO builds against rather than applying someone else’s. Attackers operate at machine speed, and human\-speed review cannot meet that, so we automate first. QXO is a leading distributor and installer of building products serving an $800 billion market. The company’s mission is to modernize the building products industry through advanced technology and a best\-in\-class customer experience. QXO is North America’s largest distributor and installer of insulation, the second\-largest distributor of roofing products, the second\-largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials, and the largest distributor of waterproofing products. The company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenue within the decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth. For more information, visit QXO.com. What you will do:: * Own the scanning and posture platform end to end across secrets, SAST, SCA, infrastructure\-as\-code, container images, and cloud runtime, at a false\-positive rate engineers trust. Build the automation that routes, deduplicates, and prioritizes findings, with owner resolution, SLA tracking, and closure verification. * Build and run policy\-based blocking controls in pull requests and CI/CD pipelines, as policy\-as\-code applied centrally and scoped to repository tiering, so coverage inherits to future repositories. Turn a gate on only when the baseline is triaged and false positives are under bar, and never block a team without a path forward. * Author the application security standards, secure design patterns, and remediation SLAs QXO builds against, own the exception and risk\-acceptance workflow, and report on risk reduced rather than finding counts. Make threat modeling repeatable through templates and AI\-assisted triage, producing testable requirements. * Sit in architecture and design reviews with principal engineers and reach a decision in the room: where a gateway\-validated token stops being sufficient and service identity needs its own mechanism, how object\-level authorization survives a list endpoint, and why a service must never take an authorization attribute from its caller. Review third\-party integrations before production. * Set the technical bar for the practice: coach, review, and direct the security work of the champions network and third\-party testing partners, and mentor engineers added to the team. Be the person engineering calls, explaining what a finding means and what it does not, so a blocked developer gets an answer the same day. * Own security testing of the running application, not just its source, and work with developers to remediate what it finds, verifying on retest. Lead the response when a critical vulnerability or exploit drops. * Lead the security integration of acquired engineering environments, bringing their repositories, pipelines, and cloud accounts under coverage without stalling delivery. What you will bring:: * 8\+ years in application security, product security, DevSecOps, or security engineering, most of it hands\-on rather than advisory. * Hands\-on experience owning an enterprise\-scale security program across multiple teams and stakeholder groups with limited oversight, including setting standards others follow and reviewing the work of other engineers. * Depth in a cloud\-native application protection or application security posture platform such as Wiz, Snyk, Prisma Cloud, or Orca. You have written policy and built on its API, not just read dashboards. * Pipeline enforcement you have actually shipped: policy\-based blocking in pull requests and CI/CD, security policy\-as\-code, and the harder part, moving a control from advisory to blocking without an engineering revolt. * Threat modeling you have run, not just studied. STRIDE or an equivalent applied to real systems, extended with MITRE ATLAS and the LLM risk taxonomies where classical categories fall short on AI\-enabled systems. * Architecture\-level security judgment. You can hold your own with a principal engineer on authorization design in a distributed system: trust boundaries, token validation, service\-to\-service identity, and object\-level access control. * Approachable, responsive, and constructive under pressure. You can tell a team their launch has a problem without becoming the reason they route around security. * An automation\-first, AI\-forward way of working, and a defensible view on securing AI itself: validating AI\-generated code, and agentic risk including prompt injection, tool permissions, and the MCP supply chain. * Dynamic testing of running applications and APIs through DAST tooling, API security testing, or hands\-on offensive work, and cloud security depth in a major public cloud, Google Cloud a plus. * Coding ability in Python, Go, or TypeScript, and writing that is tight, evidence\-backed, and defensible when challenged. **Education \& Certifications*** Bachelor’s in computer science, information assurance, MIS, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred. Google Cloud certifications preferred, particularly Professional Cloud Security Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or Architect. CSSLP, GWAPT, OSWE, or OSCP a plus. What you will earn:: * Base pay range: $101,300 \- $172,000 * Annual performance bonus * 401(k) with employer match * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * PTO, company holidays, and parental leave * Paid Time Off/Paid Sick Leave: Applicants can expect to accrue 15 days of paid time off during their first year (4\.62 hours for every 80 hours worked) and increased accruals after five years of service. * Paid training and certifications * Legal assistance and identity protection * Pet insurance * Employee assistance program (EAP) To comply with Pay Transparency laws, employers must disclose an annual salary range. Actual offers depend on factors such as location, experience, skills, and market data. This position may also offer variable compensation. Please contact careers@QXO.com if you have any questions related to this job posting. ***QXO is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*** *We value diversity and do not discriminate* *on the basis of* *race, color, religion,* *gender or sexual orientation**, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.* Pay Range: USD $101,300\.00 \- USD $172,000\.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Linux Administrator (Infrastructure)
jobs.description: **About the Team** We are Quadcode, a fintech company excelling in financial brokerage activities and delivering advanced financial products to our global clientele. Our flagship product, an internal trading platform, is offered as a Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) solution to other brokers.### **About the role** We’re looking for a **Linux Administrator** to join our **Infrastructure team**, responsible for building, operating and continuously improving a private cloud infrastructure based on OpenStack and Kubernetes. Our infrastructure supports the stable operation of a large\-scale trading platform and includes 2,000\+ virtual machines and 500\+ physical servers, as well as a wide range of Linux systems and infrastructure services such as DNS, GitLab, Artifactory, Prometheus, Loki and Vault. You’ll work in a team of experienced infrastructure engineers, using Scrum and Agile practices, with two\-week sprints and a strong focus on automation, reliability and continuous improvement. The position is **full\-time remote**, with a flexible start time — anytime before 12:00 pm EET/EEST. ### **Why this role?** You’ll be part of the team responsible for the production environment behind products used by millions of users, working directly with development teams, helping them troubleshoot infrastructure\-related issues and keep their services running reliably in production. It’s a good fit for an engineer who enjoys troubleshooting, automation and making infrastructure more reliable and scalable, rather than simply maintaining servers. ### **Tasks** * Oversee various services and associated infrastructure components, including DNS, Gitlab, Artifactory, Vault, etc; * Perform day\-to\-day operational tasks such as upgrades, CVE patching, backup and restore, security scans, and monitoring; * Manage and support private clouds (Openstack and Kubernetes); * Design, configure, maintain and troubleshoot Linux systems across different environments, including bare metal, virtual machines and containers. * Resolve incidents, provide support coverage, categorize issues, conduct post\-mortems, and perform root cause analysis; * Ensure environments are stable and adhere to availability SLAs; * Work towards reducing operational effort; * Automate repetitive operational tasks and continuously reduce manual effort; * Collaborate with development teams to troubleshoot infrastructure\-related issues in production; * Keep infrastructure documentation and operational procedures up to date; * Engage in constant upskilling to stay updated with industry best practices. ### **Requirements** * 5\+ years of professional experience as a Linux system administrator, DevOps Engineer, or Site Reliability Engineer; * Extensive experience in designing, building, configuring, and troubleshooting Linux servers across various environments (bare metal, container, cloud); * Experience with Linux server configuration, maintenance and troubleshooting in production. * Understanding of process control, logging and Linux service management. * Experience with infrastructure services such as Vault, Artifactory, DNS and similar platform components. * Proficiency with automation tools such as Ansible, Salt, or Chef; * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and containerized environments; * Experience with monitoring and log aggregation tools like Grafana, ELK, or Graylog; * Hands\-on experience in deploying and maintaining systems on cloud solutions such as OpenStack, VMware, Proxmox, or public cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure. * Skilled in scripting languages such as Bash and Python; * Familiarity with configuring various servers and databases, including Apache Tomcat, Nginx, MySQL DB, PostgreSQL, Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc; * Experience with DevOps tools and CI/CD workflows. * At least C1 in Russian and B1 in English. ### **Nice to have** * Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, including troubleshooting workloads and cluster\-related issues. * Hands\-on experience with OpenStack, including deployment, configuration, maintenance or troubleshooting of private cloud environments. * Experience with GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins or GitHub Actions. * Experience working with fintech/trading, or other high\-load and mission\-critical systems. ### **We offer** * Full\-time remote work (service provider contract). * Competitive compensation (EUR). * Flexible working hours. * Corporate AI subscriptions (Claude, Gemini, GPT, etc.). * Access to a rewards marketplace offering products and language courses, redeemable using the company’s internal currency. * A strong team of engineers. * Positive and friendly atmosphere. With a team of 500\+ creative and tech\-driven people across the globe, Quadcode is the place where ideas turn into impact, where every project is a chance to grow, innovate, and make your mark. **Join us today, and let's shape the future of fintech together!** *Note: All applications will be treated with strict confidence. We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.* \#LI\-JM1

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer (New Grad / Entry Level)
jobs.description: Qumulo is a software\-defined cloud data platform. Our core is a distributed storage operating system in C \& Rust, holding exabytes in the datacenter, at the edge, and natively in the cloud. Qumulo serves everything from a hospital's medical imaging archive to an animation studio's render farm in an environment where 99% correct doesn’t cut it. **About the Role:** Joining us, you'd learn and work across our distributed storage engine and the services that help customers store, manage, and protect their data, under the guidance of experienced senior engineers. This includes a fault\-tolerant block layer that erasure\-codes and distributes data beneath the file system, a transactional file system where aggregates roll up as they change so a query across billions of files answers in real time instead of walking a tree, and that same machinery drives quotas, capacity trends, snapshot policy, multiple access protocols, plus replication and backup \- all running in userspace. All of which makes Qumulo a distributed operating system problem: scheduling, memory hierarchy, protection, and concurrency. We're AI\-forward and specific about what that means. You will learn to use agents to help write code while developing your engineering judgment to ensure every design decision is correct, because nothing ships that isn't right. **Why join Qumulo:** Qumulo blends the flexibility of a startup with the security of a mature and profitable organization. Here you’ll work closely with a small team of smart, capable engineers who will serve as your mentors. Opinions are expected, disagreement is normal, and you'll get hands\-on experience taking projects from ideation to release. We value quality, correctness, and performance. Our architecture, protocols, and patents are public, so you can read how most of this works before you talk to us \- and we’re small enough that the work you do will actually show up in the product. **As a Software Engineer at Qumulo, you will:** * Collaborate with team members on design, code reviews, and pair programming to deliver high\-quality software. * Collaborate with team members and area leads on architecture and design of new/updated features. * Contribute to full\-lifecycle feature development and testing using C, Rust, and Python. * Take ownership of defining and implementing customer\-facing features and internal system improvements. * Help debug, troubleshoot, and fix test failures and complex product or service issues in production environments. **What we're looking for:** * Recently graduated (or graduating within the next 9 months) with a degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent experience. * Ability to write well\-factored, maintainable, and well\-tested code. * Strong grasp of algorithms and data structures, with solid academic or project experience in distributed systems, database concepts, concurrent programming, or operating systems concepts. * Proficiency in C, C\+\+, Rust, Java, or Go demonstrated through classes, internships, or personal projects * Willingness to work collaboratively with a team to solve complex problems and learn quickly on the job. * Ability to work a hybrid schedule from our downtown Seattle HQ Must be authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or transfer. This role is hybrid, based at our downtown Seattle HQ, targeting 3 days a week in\-office. The salary range for this role is USD $110,000 \- $140,000 annual base salary plus pre\-IPO stock options and benefits. Individual compensation depends on factors such as role level, relevant experience, and skill set. **Benefits \& Perks:** * Pre\-IPO stock options * Flexible time\-off policy * HSA and PPO health insurance options * Dental and Vision insurance * 401(k) plan * Choice of an ORCA card or parking subsidy **About Qumulo:** Built for the most demanding enterprise workloads, from AI and HPC simulations to Splunk Observability, genomics and PACS medical imaging, geospatial datasets, media editing and rendering, and video surveillance, Qumulo unlocks the full power of an organization’s information. Our platform unifies file and object storage across data centers, edge, and public clouds, enabling efficient, accelerated computing and extending the reach of data unbound by protocol or transport limitations. With more than 1,100 customers and exabytes of data under management, Qumulo powers mission\-critical workloads anywhere real\-time access to massive file datasets is non\-negotiable. Qumulo delivers radical simplicity, hardware freedom, exceptional customer support, and a true hybrid\-cloud architecture. **Our Values:** At Qumulo, we are building an open and collaborative culture where people can do their best work with customers as our magnetic field. jobs.title: Enterprise Architect, Data & AI Enablement

teams. * Working knowledge and practical experience with established enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman, FEAF). * DAMA CDMP certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise in data management, data governance, metadata/reference data, data quality, data architecture, data integration/interoperability, data security, and data modeling/design. * Experience applying AI governance, responsible AI, AI risk management, or AI management\-system practices informed by frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, the NIST Generative AI Profile. * Experience establishing or leading
